1fbea976-fb6a-524f-b0f7-d7202406dc52.name: Alert
1fbea976-fb6a-524f-b0f7-d7202406dc52.description: You spot trouble before it happens and can swap places with an ally at the start of combat.

attributes.benefits:
You gain the following benefits.

**Initiative Proficiency.** When you roll Initiative, you can add your Proficiency Bonus to the roll.

**Initiative Swap.** Immediately after you roll Initiative, you can swap your Initiative with the Initiative of one willing ally in the same combat. You can't make this swap if you or the ally has the Incapacitated condition.

8d75d9de-753a-531c-a302-a050d1113f3c.name: Magic Initiate
8d75d9de-753a-531c-a302-a050d1113f3c.description: You learn two cantrips and a level 1 spell from the Cleric, Druid, or Wizard list.

player_choices.label: Spell List
player_choices.prompt: Choose which class list this feat draws from.

player_choices.label: Cantrips
player_choices.prompt: Pick two cantrips from the chosen list.

player_choices.label: Level 1 Spell
player_choices.prompt: Pick one level-1 spell from the chosen list.

attributes.benefits:
You gain the following benefits.

**Two Cantrips.** You learn two cantrips of your choice from the Cleric, Druid, or Wizard spell list. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this feat's spells (choose when you select this feat).

**Level 1 Spell.** Choose a level 1 spell from the same list you selected for this feat's cantrips. You always have that spell prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a Long Rest. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have.

**Spell Change.** Whenever you gain a new level, you can replace one of the spells you chose for this feat with a different spell of the same level from the chosen spell list.

**Repeatable.** You can take this feat more than once, but you must choose a different spell list each time.

efc121c3-678c-51d1-b60c-6657dfcfdbe1.name: Savage Attacker
efc121c3-678c-51d1-b60c-6657dfcfdbe1.description: Once per turn you can re-roll a weapon's damage and use either result.

attributes.benefits: You've trained to deal particularly damaging strikes. Once per turn when you hit a target with a weapon, you can roll the weapon's damage dice twice and use either roll against the target.

de2a3510-8e97-5268-915b-44384b78c864.name: Skilled
de2a3510-8e97-5268-915b-44384b78c864.description: You gain proficiency with three skills or tools of your choice.

player_choices.label: Skill or Tool
player_choices.prompt: Pick three — any combination of skills and tools.

attributes.benefits:
You gain proficiency in any combination of three skills or tools of your choice.

**Repeatable.** You can take this feat more than once.

7f38e931-831e-5436-b691-462778a79ca5.name: Ability Score Improvement
7f38e931-831e-5436-b691-462778a79ca5.description: Increase one ability score by 2 or two ability scores by 1 (max 20).

attributes.benefits:
Increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. This feat can't increase an ability score above 20.

**Repeatable.** You can take this feat more than once.

31ef9255-e1ce-5a2f-a5b2-cdc238a9b13c.name: Grappler
31ef9255-e1ce-5a2f-a5b2-cdc238a9b13c.description: Your Unarmed Strikes can both damage and grapple, with Advantage on attacks against creatures you've grappled.

attributes.benefits:
You gain the following benefits.

**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

**Punch and Grab.** When you hit a creature with an Unarmed Strike as part of the Attack action on your turn, you can use both the Damage and the Grapple option. You can use this benefit only once per turn.

**Attack Advantage.** You have Advantage on attack rolls against a creature Grappled by you.

**Fast Wrestler.** You don't have to spend extra movement to move a creature Grappled by you if the creature is your size or smaller.

b23361cd-bba3-55cb-9007-8f4ac3778f0b.name: Archery
b23361cd-bba3-55cb-9007-8f4ac3778f0b.description: +2 to attack rolls with Ranged weapons.

attributes.benefits: You gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls you make with Ranged weapons.

attributes.mechanical_notes: Only while wearing Light, Medium, or Heavy armor
attributes.benefits: While you're wearing Light, Medium, or Heavy armor, you gain a +1 bonus to Armor Class.

18268050-91e4-5ae7-bb27-1450fe287225.name: Great Weapon Fighting
18268050-91e4-5ae7-bb27-1450fe287225.description: Treat 1s and 2s on damage dice as 3s when wielding a two-handed melee weapon.

attributes.benefits: When you roll damage for an attack you make with a Melee weapon that you are holding with two hands, you can treat any 1 or 2 on a damage die as a 3. The weapon must have the Two-Handed or Versatile property to gain this benefit.

5e6cd264-c2f8-57fe-9d3e-c82c94b9b18e.name: Two-Weapon Fighting
5e6cd264-c2f8-57fe-9d3e-c82c94b9b18e.description: Add your ability modifier to the damage of the off-hand attack.

attributes.benefits: When you make an extra attack as a result of using a weapon that has the Light property, you can add your ability modifier to the damage of that attack if you aren't already adding it to the damage.

37b48e1e-859b-5062-aaa8-e106a695a65c.name: Boon of Combat Prowess
37b48e1e-859b-5062-aaa8-e106a695a65c.description: Once per turn convert a missed attack into a hit.

attributes.benefits:
You gain the following benefits.

**Ability Score Increase.** Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 30.

**Peerless Aim.** When you miss with an attack roll, you can hit instead. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until the start of your next turn.

9921406f-3a9b-50d7-bc22-84ccca5a146c.name: Boon of Dimensional Travel
9921406f-3a9b-50d7-bc22-84ccca5a146c.description: After Attack or Magic action, teleport up to 30 feet.

attributes.benefits:
You gain the following benefits.

**Ability Score Increase.** Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 30.

**Blink Steps.** Immediately after you take the Attack action or the Magic action, you can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

93a5a2ba-ec17-58f1-9512-5b297305d5d3.name: Boon of Fate
93a5a2ba-ec17-58f1-9512-5b297305d5d3.description: Roll 2d4 to alter the result of a D20 Test you witness.

attributes.benefits:
You gain the following benefits.

**Ability Score Increase.** Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 30.

**Improve Fate.** When you or another creature within 60 feet of you succeeds on or fails a D20 Test, you can roll 2d4 and apply the total rolled as a bonus or penalty to the d20 roll. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you roll Initiative or finish a Short or Long Rest.

9f457e65-1b38-5d76-b4a5-d935b935cb2c.name: Boon of Irresistible Offense
9f457e65-1b38-5d76-b4a5-d935b935cb2c.description: Damage ignores Resistance; crits deal extra damage equal to the boosted ability score.

attributes.benefits:
You gain the following benefits.

**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 30.

**Overcome Defenses.** The Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage you deal always ignores Resistance.

**Overwhelming Strike.** When you roll a 20 on the d20 for an attack roll, you can deal extra damage to the target equal to the ability score increased by this feat. The extra damage's type is the same as the attack's type.

2b7b484b-9a46-5da3-9c25-c6c27e46bbbb.name: Boon of Spell Recall
2b7b484b-9a46-5da3-9c25-c6c27e46bbbb.description: Roll 1d4 each spell cast with a level 1–4 slot; on a match the slot isn't expended.

attributes.benefits:
You gain the following benefits.

**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 30.

**Free Casting.** Whenever you cast a spell with a level 1–4 spell slot, roll 1d4. If the number you roll is the same as the slot's level, the slot isn't expended.

3d59a205-f2b2-5a34-ad16-bb258e9801c0.name: Boon of the Night Spirit
3d59a205-f2b2-5a34-ad16-bb258e9801c0.description: Become Invisible in dim light or darkness and take Resistance to most damage.

attributes.mechanical_notes: While in Dim Light or Darkness: Resistance to all damage except Psychic and Radiant
attributes.benefits:
You gain the following benefits.

**Ability Score Increase.** Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 30.

**Merge with Shadows.** While within Dim Light or Darkness, you can give yourself the Invisible condition as a Bonus Action. The condition ends on you immediately after you take an action, a Bonus Action, or a Reaction.

**Shadowy Form.** While within Dim Light or Darkness, you have Resistance to all damage except Psychic and Radiant.

You gain the following benefits.

**Ability Score Increase.** Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 30.

**Truesight.** You have Truesight with a range of 60 feet.

5701a8bf-9c33-5811-8b7a-1e34ff64c414.name: Crafter
5701a8bf-9c33-5811-8b7a-1e34ff64c414.description: You gain proficiency with three Artisan's Tools and craft items more efficiently.

attributes.benefits:
**Tool Proficiency.** You gain proficiency with three different Artisan's Tools of your choice.

**Discount.** Whenever you buy a nonmagical item, you receive a 20% discount.

**Faster Crafting.** Whenever you craft a nonmagical item, you can do so in only a fifth of the normal crafting time.

595a8096-71ef-52b5-8d2c-1bc9841d6775.name: Healer
595a8096-71ef-52b5-8d2c-1bc9841d6775.description: You can stabilize and heal others with great efficiency, restoring HP with a use of a Healer's Kit.

attributes.benefits:
**Battle Medic.** If you have a Healer's Kit, you can take a Utilize action to expend one of its uses and tend to a creature within 5 feet of you. That creature can spend one of its Hit Point Dice, and you then roll that die. The creature regains a number of HP equal to the roll plus your Proficiency Bonus.

**Healing Surge.** Once per turn when you roll a 1 on a Hit Point Die you spent during a Short or Long Rest, you can re-roll the die and use the higher result.

b2f8ee5a-57a0-5373-8767-159c221918af.name: Lucky
b2f8ee5a-57a0-5373-8767-159c221918af.description: You have a knack for being in the right place. You can spend Luck Points to alter d20 Tests.

attributes.benefits:
**Luck Points.** You have a number of Luck Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended Luck Points when you finish a Long Rest.

**Advantage.** You can spend a Luck Point when you make a d20 Test (attack roll, ability check, or saving throw); you have Advantage on the roll.

**Disadvantage on Attacker.** When another creature rolls an attack roll against you, you can spend a Luck Point to give them Disadvantage.

751e7238-ab30-5f2b-abb9-9f46afe65725.name: Musician
751e7238-ab30-5f2b-abb9-9f46afe65725.description: You can inspire allies with music, granting Bardic-like inspiration once per Long Rest.

attributes.benefits:
**Tool Proficiency.** You gain proficiency with three musical instruments of your choice.

**Encouraging Song.** As you finish a Short or Long Rest, you can play a song on a musical instrument with which you have proficiency and give Heroic Inspiration to allies who hear the song. The number of allies you can affect equals your Proficiency Bonus.

3cff77c1-9b89-5287-baf9-26f4ff33047b.name: Tavern Brawler
3cff77c1-9b89-5287-baf9-26f4ff33047b.description: You learned to fight with whatever's at hand — chairs, mugs, fists.

player_choices.label: Ability Score Increase
player_choices.prompt: Pick which score to raise by +1.

attributes.benefits:
**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Strength or Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

**Enhanced Unarmed Strike.** When you hit with your Unarmed Strike, you can deal Bludgeoning damage equal to 1d4 + your Strength modifier instead of normal damage.

**Damaging Improvisation.** You are proficient with Improvised Weapons.

**Push.** When you hit a creature with an Unarmed Strike as part of the Attack action on your turn, you can deal damage to the target and also push it 5 feet from you.
Your Hit Point maximum increases by an amount equal to twice your character level when you choose this feat. Whenever you gain a level thereafter, your HP maximum increases by an additional 2.

8ff49932-b15e-50f9-9671-18e79fe5c633.name: Athlete
8ff49932-b15e-50f9-9671-18e79fe5c633.description: You hone your physique. Climbing and jumping become trivial.

attributes.benefits:
**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

**Climbing.** Climbing doesn't cost you extra movement.

**Jumping.** You can make a running long jump or a running high jump after moving only 5 feet on foot rather than 10 feet.

**Standing Up.** Standing up from Prone uses only 5 feet of your movement rather than half your Speed.

f7fd22db-036d-5d0d-a7a7-65cd5dc0b422.name: Charger
f7fd22db-036d-5d0d-a7a7-65cd5dc0b422.description: You can charge into battle and shove or strike at the end.

attributes.benefits: **Charge.** When you take the Attack action, you can replace one of the attacks with a special melee attack made after you move at least 10 feet straight toward a target. If your attack hits, the target takes an extra 2d8 damage of the attack's type, and you can push it up to 10 feet away from you.

39bced27-186f-5cfc-8a67-506067fc94f0.name: Crossbow Expert
39bced27-186f-5cfc-8a67-506067fc94f0.description: Master of the crossbow, ignoring loading and gaining bonus shots.

attributes.benefits:
**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

**Ignore Loading.** You ignore the Loading property of crossbows with which you are proficient.

**Firing in Melee.** Being within 5 feet of an enemy doesn't impose Disadvantage on your ranged attack rolls with crossbows you are proficient with.

**Bonus Crossbow Attack.** When you take the Attack action and attack with a one-handed weapon, you can use a Bonus Action to make a single attack with a Hand Crossbow you are holding.

8c4e2e24-a120-569e-ad17-82ea228e93b4.name: Defensive Duelist
8c4e2e24-a120-569e-ad17-82ea228e93b4.description: When wielding a Finesse weapon, you can deflect attacks.

attributes.benefits:
**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

**Parry.** When you're wielding a Finesse weapon and another creature hits you with a melee attack roll, you can take a Reaction to add your Proficiency Bonus to your AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss you.

693bca21-549a-5200-af1e-fba9d63c98c9.name: Dual Wielder
693bca21-549a-5200-af1e-fba9d63c98c9.description: You wield two weapons with skill, gaining AC and bonus attacks.

attributes.benefits:
**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

**Bonus Attack.** When you take the Attack action and attack with a one-handed melee weapon that lacks the Two-Handed property, you can use a Bonus Action to make one melee attack with a different weapon you're holding (the second weapon doesn't need the Light property).

**Drawing Weapons.** You can draw or stow two one-handed weapons when you would normally be able to draw or stow only one.

**Enhanced Defense.** While you are holding a separate melee weapon in each hand, you gain a +1 bonus to AC.

**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

**Defy Death.** You have Advantage on Death Saves.

**Speedy Recovery.** As a Bonus Action, you can expend one of your Hit Point Dice, roll the die, and regain HP equal to the roll plus your Constitution modifier (minimum of 1 HP). Once you use this benefit, you can't do so again until you finish a Short or Long Rest.

d670d11c-ca23-529b-b262-07aecc29be01.name: Elemental Adept
d670d11c-ca23-529b-b262-07aecc29be01.description: You overcome resistance to one damage type and ignore zeroes.

attributes.benefits:
**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

**Energy Mastery.** Choose one of the following damage types: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder. Spells you cast ignore Resistance to damage of the chosen type. In addition, when you roll damage for a spell you cast that deals damage of that type, you can treat any 1 on a damage die as a 2.

**Repeatable.** You can take this feat more than once, but you must choose a different damage type each time.

7fd86fa5-af35-5e6d-88f0-1d7deaf07e8e.name: Fey-Touched
7fd86fa5-af35-5e6d-88f0-1d7deaf07e8e.description: You gain Misty Step and another Divination or Enchantment spell.

attributes.benefits:
**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

**Magical Gift.** You learn the Misty Step spell and one level 1 spell of your choice from the Divination or Enchantment school of magic. You can cast each of these spells without expending a spell slot once per Long Rest. You can also cast these spells using spell slots you have. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells (choose when you take the feat).

7118cd24-8910-5eb4-893e-095f090b0428.name: Great Weapon Master
7118cd24-8910-5eb4-893e-095f090b0428.description: You wield heavy weapons with deadly skill.

attributes.benefits:
**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Strength score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

**Cleaving Strike.** Once on each of your turns when you score a Critical Hit with a melee weapon or reduce a creature to 0 HP with one, you can use a Bonus Action to make one melee weapon attack.

**Heavy Hitter.** Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with an attack using a Heavy weapon, you can deal an extra 1d12 damage of the same type as the weapon's damage.

ca5169eb-a28c-56bc-a01d-98db70a59d0e.name: Heavy Armor Master
ca5169eb-a28c-56bc-a01d-98db70a59d0e.description: You can ignore some damage while wearing heavy armor.

attributes.benefits:
**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Strength score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

**Damage Resistance.** While you are wearing Heavy Armor and aren't Incapacitated, Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage that you take from nonmagical attacks is reduced by an amount equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

552daf26-cafd-55d2-b657-3fb1040a9c83.name: Inspiring Leader
552daf26-cafd-55d2-b657-3fb1040a9c83.description: You can inspire your allies with a stirring speech.

attributes.mechanical_notes: 10-minute speech: up to six creatures gain Temporary HP equal to your character level + CHA modifier (once per Long Rest per creature)
attributes.benefits:
**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

**Speech.** You can spend 10 minutes giving a stirring speech to up to six creatures within 30 feet who can hear and understand you. Each creature gains Temporary Hit Points equal to your character level + your Charisma modifier. A creature can't gain TempHP from this feat again until it has finished a Long Rest.

3f1ede24-d5c5-5997-a78d-9460913465d7.name: Keen Mind
3f1ede24-d5c5-5997-a78d-9460913465d7.description: Your memory and reasoning are sharp.

attributes.benefits:
**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Intelligence score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

**Perfect Recall.** You can perfectly remember anything you've experienced or read in the past month. Whenever you make an Intelligence check that involves remembering something, you can add your Proficiency Bonus to the roll if you wouldn't already.

**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

**Armor Training.** You gain training with Light Armor.

7075f554-09ca-50cf-abe9-af3e539fcac2.name: Mage Slayer
7075f554-09ca-50cf-abe9-af3e539fcac2.description: You strike with skill against spellcasters.

attributes.benefits:
**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

**Concentration Breaker.** When you damage a creature concentrating on a spell, the creature has Disadvantage on the saving throw it makes to maintain Concentration.

**Guarded Mind.** If you fail an Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma save, you can spend 10 feet of movement to reroll, using the new roll.

621fd4eb-c0ab-5322-88cc-9b52ce869148.name: Martial Adept
621fd4eb-c0ab-5322-88cc-9b52ce869148.description: You learn Maneuvers from Battle Master fighters.

attributes.benefits:
**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

**Maneuvers.** You learn two Maneuvers of your choice from those available to the Battle Master. If a Maneuver requires a save, the DC equals 8 + your Proficiency Bonus + your Strength or Dex modifier (your choice).

**Superiority Die.** You gain one Superiority Die (a d6). It is expended when you use it. You regain it when you finish a Short or Long Rest.

502ee3df-cfca-50bd-8cfa-d0005b92d464.name: Medium Armor Master
502ee3df-cfca-50bd-8cfa-d0005b92d464.description: You wear medium armor with finesse.

attributes.benefits:
**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

**Stealth Bonus.** Wearing Medium Armor doesn't impose Disadvantage on your Dex (Stealth) checks.

**Dexterity Bonus.** When you wear Medium Armor, you can add 3, rather than 2, to your AC if your Dex is 16+.

6cc421d6-e6f6-59c0-a68f-50a19a65c653.name: Mobile
6cc421d6-e6f6-59c0-a68f-50a19a65c653.description: You are exceptionally swift and agile.

attributes.benefits:
**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Dexterity or Strength score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

**Nimble.** Your Speed increases by 10 feet.

**Dash Across Difficult Terrain.** When you take the Dash action, Difficult Terrain doesn't cost you extra movement on that turn.

**Avoid Opportunity Attacks.** When you make a melee attack against a creature, you don't provoke Opportunity Attacks from that creature for the rest of the turn.

619284f6-69a9-5509-a72d-9d5ed5e40f42.name: Moderately Armored
619284f6-69a9-5509-a72d-9d5ed5e40f42.description: You gain Medium Armor and Shield training.

attributes.benefits:
**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

**Armor Training.** You gain training with Medium Armor and Shields.

3d152599-655b-5b60-9730-b625461106a3.name: Mounted Combatant
3d152599-655b-5b60-9730-b625461106a3.description: You are a mounted warrior par excellence.

attributes.benefits:
**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Strength, Dexterity, or Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

**Mounted Strike.** You have Advantage on melee attack rolls against an unmounted creature smaller than your mount.

**Veer.** As a Reaction when your mount is targeted by an attack while you are riding it, you can swap targets with the mount.

**Leap Aside.** If your mount is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dex save for half damage, it instead takes no damage on a success and only half on a failure.

**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Intelligence or Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

**Quick Search.** You can take the Search action as a Bonus Action.

**Lipreading.** If you can see a creature's mouth while it is speaking a language you understand, you can interpret what it's saying.

**Passive Bonuses.** You gain a +5 bonus to your Passive Perception and Passive Investigation.

6a59fb4c-5cb7-5f50-87e5-7dc8f1515f50.name: Polearm Master
6a59fb4c-5cb7-5f50-87e5-7dc8f1515f50.description: You wield polearms with deadly precision.

attributes.benefits:
**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

**Bonus Attack.** When you take the Attack action and attack with only a Glaive, Halberd, Pike, or Quarterstaff, you can use a Bonus Action to make a melee attack with the opposite end (deals 1d4 Bludgeoning damage).

**Reaction Strike.** While wielding a Glaive, Halberd, Pike, or Quarterstaff, you can take an Opportunity Attack when a creature enters your reach.

c26b4728-4534-5082-877d-12f7c7def7d3.name: Resilient
c26b4728-4534-5082-877d-12f7c7def7d3.description: You gain proficiency in saves with one ability.

attributes.benefits:
**Ability Score Increase.** Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 20.

**Save Proficiency.** You gain proficiency in saving throws made with the chosen ability.

**Repeatable.** You can take this feat more than once, but you must choose a different ability each time.

0055b218-6498-523b-a92c-38929398e183.name: Ritual Caster
0055b218-6498-523b-a92c-38929398e183.description: You learn rituals from any class.

attributes.benefits:
**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Intelligence or Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

**Ritual Book.** You have a Ritual Book holding two level 1 spells with the Ritual tag. Choose any class's spell list. The chosen ability is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

**Adding Rituals to the Book.** When you find a spell with the Ritual tag, you can add it to your book if its level is no more than half your character level (rounded up) and you spend 2 hours and 50 GP per level of the spell to copy it.

fa2e9af0-5180-52de-99e7-794c2e02cceb.name: Sentinel
fa2e9af0-5180-52de-99e7-794c2e02cceb.description: You guard your allies with martial precision.

attributes.benefits:
**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

**Stop the Foe.** When you hit a creature with an Opportunity Attack, the creature's Speed becomes 0 for the rest of the turn.

**Bonus Opportunity Attacks.** Creatures provoke Opportunity Attacks from you even if they take the Disengage action before leaving your reach.

**Distract the Foe.** When a creature within 5 feet of you makes an attack against a target other than you (and that target doesn't have this feat), you can use your Reaction to make a melee weapon attack against the attacker.

91376b05-7e5a-5452-bec1-9d0b8ca9c105.name: Shadow-Touched
91376b05-7e5a-5452-bec1-9d0b8ca9c105.description: You gain Invisibility and a level 1 Illusion or Necromancy spell.

attributes.benefits:
**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

**Magical Gift.** You learn the Invisibility spell and one level 1 spell of your choice from the Illusion or Necromancy school. You can cast each of these spells without expending a spell slot once per Long Rest. You can also cast these spells using spell slots you have.

4e6bed8e-0e11-5af0-9633-a4820cc7b73b.name: Sharpshooter
4e6bed8e-0e11-5af0-9633-a4820cc7b73b.description: You are deadly with ranged weapons.

attributes.benefits:
**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

**Long Range.** Attacking at long range doesn't impose Disadvantage on your ranged weapon attacks.

**Cover.** Your ranged weapon attacks ignore Half Cover and Three-Quarters Cover.

**Bullseye.** Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with a ranged weapon attack, you can deal an extra 1d10 damage.

1e1513b3-d64e-568f-9bf9-4d67e1fe1af0.name: Shield Master
1e1513b3-d64e-568f-9bf9-4d67e1fe1af0.description: You wield a Shield with skill, gaining bonus actions and reactions.

attributes.benefits:
**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Strength score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

**Shield Bash.** If you take the Attack action on your turn and are holding a Shield, you can use a Bonus Action to try to shove a creature within 5 feet of you with the Shield. The target must succeed on a Strength save or take 2d4 Bludgeoning damage and have the Prone condition, your choice.

**Interpose Shield.** If you are subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Dex save to take only half damage, you can use your Reaction to take no damage if you succeed on the save and only half on a failure, provided you are wielding a Shield.

**Ability Score Increase.** Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 20.

**Skill Proficiency.** You gain proficiency in one skill of your choice.

**Expertise.** Choose one skill in which you have proficiency but lack Expertise. You gain Expertise with that skill.

07127c14-bf5c-5571-b176-c9e0cac5d2fb.name: Spell Sniper
07127c14-bf5c-5571-b176-c9e0cac5d2fb.description: You strike with magical precision at range.

attributes.benefits:
**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

**Spell Range.** When you cast a spell that requires you to make an attack roll, the spell's range is doubled.

**Cover.** Your ranged spell attacks ignore Half Cover and Three-Quarters Cover.

**Cantrip.** You learn one cantrip that requires an attack roll. Choose the cantrip from the spell list of any class.

c2435b71-5233-525b-88db-20a07fb84a9c.name: Telekinetic
c2435b71-5233-525b-88db-20a07fb84a9c.description: You move objects with your mind.

attributes.benefits:
**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

**Cantrip.** You learn the Mage Hand cantrip, except it is invisible and the hand has a range of 30 feet.

**Telekinetic Shove.** As a Bonus Action, you can try to telekinetically shove one creature within 30 feet of you. The target must succeed on a Strength save or be moved 5 feet toward you or away from you.

**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

**Telepathic Speech.** You can speak telepathically to any creature you can see within 60 feet. You don't need to share a language with the creature for it to understand.

**Detect Thoughts.** You can cast Detect Thoughts once per Long Rest without expending a spell slot.

75fc5546-c464-5f6e-b859-418d586d9f03.name: War Caster
75fc5546-c464-5f6e-b859-418d586d9f03.description: You've practiced casting in the chaos of battle.

attributes.benefits:
**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

**Concentration.** You have Advantage on saving throws to maintain Concentration.

**Reactive Spell.** When a creature provokes an Opportunity Attack from you, you can take that Reaction to cast a spell at the creature rather than make a melee attack. The spell must have a casting time of Action and target only that creature.

6fef5998-fd13-5166-af74-f3e5849478b8.name: Weapon Master
6fef5998-fd13-5166-af74-f3e5849478b8.description: You hone proficiency with several weapons.

attributes.benefits:
**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

**Weapon Training.** You gain proficiency with four weapons of your choice.

You have Blindsight with a range of 10 feet. Within that range, you can effectively see anything that isn't behind Total Cover, even if you have the Blinded condition or are in Darkness. Moreover, in that range you can see a creature that is Invisible.

8c587c03-4a4b-562c-92bb-504fd82a7747.name: Dueling
8c587c03-4a4b-562c-92bb-504fd82a7747.description: You wield a one-handed weapon with finesse.

attributes.benefits: When you are wielding a melee weapon in one hand and no other weapons, you gain a +2 bonus to damage rolls with that weapon.

70dea8ec-cf2c-5070-9db9-01632f1a7d78.name: Interception
70dea8ec-cf2c-5070-9db9-01632f1a7d78.description: You protect allies from incoming attacks.

attributes.benefits: When a creature you can see hits a target, other than you, within 5 feet of you with an attack roll, you can use your Reaction to reduce the damage the target takes by 1d10 + your Proficiency Bonus (to a minimum of 0 damage). You must be wielding a Shield or a Simple or Martial weapon to use this Reaction.

da56f0a7-0734-5966-9676-5aafa8dfe6de.name: Protection
da56f0a7-0734-5966-9676-5aafa8dfe6de.description: You impose Disadvantage on attacks against allies.

attributes.benefits: When a creature you can see attacks a target other than you that is within 5 feet of you, you can use your Reaction to impose Disadvantage on the attack roll. You must be wielding a Shield.

11887040-d1d4-5cd7-a8fe-fc13e65dc2b6.name: Thrown Weapon Fighting
11887040-d1d4-5cd7-a8fe-fc13e65dc2b6.description: You hurl weapons with deadly skill.

attributes.benefits: You can draw a weapon that has the Thrown property as part of the attack you make with the weapon. In addition, when you hit with a ranged attack using a Thrown weapon, you gain a +2 bonus to the damage roll.

b9060075-6301-512e-b877-12a6c4eb8165.name: Unarmed Fighting
b9060075-6301-512e-b877-12a6c4eb8165.description: Your unarmed strikes deal more damage.

attributes.benefits: Your Unarmed Strikes use a d6 for damage. The d6 becomes a d8 if you hit with the Unarmed Strike and aren't wielding any weapons or a Shield. When you Grapple a creature with your Unarmed Strike, you can deal Bludgeoning damage to the Grappled target equal to your Strength modifier.

6362734e-d090-563e-9fdd-12023e74be30.name: Rage
6362734e-d090-563e-9fdd-12023e74be30.description: You can imbue yourself with primal power as a Bonus Action while not in Heavy armor.

attributes.mechanical_notes:
Advantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws
Strength-based melee attacks deal +2 damage (+3 at L9, +4 at L16)
Can't cast spells or maintain Concentration
attributes.benefits:
**Bonus Action.** Activate Rage as a Bonus Action; you must not be wearing Heavy armor.

**Damage Resistance.** While raging you have Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.

**Strength Advantage.** Advantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws while raging.

**Rage Damage.** When you make a Strength-based melee weapon attack, gain a damage bonus that scales with your Barbarian level (+2 at L1, +3 at L9, +4 at L16).

**No Spells.** While raging you can't cast spells or maintain Concentration.

**Duration.** Lasts up to 10 minutes; ends if you don't attack or take damage on your turn, you fall Unconscious, or you don Heavy armor.

**Uses.** Per Long Rest: 2 (L1), 3 (L3), 4 (L6), 5 (L12), 6 (L17), unlimited (L20).

a87ee88c-87f1-51fe-91d1-79ee7e8964f3.name: Unarmored Defense (Barbarian)
a87ee88c-87f1-51fe-91d1-79ee7e8964f3.description: While not wearing armor, your AC equals 10 + Dex mod + Con mod. Shield allowed.

attributes.benefits: While not wearing armor, your AC equals 10 + Dex mod + Con mod. Shield allowed.

42c23252-5af9-50b0-947b-47e2d688e7bb.name: Weapon Mastery (Barbarian)
42c23252-5af9-50b0-947b-47e2d688e7bb.description: You can use the mastery property of two kinds of Simple or Martial Melee weapons; swap one on each Long Rest.

attributes.benefits: You can use the mastery property of two kinds of Simple or Martial Melee weapons; swap one on each Long Rest.

8b9a6bff-e1b6-53b8-90a4-492934198e29.name: Danger Sense
8b9a6bff-e1b6-53b8-90a4-492934198e29.description: You have Advantage on Dexterity saving throws unless you have the Incapacitated condition.

attributes.mechanical_notes: Advantage on Dexterity saving throws unless Incapacitated
attributes.benefits: You have Advantage on Dexterity saving throws unless you have the Incapacitated condition.

e368e3ec-869c-556b-b4d2-c64906e8a6f4.name: Reckless Attack
e368e3ec-869c-556b-b4d2-c64906e8a6f4.description: On your turn you can attack recklessly: gain Advantage on Strength-based melee attack rolls until your next turn, but attack rolls against you also have Advantage.

attributes.mechanical_notes: While attacking recklessly: Advantage on Strength-based melee attack rolls, and attack rolls against you have Advantage until your next turn
attributes.benefits: On your turn you can attack recklessly: gain Advantage on Strength-based melee attack rolls until your next turn, but attack rolls against you also have Advantage.

33d4a8bc-0c31-5e68-9913-5bcfdf2fcb5b.name: Primal Knowledge
33d4a8bc-0c31-5e68-9913-5bcfdf2fcb5b.description: You gain proficiency in another skill of your choice from the Barbarian list. While raging you can substitute Strength for the ability score normally used to make checks with that skill.

attributes.mechanical_notes: While raging, you can make checks with that skill using Strength
attributes.benefits: You gain proficiency in another skill of your choice from the Barbarian list. While raging you can substitute Strength for the ability score normally used to make checks with that skill.

258ad8fa-7596-5218-8f94-302de148a30d.name: Extra Attack (Barbarian)
258ad8fa-7596-5218-8f94-302de148a30d.description: You can attack twice when you take the Attack action.

attributes.benefits: You can attack twice when you take the Attack action.

9b5954a4-2371-5443-9ecb-e8454a1be8ea.name: Fast Movement
9b5954a4-2371-5443-9ecb-e8454a1be8ea.description: Your Speed increases by 10 feet while you aren't wearing Heavy armor.

attributes.mechanical_notes: Only while not wearing Heavy armor
attributes.benefits: Your Speed increases by 10 feet while you aren't wearing Heavy armor.

9a4cc286-581a-5381-8430-f192ba677bc8.name: Feral Instinct
9a4cc286-581a-5381-8430-f192ba677bc8.description: You have Advantage on Initiative rolls.

attributes.mechanical_notes: Advantage on Initiative rolls
attributes.benefits: You have Advantage on Initiative rolls.

31cdcd7f-cccf-5792-98cf-9de25356fcd3.name: Instinctive Pounce
31cdcd7f-cccf-5792-98cf-9de25356fcd3.description: As part of the Bonus Action you take to enter your Rage, you can move up to half your Speed.

attributes.benefits: As part of the Bonus Action you take to enter your Rage, you can move up to half your Speed.

898bc4c0-f1a2-533a-9ebb-e87777f4e4c8.name: Brutal Strike
898bc4c0-f1a2-533a-9ebb-e87777f4e4c8.description: When you Reckless Attack, you can forgo Advantage to deal +1d10 damage and apply one Brutal Strike effect (Forceful Blow / Hamstring Blow).

attributes.mechanical_notes: When you Reckless Attack, you can forgo Advantage to deal +1d10 damage and apply one Brutal Strike effect
attributes.benefits: When you Reckless Attack, you can forgo Advantage to deal +1d10 damage and apply one Brutal Strike effect (Forceful Blow / Hamstring Blow).

a94a0b6f-5976-5d98-aa26-c76248378079.name: Relentless Rage
a94a0b6f-5976-5d98-aa26-c76248378079.description: When you would drop to 0 HP while raging and aren't killed outright, you can make a Constitution save (DC 10, +5 per use this rest); on success you drop to 1 HP instead.

attributes.benefits: When you would drop to 0 HP while raging and aren't killed outright, you can make a Constitution save (DC 10, +5 per use this rest); on success you drop to 1 HP instead.

38bfa67d-48fb-57e5-8a02-e11d5775b003.name: Improved Brutal Strike
38bfa67d-48fb-57e5-8a02-e11d5775b003.description: Add Staggering Blow and Sundering Blow to the list of Brutal Strike effects.

attributes.benefits: Add Staggering Blow and Sundering Blow to the list of Brutal Strike effects.

300740cd-5101-55a9-9c9d-82a0381c11b8.name: Persistent Rage
300740cd-5101-55a9-9c9d-82a0381c11b8.description: Your Rage lasts 10 minutes without needing to attack or take damage to extend it. When you roll Initiative, regain all expended Rage uses (1/Long Rest).

attributes.benefits: Your Rage lasts 10 minutes without needing to attack or take damage to extend it. When you roll Initiative, regain all expended Rage uses (1/Long Rest).

c8fdcf8f-1ec3-5dbd-90f9-c29f80661216.name: Improved Brutal Strike (II)
c8fdcf8f-1ec3-5dbd-90f9-c29f80661216.description: Brutal Strike's damage die increases to 2d10, and you can apply two Brutal Strike effects per use.

attributes.mechanical_notes: Brutal Strike's damage die increases to 2d10; apply two Brutal Strike effects per use
attributes.benefits: Brutal Strike's damage die increases to 2d10, and you can apply two Brutal Strike effects per use.

bd7494c9-d340-5455-ad7c-be25892f1c89.name: Indomitable Might
bd7494c9-d340-5455-ad7c-be25892f1c89.description: When you make a Strength check or Strength save, treat any roll lower than your Strength score as if it were equal to your Strength score.

attributes.benefits: When you make a Strength check or Strength save, treat any roll lower than your Strength score as if it were equal to your Strength score.

9999d04a-556f-50bb-b7cf-d52716a4bb01.name: Primal Champion
9999d04a-556f-50bb-b7cf-d52716a4bb01.description: Your Strength and Constitution increase by 4. Your maximum for those scores becomes 25.

attributes.benefits: Your Strength and Constitution increase by 4. Your maximum for those scores becomes 25.

542d9743-f1ea-5746-99b0-ce4ed384177c.name: Bardic Inspiration
542d9743-f1ea-5746-99b0-ce4ed384177c.description: As a Bonus Action, you can grant a creature within 60 feet (other than yourself) a Bardic Inspiration die — initially d6, increasing with level. Within 10 minutes the recipient adds it to one ability check, attack roll, or saving throw.

attributes.benefits: As a Bonus Action, you can grant a creature within 60 feet (other than yourself) a Bardic Inspiration die — initially d6, increasing with level. Within 10 minutes the recipient adds it to one ability check, attack roll, or saving throw.

793bcac8-963b-53b7-968b-cb6692a41ce2.name: Bard Spellcasting
793bcac8-963b-53b7-968b-cb6692a41ce2.description: You know cantrips and spells from the Bard spell list. Charisma is your spellcasting ability. You can use a Musical Instrument or Bard Spellcasting Focus.

attributes.benefits: You know cantrips and spells from the Bard spell list. Charisma is your spellcasting ability. You can use a Musical Instrument or Bard Spellcasting Focus.

84e44b10-49f9-528d-a041-272026ea7ce1.name: Expertise (Bard)
84e44b10-49f9-528d-a041-272026ea7ce1.description: Choose two skills with which you have Proficiency. Your Proficiency Bonus is doubled for any check you make with those skills.

attributes.benefits: Choose two skills with which you have Proficiency. Your Proficiency Bonus is doubled for any check you make with those skills.

4cf038e7-57e0-5791-956a-53b4d5a76586.name: Jack of All Trades
4cf038e7-57e0-5791-956a-53b4d5a76586.description: You can add half your Proficiency Bonus (rounded down) to any ability check you make that uses a skill in which you lack Proficiency.

attributes.mechanical_notes: Add half your Proficiency Bonus (round down) to ability checks using skills you lack proficiency in
attributes.benefits: You can add half your Proficiency Bonus (rounded down) to any ability check you make that uses a skill in which you lack Proficiency.

8a0f1fed-310c-5624-b6ee-ffc494f765a2.name: Font of Inspiration
8a0f1fed-310c-5624-b6ee-ffc494f765a2.description: Your Bardic Inspiration die is now a d8. You also regain expended uses on a Short Rest.

attributes.benefits: Your Bardic Inspiration die is now a d8. You also regain expended uses on a Short Rest.

17f79eb0-271c-5f27-b44c-bc9598b1035a.name: Countercharm
17f79eb0-271c-5f27-b44c-bc9598b1035a.description: When you or a creature within 30 feet that you can see fails a save vs. being Charmed or Frightened, you can use a Reaction to allow the save to be rerolled with Advantage.

attributes.benefits: When you or a creature within 30 feet that you can see fails a save vs. being Charmed or Frightened, you can use a Reaction to allow the save to be rerolled with Advantage.

e4b6fe9a-8352-5983-9641-63b9144c53d1.name: Expertise (Bard II)
e4b6fe9a-8352-5983-9641-63b9144c53d1.description: Two more proficient skills gain Expertise.

attributes.benefits: Two more proficient skills gain Expertise.

904ef6ad-9c03-5698-9a12-0c46902b3c59.name: Magical Secrets
904ef6ad-9c03-5698-9a12-0c46902b3c59.description: When you reach this level and at later milestones, replace one Bard spell you know with any spell of the same level from any class's spell list.

attributes.benefits: When you reach this level and at later milestones, replace one Bard spell you know with any spell of the same level from any class's spell list.

f839d13b-e818-58e5-835d-521213973ada.name: Bardic Inspiration (d10)
f839d13b-e818-58e5-835d-521213973ada.description: Your Bardic Inspiration die is now a d10.

attributes.benefits: Your Bardic Inspiration die is now a d10.

b0b731d7-82a3-58f8-93c4-8631d0227503.name: Words of Creation
b0b731d7-82a3-58f8-93c4-8631d0227503.description: You always have Power Word Heal and Power Word Kill prepared, and they can target two creatures rather than one.

7f79d51a-87d0-50fe-9350-b1b00affd22f.description: You return a dead creature you touch to life, provided that it has been dead no longer than 10 days. The creature returns to life with 1 HP. The spell takes –4 to all D20 Tests for 4 days; this penalty reduces by 1 each Long Rest.

**Higher-Level Slot.** +3d6 per slot level above 6.

104c00d3-e355-54e6-b9fd-e7f8e76cd80f.description: You briefly stop time for everyone but yourself. Take 1d4+1 turns in a row. The spell ends if any action you take during this period — or any effect you create — affects a creature other than yourself or an object being worn or carried by someone other than you, or you move more than 1,000 feet from the location where you cast it.

c6a05f22-fa8c-5ede-a1d6-fed00c529c1e.name: Wish
c6a05f22-fa8c-5ede-a1d6-fed00c529c1e.description: The mightiest spell. By stating aloud what you wish for, you can alter the very foundations of reality. The basic use is to duplicate any other spell of level 8 or lower (without needing to meet that spell's requirements). Alternatively choose from one of these effects: heal up to 20 creatures of all HP, conditions, exhaustion, etc.; grant up to 10 creatures Resistance to a damage type for 8 hours; grant 10 creatures Immunity to a single spell or magical effect for 8 hours; undo a single recent event by forcing a reroll. Other wishes have unpredictable consequences and may require Constitution rolls; once cast for a non-spell-duplication wish, you can't cast Wish again for 1d4 days and you take 1d10 Necrotic damage per spell level for each spell you cast for the next 8 hours.

3c12ecdd-151a-5483-9682-68270094ba68.name: Identify

You touch an object. If it is a magic item or some other magic-imbued object, you learn its properties and how to use them, whether it requires Attunement, and how many charges it has, if any. You learn whether any ongoing spells are affecting the item and what they are.

If you instead touch a creature throughout the casting, you learn what spells, if any, are currently affecting it.

8196a03d-1bba-513d-9da4-24dbafbc0fbe.description: You make yourself — including your clothing, armor, weapons, and other belongings on your person — look different until the spell ends or until you take a Magic action to dismiss it. The changes wrought by this spell fail to hold up to physical inspection — a creature can take a Study action to discern the disguise (DC = your spell save DC).

As a Bonus Action on your turn, you can move the weapon up to 20 feet and repeat the attack against a creature within 5 feet of it.

*Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.* The damage increases by 1d8 for every two spell slot levels above 2.

Casting a spell that includes a Verbal component is impossible there.

fb803886-0635-5cbe-8f11-56414c8e5f8f.description: Three illusory duplicates of yourself appear in your space. Until the spell ends, the duplicates move with you and mimic your actions. A duplicate's AC equals 10 + your Dex modifier. The spell ends when all three duplicates are destroyed.

On a failed save, the creature has the Charmed and Incapacitated conditions and a Speed of 0 for the duration. The spell ends for an affected creature if it takes damage or someone uses an action to shake the creature out of its stupor.

If it casts a spell with Action or Bonus Action casting time, roll a d20; on an 11 or lower, the spell doesn't take effect until the target's next turn. A target makes a new save at the end of each of its turns to end the spell on itself.

Until the spell ends, the target's Speed is doubled, it gains a +2 bonus to AC, it has Advantage on Dex saves, and it gains an additional Action on each of its turns. That action can be used only to take the Attack (one weapon attack only), Dash, Disengage, Hide, or Utilize action. When the spell ends, the target can't move or take Actions until after its next turn, as a wave of lethargy sweeps over it.

66e16dad-bae4-5d19-893c-fcd9c13c6e87.name: Animate Dead
66e16dad-bae4-5d19-893c-fcd9c13c6e87.description:
Choose a pile of bones or a corpse of a Medium or Small Humanoid within range. The target becomes an Undead creature: a Skeleton if you chose bones or a Zombie if you chose a corpse. On each of your turns, you can take a Bonus Action to mentally command any creature you made with this spell within 60 feet. The creature is under your control for 24 hours, after which it stops obeying any command. To maintain control, recast the spell within the 24-hour period.

*Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.* You animate or reassert control over two additional Undead for each spell slot level above 3.

f67762ae-5111-5101-a534-0b247add769c.name: Daylight
f67762ae-5111-5101-a534-0b247add769c.description: A 60-foot-radius Sphere of light spreads out from a point you choose within range. The Sphere is Bright Light and sheds Dim Light for an additional 60 feet. If you chose a point on an object you are holding or one that isn't being worn or carried, the light shines from the object and moves with it. Completely covering the affected object blocks the light. If any of this spell's area overlaps with an area of Darkness created by a spell of level 3 or lower, that spell is dispelled.

5ef17ddb-0d4d-51ef-a74f-81d49378dcfe.name: Major Image
5ef17ddb-0d4d-51ef-a74f-81d49378dcfe.description:
You create the image of an object, a creature, or some other visible phenomenon that is no larger than a 20-foot Cube. The image appears at a spot you can see within range and lasts for the duration. It seems real, including sounds, smells, and temperature appropriate to the thing depicted. You can't create sufficient heat or cold to cause damage, a sound loud enough to deal Thunder damage or to deafen, or a smell that might sicken. Physical interaction with the image reveals it to be an illusion. A creature that takes a Study action can determine that it is an illusion (DC = your spell save DC). If a creature discerns the illusion for what it is, the creature can see through the image.

**Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.** The spell lasts until dispelled, without requiring Concentration, if cast with a level 4+ spell slot.

ec94213f-4233-5416-a176-5c7f79a650b8.name: Banishment
ec94213f-4233-5416-a176-5c7f79a650b8.description:
You attempt to send one creature that you can see within range to another plane of existence. The target must succeed on a Charisma save or be banished. If the target is native to the plane you're on, you banish it to a harmless demiplane where it is incapacitated; it returns at the end of the duration. If the target is native to a different plane, the target is banished there with no return for the duration; if the spell ends before 1 minute has passed, the target reappears in the space it left. Otherwise, the target doesn't return.

*Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.* You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 4.

0a945bfa-3df8-57ac-9bf8-ec306a570ea2.name: Wall of Fire
0a945bfa-3df8-57ac-9bf8-ec306a570ea2.description:
You create a wall of fire on a solid surface within range. You can make the wall up to 60 feet long, 20 feet high, and 1 foot thick, or a ringed wall up to 20 feet in diameter, 20 feet high, and 1 foot thick. The wall is opaque and lasts for the duration. When the wall appears, each creature in its area must make a Dex save: 5d8 Fire damage on a fail, half on a success. One side of the wall, selected by you, deals 5d8 Fire damage to each creature that ends its turn within 10 feet of that side or inside the wall. A creature takes the same damage when it enters the wall for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there. The other side deals no damage.

*Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.* The damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 4.

3f585eac-a584-590d-923f-673ebfe7fd67.name: Wall of Force
3f585eac-a584-590d-923f-673ebfe7fd67.description: An invisible wall of force springs into existence at a point you choose within range. The wall appears in any orientation: as a horizontal or vertical barrier or at an angle. It can be free-floating or resting on a solid surface. You can form the wall into a hemispherical dome or a Sphere with a radius of up to 10 feet, or you can shape a flat surface made up of ten 10-foot-square panels (must be contiguous). Each panel must be contiguous with another panel. In any form, the wall is 1/4 inch thick and lasts for the duration. If the wall cuts through a creature's space when it appears, the creature is pushed to one side of the wall. Nothing can physically pass through the wall. It is immune to all damage and can't be dispelled by Dispel Magic. A Disintegrate spell destroys the wall instantly.

bc808913-37f9-558f-803f-e33cb2b65df4.name: Telekinesis
bc808913-37f9-558f-803f-e33cb2b65df4.description:
You gain the ability to move or manipulate creatures or objects by thought. When you cast the spell, and as a Magic action while it lasts, you can exert your will on one creature or object that you can see within range, causing the appropriate effect below. You can affect the same target round after round, or choose a new one at any time. If you change targets, the prior target is no longer affected by the spell.

*Creature.* You can try to move a Huge or smaller creature. Make an ability check with your spellcasting ability contested by the creature's Strength check. If you win the contest, you move the creature up to 30 feet in any direction. Until the end of your next turn, the creature is Restrained.

*Object.* You can try to move an object weighing up to 1,000 pounds. If the object isn't being worn or carried, you automatically move it up to 30 feet in any direction. If the object is worn or carried, make an ability check contested by the wearer/wielder's Strength check.

The fog moves 10 feet away from you at the start of each of your turns.

*Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.* The damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 5.

*Cantrip Upgrade.* Damage increases by 1d8 at levels 5 (2d8), 11 (3d8), and 17 (4d8).

*Cantrip Upgrade.* The damage increases by 1d6 at levels 5 (2d6), 11 (3d6), and 17 (4d6).

Physical interaction with the image reveals it to be an illusion. A creature that takes a Study action can determine that it is an illusion (DC = your spell save DC).

113b7ea6-99f1-5aaa-96ad-0f9be07ea041.name: Detect Thoughts

If you choose a target held shut with Arcane Lock, that spell is suppressed for 10 minutes. When you cast the spell, a loud knock, audible from as far away as 300 feet, emanates from the target.

You touch a nonmagical weapon. Until the spell ends, that weapon becomes a magic weapon with a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls.

*Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.* The bonus increases to +2 with a level 4 spell slot, and to +3 with a level 6 spell slot.

51d2d4ac-fa7e-598b-b3a8-2396b8dc9c68.description: You touch a creature. If it is poisoned, you neutralize the poison. If more than one poison afflicts the target, you neutralize one poison that you know is present, or you neutralize one at random. For the duration, the target has Advantage on saves against being poisoned, and it has Resistance to Poison damage.

10b0a180-f7ac-58dc-860a-2d1d956df806.description: A black beam of enervating energy springs from your finger toward a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack. *Hit:* The target deals only half damage with weapon attacks that use Strength until the spell ends. At the end of each of the target's turns, it can make a Constitution save against the spell. On a success, the spell ends.

47581be8-4f0c-5a8d-b670-79b51638cdc4.name: Rope Trick
47581be8-4f0c-5a8d-b670-79b51638cdc4.description: You touch a length of rope that is up to 60 feet long. One end of the rope then rises into the air until the whole rope hangs perpendicular to the ground. At the upper end of the rope, an invisible entrance opens to an extradimensional space that lasts until the spell ends. The extradimensional space can be reached by climbing to the top of the rope. The space can hold as many as eight Medium or smaller creatures. The rope can be pulled into the space, making the rope disappear from view outside the space.

ecff54f0-88bd-51a8-a1e7-c6253e5f0f4e.description:
A loud ringing noise erupts from a point you choose within range. Each creature in a 10-foot-radius Sphere centered on that point must make a Con save: 3d8 Thunder damage on a fail, half on a success. A Construct has Disadvantage on the save. A nonmagical object that isn't worn or carried also takes the damage if it's in the spell's area.

*Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.* The damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 2.

5ac97c80-c0cf-5fec-b7ee-3b52ee9d6c94.name: Bestow Curse
5ac97c80-c0cf-5fec-b7ee-3b52ee9d6c94.description:
You touch a creature, which must succeed on a Wisdom save or become cursed for the duration. Choose one: target has Disadvantage on ability checks and saves with one chosen ability; target has Disadvantage on attack rolls against you; target must succeed on a Wisdom save at start of each turn or waste turn doing nothing; or your attacks and spells deal an extra 1d8 Necrotic damage to the target.

**Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.** If you cast this spell using a level 4 spell slot, you can maintain Concentration on it for up to 10 minutes. If you use a level 5+ spell slot, the spell doesn't require Concentration, and the duration becomes 8 hours (level 5–6 slot) or 24 hours (level 7–8 slot). If you use a level 9 spell slot, the spell lasts until dispelled.

93469f47-a691-5f6e-9211-12dc97b1b099.description: You create an invisible sensor within 1 mile of you in a location familiar to you (a place you have visited or seen) or in an obvious location that is unfamiliar to you. The sensor remains in place for the duration, and it can't be attacked. When you cast the spell, choose seeing or hearing. You can use the chosen sense through the sensor as if you were in its space. You can take a Magic action to switch between seeing and hearing.

93fda2fb-0f25-594b-baf9-6da9b375eafa.name: Create Food and Water
93fda2fb-0f25-594b-baf9-6da9b375eafa.description: You create 45 pounds of food and 30 gallons of water on the ground or in containers within range, enough to sustain up to 15 Humanoids or five steeds for 24 hours. The food is bland but nourishing and spoils if uneaten after 24 hours. The water is clean and doesn't go bad.

17fd47c4-d8d1-5fea-be3d-8c2cb836131b.name: Fear
17fd47c4-d8d1-5fea-be3d-8c2cb836131b.description: You project a phantasmal image of a creature's worst fears. Each creature in a 30-foot Cone must succeed on a Wisdom save or drop whatever it's holding and have the Frightened condition for the duration. While Frightened by this spell, a creature must take the Dash action and move away from you by the safest available route. If the creature ends its turn in a location where it doesn't have line of sight to you, the creature can make a Wisdom save. On a successful save, the spell ends for that creature.

c7cc9d29-029a-523a-836d-1124226db3e9.name: Gaseous Form
c7cc9d29-029a-523a-836d-1124226db3e9.description:
You transform a willing creature you touch, along with everything it's wearing and carrying, into a misty cloud for the duration. The spell ends if the creature drops to 0 HP. An incorporeal creature isn't affected. While in this form, the target's only method of movement is a Fly Speed of 10 feet. The target can enter and occupy the space of another creature. The target has Resistance to nonmagical damage, and it has Advantage on Strength, Dex, and Con saves. The target can pass through small holes, narrow openings, and even mere cracks, though it treats liquids as solid surfaces. The target can't fall and remains hovering in the air even when stunned or otherwise incapacitated. While in the form of a misty cloud, the target can't talk or manipulate objects, and any objects it was carrying or holding can't be dropped, used, or otherwise interacted with.

**Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.** You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 3.

63948cf9-1b13-53aa-864b-b6b2b7441762.name: Glyph of Warding
63948cf9-1b13-53aa-864b-b6b2b7441762.description:
When you cast this spell, you inscribe a glyph that harms other creatures, either upon a surface or within an object. The glyph triggers when a creature performs the action you specified. Choose Explosive Runes (3d8 damage of acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder, Dex save for half) or Spell Glyph (store a prepared spell of level 3 or lower; expended slot needed). The glyph is nearly invisible: an Investigation check (DC = your spell save DC) reveals it.

**Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.** The damage of an explosive rune increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 3. If you create a spell glyph, you can store any spell of up to the same level as the spell slot you use for the Glyph of Warding.

60564a0b-287d-58c0-ae53-047b047642c3.description:
You create a 10-foot-radius, 20-foot-tall Cylinder of magical energy centered on a point on the ground that you can see within range. Choose one or more of the following types of creatures: Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends, or Undead. The circle affects creatures of those types in the following ways: they can't willingly enter the Cylinder by nonmagical means; they have Disadvantage on attack rolls against targets within the Cylinder; targets within the Cylinder can't be Charmed, Frightened, or possessed by them.

*Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.* The duration increases by 1 hour for each spell slot level above 3.

*Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.* The healing increases by 1d4 for each spell slot level above 3.

2396d962-7f3c-56ce-b2a5-88465e8546da.name: Phantom Steed
2396d962-7f3c-56ce-b2a5-88465e8546da.description: A Large quasi-real, horselike creature appears on the ground in an unoccupied space within range. You decide its appearance, but it is equipped with a saddle, bit, and bridle. Any of the equipment created by the spell vanishes in a puff of smoke if it is carried more than 10 feet away from the steed. For the duration, you or a creature you choose can ride the steed. The creature uses the statistics for a Riding Horse, except it has a Speed of 100 feet and can travel 13 miles per hour, or 10 miles per hour at a fast pace. When the spell ends, the steed gradually fades, giving the rider 1 minute to dismount.

0ddd9515-7862-50c8-ba17-d15ccffdad25.description: At your touch, all curses affecting one creature or object end. If the object is a cursed magic item, its curse remains, but the spell breaks its owner's attunement to the object so it can be removed or discarded.

29be7cf8-669e-58a6-8079-d95dadadd9e7.description: You send a short message of twenty-five words or less to a creature with which you are familiar. The creature hears the message in its mind, recognizes you as the sender if it knows you, and can answer in a like manner immediately. The spell enables creatures with Intelligence scores of at least 1 to understand the meaning of your message. You can send the message across any distance, even to other planes of existence, but if the target is on a different plane, there is a 5% chance that the message doesn't arrive.

3077d08f-a510-54d7-8f1c-b8d62ded4469.name: Speak with Dead
3077d08f-a510-54d7-8f1c-b8d62ded4469.description: You grant the semblance of life and intelligence to a corpse of your choice within range, allowing it to answer the questions you pose. The corpse must still have a mouth, and it can't be Undead. The spell fails if the corpse was the target of this spell within the last 10 days. Until the spell ends, you can ask the corpse up to five questions. The corpse knows only what it knew in life, including the languages it knew. Answers are usually brief, cryptic, or repetitive, and the corpse is under no compulsion to offer a truthful answer if you are hostile to it or it recognizes you as an enemy.

e22e4b3a-a859-5e9e-a2a6-b3f5c338f5dc.description: You create a 20-foot-radius Sphere of yellow, nauseating gas centered on a point within range. The cloud spreads around corners, and its area is Heavily Obscured. The cloud lingers in the air for the duration. Each creature that is completely within the cloud at the start of its turn must succeed on a Con save against being Poisoned. While Poisoned in this way, the creature is also Incapacitated. Creatures that don't need to breathe or are immune to Poison automatically succeed.

05b8ebc0-bc14-5264-ba4b-09ebacc77ff5.description: A wall of strong wind rises from the ground at a point you choose within range. The wall is up to 50 feet long, 15 feet high, and 1 foot thick. The wall lasts for the duration. When the wall appears, each creature in its area must make a Str save: 3d8 Bludgeoning damage on a fail, half on a success. The strong wind keeps fog, smoke, and other gases at bay. Small or smaller flying creatures or objects can't pass through the wall. Loose, lightweight materials in the wall (paper, cloth, leaves) are blown upward. Arrows, bolts, and other ordinary projectiles launched at targets behind the wall are deflected upward and automatically miss.

A solid barrier blocks the eye's movement, but the eye can pass through an opening as small as 1 inch in diameter.

7d540409-dc11-5475-9732-00ab30f779f1.description: You teleport yourself from your current location to any other spot within range. You arrive at exactly the spot desired. It can be a place you can see, one you can visualize, or one you can describe by stating distance and direction. You can bring along objects as long as their weight doesn't exceed what you can carry. You can also bring one willing creature of your size or smaller who is carrying gear up to its carrying capacity. The creature must be within 5 feet of you when you cast this spell. If you would arrive in a place already occupied by an object or a creature, you and any creature traveling with you each take 4d6 Force damage, and the spell fails to teleport you.

fb8c6c2c-3f06-5797-905f-faf18699e017.description: Your magic and an offering put you in contact with a god or god's servants. You ask one question concerning a specific goal, event, or activity to occur within 7 days. The GM offers a truthful reply, which might take the form of a short phrase, a cryptic rhyme, or an omen. If you cast the spell two or more times before finishing a Long Rest, there is a cumulative 25% chance for each casting after the first that you get no answer.

c4f2d828-a2a6-56ac-8199-446c49cfe8f8.name: Faithful Hound
c4f2d828-a2a6-56ac-8199-446c49cfe8f8.description: You conjure a phantom watchdog in an unoccupied space that you can see within range, where it remains for the duration, until you dismiss it (no action required), or until you move more than 100 feet away from it. The hound is invisible to all creatures except you. While the hound is within 30 feet of the location where it was cast, it has the ability to detect Hidden creatures within that radius and barks an alarm. As a Magic action, you can mentally command the hound to make a melee attack with a +5 bonus to hit; *Hit:* 4d8 Piercing damage.

69581ca2-d298-5059-8e34-1b1763327869.name: Fire Shield
69581ca2-d298-5059-8e34-1b1763327869.description: Thin and wispy flames wreathe your body for the duration, shedding Bright Light in a 10-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 10 feet. You can dismiss the flames as an action. Choose Warm Shield (Resistance to Cold damage) or Chill Shield (Resistance to Fire damage). When a creature within 5 feet of you hits you with a melee attack, the shield erupts: the attacker takes 2d8 damage of the chosen type (Fire for Warm Shield, Cold for Chill Shield).

b4d7f48e-1bf2-57f3-b31c-aca20afae1ed.name: Freedom of Movement
b4d7f48e-1bf2-57f3-b31c-aca20afae1ed.description:
You touch a willing creature. For the duration, the target's movement is unaffected by Difficult Terrain, and spells and other magical effects can neither reduce the target's Speed nor cause the target to have the Paralyzed or Restrained condition. The target can also spend 5 feet of movement to automatically escape from nonmagical restraints, such as manacles or a creature that has it grappled. Finally, being underwater imposes no penalties on the target's movement or attacks.

**Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.** You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 4.

58cffcff-a9b5-5129-9932-e9d53d54827c.description: A Large spectral guardian appears and hovers for the duration in an unoccupied space within range. The guardian occupies that space and is indistinct except for a gleaming sword and shield emblazoned with the symbol of your deity. Any creature hostile to you that moves to a space within 10 feet of the guardian for the first time on a turn must succeed on a Dex save: 20 Radiant damage on a fail, half on a success. The guardian vanishes when it has dealt a total of 60 damage.

50eb43a4-845f-5c4d-9397-5fb8423c29e3.name: Ice Storm
50eb43a4-845f-5c4d-9397-5fb8423c29e3.description:
A hail of rock-hard ice pounds to the ground in a 20-foot-radius, 40-foot-tall Cylinder centered on a point within range. Each creature in the Cylinder must make a Dex save: 2d8 Bludgeoning + 4d6 Cold damage on a fail, half on a success. Hailstones turn the storm's area of effect into Difficult Terrain until the end of your next turn.

*Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.* The Bludgeoning damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 4.

1d855142-1b26-50e5-a2b1-81a3e673a0ed.name: Locate Creature
1d855142-1b26-50e5-a2b1-81a3e673a0ed.description: Describe or name a creature familiar to you. You sense the direction to the creature's location, as long as that creature is within 1,000 feet of you. If the creature is moving, you know the direction of its movement. The spell can locate a specific creature known to you or the nearest creature of a specific kind, provided you have seen such a creature up close — within 30 feet — at least once. If the creature is in a different form, the spell doesn't locate it. Running water at least 10 feet wide blocks the spell.

24e383ec-4ec1-5fa7-acde-9abf8450b86e.name: Phantasmal Killer
24e383ec-4ec1-5fa7-acde-9abf8450b86e.description:
You tap into the nightmares of a creature you can see within range and create an illusory manifestation of its deepest fears. The target must make a Wisdom save: on a fail, it has the Frightened condition for the duration. At the end of each of its turns, the target must succeed on another Wisdom save or take 4d10 Psychic damage. On a successful save, the spell ends.

**Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.** The damage increases by 1d10 for each spell slot level above 4.

1b42713c-7525-511e-8249-8983fff2fc8e.name: Resilient Sphere
1b42713c-7525-511e-8249-8983fff2fc8e.description: A sphere of shimmering force encloses a creature or object of Large size or smaller within range. An unwilling creature must make a Dex save. On a failed save, the creature is enclosed for the duration. Nothing — not physical objects, energy, or other spell effects — can pass through the barrier, in or out, though a creature in the sphere can breathe there. The sphere is immune to all damage, and a creature or object inside can't be damaged by attacks or effects originating from outside, nor can a creature inside the sphere damage anything outside it. The sphere is weightless and just large enough to contain the creature or object inside. An enclosed creature can use its action to push against the sphere's walls and thus roll the sphere up to half the creature's Speed.

0a4f2c40-de8f-565b-b152-9561752e465d.name: Animate Objects
0a4f2c40-de8f-565b-b152-9561752e465d.description:
Objects come to life at your command. Choose up to ten nonmagical objects within range that aren't being worn or carried, aren't fixed to a surface, and aren't Gargantuan. Tiny: AC 18, HP 20, attack +8 / 1d4+4. Small: AC 16, HP 25, attack +6 / 1d8+2. Medium: AC 13, HP 40, attack +5 / 2d6+1. Large: AC 10, HP 50, attack +6 / 2d10+2. Huge: AC 10, HP 80, attack +8 / 2d12+4. Each object becomes a creature under your control, and you can use a Bonus Action to mentally command any creature you made.

**Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.** The creature's Slam damage increases by 1d4 (Medium or smaller), 1d6 (Large), or 1d12 (Huge) for each spell slot level above 5.

36d8cd9b-d451-51fb-b54d-d8ed6bb5f0cc.name: Commune
36d8cd9b-d451-51fb-b54d-d8ed6bb5f0cc.description: You contact your deity or a divine proxy and ask up to three questions that can be answered with a yes or no. You must ask your questions before the spell ends. You receive a correct answer for each question. Divine beings aren't necessarily omniscient, so you might receive "unclear" as an answer if a question pertains to information that lies beyond the deity's knowledge. If you cast the spell two or more times before finishing a Long Rest, there is a cumulative 25% chance for each casting after the first that you get no answer.

An elemental of CR 5 or lower appropriate to the area you chose appears in an unoccupied space within 10 feet of it. The elemental disappears when it drops to 0 HP or when the spell ends.

**Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.** The damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 5.

11a6307d-4d32-591c-b050-643d53a8d40f.name: Contact Other Plane
11a6307d-4d32-591c-b050-643d53a8d40f.description: You mentally contact a demigod, the spirit of a long-dead sage, or some other mysterious entity from another plane. Contacting this extraplanar intelligence can strain or even break your mind. When you cast this spell, make an Intelligence save (DC 15). On a failure, you take 6d6 Psychic damage and have the Insanity condition until you finish a Long Rest. On a successful save, you can ask the entity up to five questions before the spell ends. You must ask your questions verbally, and the GM answers each one with one word: yes, no, maybe, never, irrelevant, or unclear.

c18dacc6-706c-5ee1-8f4d-9729d404876f.description: Shimmering energy surrounds and protects you from Aberrations, Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends, and Undead. You can end the spell early by using either of the following special functions: Break Enchantment (touch a creature you can see that is Charmed, Frightened, or Possessed by such a creature; the target is no longer affected) or Dismissal (target a single such creature within 5 feet that you can see; the target makes a Charisma save or is sent back to its native plane).

99310726-0780-5fad-8914-13e1b13d8bf7.name: Geas
99310726-0780-5fad-8914-13e1b13d8bf7.description:
You place a magical command on a creature that you can see within range, forcing it to carry out some service or refrain from some action or course of activity as you decide. If the creature can understand you, it must succeed on a Wisdom save or be Charmed by you for the duration. While Charmed, the creature takes 5d10 Psychic damage each time it acts in a manner directly counter to your instructions, but no more than once each day.

*Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.* The duration increases: 1 year (level 7), permanent until dispelled (level 9).

*Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.* The damage increases by 1d10 for each spell slot level above 5.

98de89ed-2365-5ec7-9fa3-05a544971cb9.name: Modify Memory
98de89ed-2365-5ec7-9fa3-05a544971cb9.description:
You attempt to reshape another creature's memories. One creature that you can see must make a Wisdom save. If you are fighting the creature, it has Advantage on the save. On a failed save, the target has the Charmed condition for the duration. While Charmed in this way, the target is Incapacitated and unaware of its surroundings. While the target is Charmed, you can affect its memory of an event that it experienced within the last 24 hours and that lasted no more than 10 minutes.

**Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.** You can alter the target's memories of an event that took place up to 7 days ago (level 6 spell slot), 30 days ago (level 7 spell slot), 365 days ago (level 8 spell slot), or any time in the creature's past (level 9 spell slot).

At the end of the casting, the target must succeed on a Charisma save or be bound to serve you for the duration. If the creature was summoned or created by another spell, that spell's duration is extended to match this one. A bound creature must follow your instructions to the best of its ability.

The spell doesn't change perceived sound, smell, or other sensory effects. A creature can use a Study action to physically inspect a target and discern that it is disguised; on a successful Investigation check (DC = your spell save DC), the creature is no longer fooled.

eed411f2-4bdd-5a1e-acb5-3ef2fbbf87e4.name: Tree Stride
eed411f2-4bdd-5a1e-acb5-3ef2fbbf87e4.description: You gain the ability to enter a tree and move from inside it to inside another tree of the same kind within 500 feet. Both trees must be living and at least the same size as you. You must use 5 feet of movement to enter a tree. You instantly know the location of all other trees of the same kind within 500 feet and can step from one tree to another by spending 5 feet of movement. You appear in a spot of your choice within 5 feet of the destination tree. You can use this transportation ability once per round for the duration.

3aeda714-be17-5651-a0c1-71cbe8eb6df2.name: Wall of Stone
3aeda714-be17-5651-a0c1-71cbe8eb6df2.description: A nonmagical wall of solid stone springs into existence at a point you choose within range. The wall is 6 inches thick and is composed of ten 10-foot-by-10-foot panels. Each panel must be contiguous with at least one other panel. The wall lasts for the duration. If the wall cuts through a creature's space when it appears, the creature is pushed to one side of the wall (the creature's choice). If the spell's duration expires while you maintain Concentration, the wall becomes permanent and can't be dispelled. Otherwise, the wall disappears when the spell ends. The wall can be damaged and breached normally (AC 15, 30 HP per 10-foot section, immune to Poison and Psychic damage).

04cc2884-4ef5-5c22-ac68-1751fe4764fd.name: Chain Lightning
04cc2884-4ef5-5c22-ac68-1751fe4764fd.description:
You unleash a stroke of lightning that arcs toward a target of your choice within range. Three bolts then leap from that target to as many as three other targets, each of which must be within 30 feet of the first. A target can be a creature or object and can be targeted by only one of the bolts. Each target must make a Dex save: 10d8 Lightning damage on a fail, half on a success.

*Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.* One additional bolt leaps from the first target to another target for each spell slot level above 6.

e98f2f29-9562-5464-b336-4963943c6384.name: Circle of Death
e98f2f29-9562-5464-b336-4963943c6384.description:
A sphere of negative energy ripples out in a 60-foot-radius Sphere from a point within range. Each creature in the area must make a Con save: 8d6 Necrotic damage on a fail, half on a success.

*Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.* The damage increases by 2d6 for each spell slot level above 6.
