c631eb31-d7fb-58c2-b827-cc86af5ee866.name: Eyebite
c631eb31-d7fb-58c2-b827-cc86af5ee866.description: For the duration, your eyes become an inky void. One creature of your choice within 60 feet that you can see must succeed on a Wisdom save or be afflicted with one of the following effects: Asleep (target falls Unconscious; wakes if it takes damage or someone uses an action to shake it awake), Panicked (target is Frightened of you for the duration; must take Dash and move at least 30 feet away each turn), Sickened (target has Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks).

d53e25b4-f27c-500e-bc4a-f77d1d82532a.name: Globe of Invulnerability
d53e25b4-f27c-500e-bc4a-f77d1d82532a.description:
An immobile, faintly shimmering barrier springs into existence in a 10-foot radius around you and remains for the duration. Any spell of level 5 or lower cast from outside the barrier can't affect creatures or objects within it, even if the spell is cast using a higher-level spell slot. Such a spell can target creatures and objects within the barrier, but the spell has no effect on them. Similarly, the area within the barrier is excluded from the areas affected by such spells.

*Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.* The barrier blocks spells of one level higher for each spell slot level above 6.

8d84a43c-6c32-5115-a764-e3a4b23a608f.name: Harm
8d84a43c-6c32-5115-a764-e3a4b23a608f.description: You unleash a virulent disease on a creature you can see within range. The target must make a Con save: 14d6 Necrotic damage on a fail, half on a success. The damage can't reduce the target's HP below 1. If the target fails the save, its HP maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the Necrotic damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a Long Rest. The target dies if its HP maximum is reduced to 0.

bfc0d5d5-ff20-5530-9ea8-dad619d1d708.name: Heroes' Feast
bfc0d5d5-ff20-5530-9ea8-dad619d1d708.description: You bring forth a great feast, including magnificent food and drink. The feast takes 1 hour to consume and disappears at the end of that time, and the beneficial effects don't set in until this hour is over. Up to twelve creatures can partake of the feast. A creature that partakes of the feast gains several benefits: it is cured of all diseases and Poisoned conditions, becomes immune to Poison damage and being Frightened, and makes all Wisdom saves with Advantage. Its HP maximum also increases by 2d10, and it gains the same number of HP. These benefits last for 24 hours.

81264f18-63b6-5a53-aac4-3ca4068faad9.name: Magic Jar
81264f18-63b6-5a53-aac4-3ca4068faad9.description: Your body falls into a catatonic state as your soul leaves it and enters the container you used as the spell's Material component. While your soul resides in the container, you can take a Magic action to attempt to possess any Humanoid within 100 feet that you can see. The target must succeed on a Charisma save or be possessed; you can't be possessed by a target that has died, and you are aware of any creature in the area that has been possessed by another spell. The target's soul is transported to the container; while there, it can't be reawakened to its body, and it has the Incapacitated condition.

e78fed6f-bfe5-57bb-aacb-0098c30484c4.name: Mass Suggestion
e78fed6f-bfe5-57bb-aacb-0098c30484c4.description:
You suggest a course of activity (limited to a sentence or two) and magically influence up to twelve creatures of your choice that you can see within range, and that can hear and understand you. Creatures that can't be Charmed are immune to this effect. The suggestion must be worded in such a manner as to make the course of action sound reasonable. Asking the creature to stab itself or impale itself on a spear, throw itself onto a campfire, or otherwise harm itself ends the spell.

**Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.** The duration is longer with a spell slot of level 7 (10 days), 8 (30 days), or 9 (366 days).

c2f9dfe9-8e9e-5a7e-a977-297449cf66fe.name: Move Earth
c2f9dfe9-8e9e-5a7e-a977-297449cf66fe.description: Choose an area of terrain no larger than 40 feet on a side within range. You can reshape dirt, sand, or clay in the area in any manner you choose for the duration. You can raise or lower the area's elevation, create or fill in a trench, erect or flatten a wall, or form a pillar. The extent of any such changes can't exceed half the area's largest dimension. Because the terrain's transformation occurs slowly, creatures in the area can't usually be trapped or injured by the ground's movement.

e8ecac91-7a6a-5e63-9084-6167465d8cff.name: Sunbeam
e8ecac91-7a6a-5e63-9084-6167465d8cff.description: A beam of brilliant light flashes out from your hand in a 5-foot-wide, 60-foot Line. Each creature in the Line must make a Con save: 6d8 Radiant damage and Blinded until your next turn on a fail, half damage on a success. Until the spell ends, you can take a Magic action on each of your turns to create a new Line of radiance. For the duration, a mote of brilliant radiance shines in your hand. It sheds Bright Light in a 30-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 30 feet.

f36a09c7-ae2f-5f31-b572-e7db4b634b9d.name: True Seeing
f36a09c7-ae2f-5f31-b572-e7db4b634b9d.description: This spell gives the willing creature you touch the ability to see things as they actually are. For the duration, the creature has Truesight, notices secret doors hidden by magic, and can see into the Ethereal Plane, all out to a range of 120 feet.

attributes.material_description: An ointment for the eyes that costs 25+ GP, is made from mushroom powder, saffron, and fat, and is consumed by the spell

b81ef90b-ea68-56b4-96b8-5956b74789c7.name: Wall of Ice
b81ef90b-ea68-56b4-96b8-5956b74789c7.description:
You create a wall of ice on a solid surface within range. You can form it into a hemispherical dome or a flat surface. As a flat surface, the wall is up to 10 feet thick and consists of ten 10-foot-square panels (must be contiguous). The wall lasts for the duration and is opaque. When the wall appears, each creature in its area must make a Dex save: 10d6 Cold damage on a fail, half on a success. The wall is an object; each 10-foot section has AC 12 and 30 HP. Reducing a 10-foot section to 0 HP destroys it and leaves behind a 5-foot-thick sheet of frigid air in the space the wall occupied. A creature moving through the sheet must succeed on a Con save (DC = your spell save DC) or take 5d6 Cold damage.

*Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.* The damage increases by 2d6 for each spell slot level above 6.

8d47a02a-9f9b-5a59-b54a-22b0e56af033.description:
You summon a Celestial of CR 4 or lower, which appears in an unoccupied space that you can see within range. The Celestial disappears when it drops to 0 HP or when the spell ends.

*Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.* The CR increases by 1 for each spell slot level above 7.

1501c48d-d82c-5877-afd3-3c1245451a66.name: Delayed Blast Fireball
1501c48d-d82c-5877-afd3-3c1245451a66.description:
A beam of yellow light flashes from your pointing finger, then condenses to linger at a chosen point within range as a glowing bead for the duration. When the spell ends, either because your Concentration is broken or because you decide to end it, the bead blossoms with a low roar into an explosion of flame that spreads around corners. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on that point must make a Dex save: 12d6 Fire damage on a fail, half on a success. If the glowing bead is touched before the spell ends, the creature touching it must make a Dex save. The damage increases by 1d6 for each round the bead has lingered.

**Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.** The base damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 7.

4414f980-844b-597e-a84b-dfee259b7715.name: Etherealness
4414f980-844b-597e-a84b-dfee259b7715.description:
You step into the border regions of the Ethereal Plane, in the area where it overlaps with your current plane. You remain in the Border Ethereal for the duration or until you use your action to dismiss the spell. During this time, you can move in any direction. If you move up or down, every foot of movement costs an extra foot. You can see and hear the plane you originated from, but everything there looks gray, and you can't see anything more than 60 feet away. While on the Ethereal Plane, you can affect and be affected only by other creatures on that plane. Creatures that aren't on the Ethereal Plane can't perceive you and can't interact with you, unless a special ability or magic has given them the ability to do so.

**Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.** You can target up to three willing creatures (including yourself) for each spell slot level above 7. The creatures must be within 10 feet of you when you cast the spell.

9fa0bc7b-b87b-5fad-8e02-f90a70ce5779.name: Forcecage
9fa0bc7b-b87b-5fad-8e02-f90a70ce5779.description: An immobile, invisible, cube-shaped prison composed of magical force springs into existence around an area you choose within range. The prison can be a Cage or a Solid Box. As a Cage, the prison can be up to 20 feet on a side and is made from 1/2-inch-diameter bars spaced 1/2 inch apart. As a Solid Box, the prison can be up to 10 feet on a side and creates a solid barrier. A creature inside the cage can't leave it by nonmagical means. If the creature tries to use teleportation or interplanar travel, it must make a Charisma save. On a failure, the creature can't use that magic to leave the cage. The cage doesn't prevent line of sight (in cage form), but a Solid Box does. Spells and other magical effects can't extend through the cage or be cast through it.

9f4d42ef-508b-5c4c-bdac-52ab9d4445a1.name: Plane Shift
9f4d42ef-508b-5c4c-bdac-52ab9d4445a1.description: You and up to eight willing creatures who link hands in a circle are transported to a different plane of existence. You can specify a target destination in general terms, and you appear in or near that destination. Alternatively, if you know the sigil sequence of a teleportation circle on another plane of existence, this spell can take you to that circle. You can also use this spell to banish an unwilling creature to another plane. Choose a creature within reach and make a melee spell attack against it. *Hit:* The creature must succeed on a Charisma save or be transported to a random location on the plane of existence you specify.

b4bfc76b-aafd-5a36-bd14-eae6ed8e5902.name: Prismatic Spray
b4bfc76b-aafd-5a36-bd14-eae6ed8e5902.description: Eight multicolored rays of light flash from your hand. Each ray is a different color and has a different power and purpose. Each creature in a 60-foot Cone must make a Dex save. For each target, roll a d8 to determine the ray color: 1 Red (10d6 Fire), 2 Orange (10d6 Acid), 3 Yellow (10d6 Lightning), 4 Green (10d6 Poison), 5 Blue (10d6 Cold), 6 Indigo (Restrained, save ends), 7 Violet (Blinded; turn back at start of next turn or be transported to another plane), 8 Special (target struck by two rays — roll twice more, ignoring 8s).

f42be4f4-00ae-5400-ab3b-e7561e7980d3.name: Regenerate
f42be4f4-00ae-5400-ab3b-e7561e7980d3.description: You touch a creature and stimulate its natural healing ability. The target regains 4d8 + 15 HP. For the duration, the target regains 1 HP at the start of each of its turns (10 HP per minute). The target's severed body members (fingers, legs, tails, and so on), if any, are restored after 2 minutes. If you have the severed part and hold it to the stump, the spell instantaneously causes the limb to knit to the stump.

1372586b-a8c1-521b-aeb5-71f1a8219a89.name: Resurrection
1372586b-a8c1-521b-aeb5-71f1a8219a89.description: You touch a dead creature that has been dead for no more than a century, that didn't die of old age, and that isn't Undead. If its soul is free and willing, the target returns to life with all its HP. This spell neutralizes any poisons and cures normal diseases afflicting the creature when it died. It doesn't, however, remove magical diseases, curses, and the like; if these aren't removed prior to casting the spell, they take effect when the creature returns to life.

1523bd95-726f-556b-b2b4-f56feed1185b.name: Reverse Gravity
1523bd95-726f-556b-b2b4-f56feed1185b.description: This spell reverses gravity in a 50-foot-radius, 100-foot-high Cylinder centered on a point within range. All creatures and objects that aren't somehow anchored to the ground in the area fall upward and reach the top of the area when you cast this spell. A creature can make a Dex save to grab onto a fixed object it can reach, thus avoiding the fall. If some solid object (such as a ceiling) is encountered in this fall, falling objects and creatures strike it just as they would during a normal downward fall. When the spell ends, affected objects and creatures fall back down.

43727a5a-f666-5a59-bf59-6e2b7bd17a0f.name: Symbol
43727a5a-f666-5a59-bf59-6e2b7bd17a0f.description: When you cast this spell, you inscribe a harmful glyph either on a surface or within an object that can be closed. You decide what triggers the glyph when you cast the spell. Choose: Death (10d10 Necrotic), Discord (creatures bicker for 1 minute), Fear (Frightened for 1 minute), Hopelessness (target overwhelmed with despair), Insanity (target confused), Pain (Incapacitated by waves of pain), Sleep (Unconscious 10 minutes), Stunning (Stunned for 1 minute). Each effect resolves with appropriate save DC.

23dd6cb4-5cfe-5deb-905c-a7a7803146e6.name: Antimagic Field
23dd6cb4-5cfe-5deb-905c-a7a7803146e6.description: A 10-foot-radius invisible Sphere of antimagic surrounds you. This area is divorced from the magical energy that suffuses the multiverse. Within the sphere, spells can't be cast, summoned creatures disappear, and even magic items become mundane. Until the spell ends, the sphere moves with you, centered on you. Spells and other magical effects, except those created by an artifact or a deity, are suppressed in the sphere and can't protrude into it. A slot expended to cast a suppressed spell is consumed. Targeted effects don't affect targets in the sphere.

520876e9-b5df-5379-9b25-44ffbeb2e556.name: Animal Shapes
520876e9-b5df-5379-9b25-44ffbeb2e556.description: Your magic turns others into beasts. Choose any number of willing creatures that you can see within range. Each target shape-shifts into a Large or smaller Beast of your choice that has a CR of 4 or lower. You can choose a different form for each target. On later turns, you can take a Magic action to transform the targets again. The transformation lasts for the duration or until the target ends it as a Bonus Action.

c16be5ca-9c62-5c53-b121-6595c5d43d07.name: Control Weather
c16be5ca-9c62-5c53-b121-6595c5d43d07.description: You take control of the weather within 5 miles of you for the duration. You must be outdoors to cast this spell. When you cast the spell, the existing weather conditions are determined by the GM. After that, you can change the weather in any of three ways at the start of each turn (Precipitation, Temperature, Wind). It takes 1d4 × 10 minutes for the new conditions to take effect.

f10e9e44-0f1b-5ab1-b74a-218e6ad03aef.name: Demiplane
f10e9e44-0f1b-5ab1-b74a-218e6ad03aef.description: You create a shadowy door on a flat solid surface that you can see within range. The door is large enough to allow Medium creatures to pass through unhindered. When opened, the door leads to a demiplane that appears to be an empty room 30 feet in each dimension, made of wood or stone. When the spell ends, the door disappears, and any creatures or objects inside the demiplane remain trapped there.

aa27b693-8784-5b08-8205-572c62f836f8.name: Dominate Monster
aa27b693-8784-5b08-8205-572c62f836f8.description:
You attempt to beguile a creature that you can see within range. It must succeed on a Wisdom save or be Charmed by you for the duration. While the target is Charmed, you have a telepathic link with it as long as the two of you are on the same plane of existence. You can use this telepathic link to issue commands to the creature while you are conscious. Each time the target takes damage, it makes a new Wisdom save. On a successful save, the spell ends.

**Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.** Your Concentration can last longer with a level 9 spell slot (up to 8 hours).

4cc867fe-f77f-5d83-9d7b-6f15b6d489ad.name: Earthquake
4cc867fe-f77f-5d83-9d7b-6f15b6d489ad.description: You create a seismic disturbance at a point on the ground that you can see within range. For the duration, an intense tremor rips through the ground in a 100-foot-radius circle centered on that point and shakes creatures and structures in contact with the ground there. The ground in the area becomes Difficult Terrain. Each creature on the ground that is concentrating must make a Con save (DC 10 + spell's save DC) or its Concentration is broken. When you cast the spell and at the end of each turn, each creature on the ground in the area must make a Dex save or be knocked Prone.

92a325c9-ad92-5c52-a2af-63dc9c589f0c.name: Holy Aura
92a325c9-ad92-5c52-a2af-63dc9c589f0c.description: Divine light washes out from you and coalesces in a soft radiance in a 30-foot Emanation centered on you. Creatures of your choice in the Emanation when you cast this spell shed Dim Light in a 5-foot radius, have Advantage on all saves, and other creatures have Disadvantage on attack rolls against them. In addition, when a Fiend or an Undead hits an affected creature with a melee attack, the attacker takes 10 Radiant damage and must make a Con save or have the Blinded condition until the spell ends.

98a01be5-9db4-5401-bf64-7dbd12db4be0.name: Incendiary Cloud
98a01be5-9db4-5401-bf64-7dbd12db4be0.description: A swirling cloud of smoke shot through with white-hot embers appears in a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point within range. The cloud spreads around corners and is Heavily Obscured. It lasts for the duration or until a wind disperses it. When the cloud appears, each creature in it must make a Dex save: 10d8 Fire damage on a fail, half on a success. A creature must also make this save when it enters the spell's area for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there. The cloud moves 10 feet directly away from you in a direction that you choose at the start of each of your turns.

ce405465-eb28-58ff-8b3a-a5fc5509aef8.name: Maze
ce405465-eb28-58ff-8b3a-a5fc5509aef8.description: You banish a creature that you can see within range into a labyrinthine demiplane. The target remains there for the duration or until it escapes the maze. The target can use its action to attempt to escape. When it does so, it makes a DC 20 Intelligence check. If it succeeds, it escapes, and the spell ends (a Minotaur or goristro demon automatically succeeds). When the spell ends, the target reappears in the space it left.

b9a428d3-230e-5f07-bdd5-1be2897ac246.name: Mind Blank
b9a428d3-230e-5f07-bdd5-1be2897ac246.description: Until the spell ends, one willing creature you touch is immune to Psychic damage, any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, divination spells, and the Charmed condition. The spell even foils Wish spells and spells or effects of similar power used to affect the target's mind or to gain information about the target.

f0a0791b-2d66-5b67-a5c5-17ae7233ec9e.name: Telepathy
f0a0791b-2d66-5b67-a5c5-17ae7233ec9e.description: You create a telepathic link between yourself and a willing creature with which you are familiar. The creature can be anywhere on the same plane of existence. The spell ends if you or the target are no longer on the same plane. Until the spell ends, you and the target can instantaneously share words, images, sounds, and other sensory messages with one another through the link, and the target recognizes you as the creature it is communicating with.

bb405a63-ad37-5b63-8899-cb9ae8a0f6e9.name: Astral Projection
bb405a63-ad37-5b63-8899-cb9ae8a0f6e9.description: You and up to eight willing creatures within range project your astral bodies into the Astral Plane. Each creature's astral body resembles its mortal form. The material body is left behind in a state of suspended animation; the body doesn't need food or air and doesn't age. The astral body can travel through the Astral Plane and can use its action to attack and cast spells as normal. The spell ends for you and your companions when you use your action to dismiss it.

0804e16d-9d04-5bf1-9e47-208a108342de.description: You touch a willing creature and bestow a limited ability to see into the immediate future. 7b41d1bb-f239-5634-ae72-cc1b381ee7eb.name: Gate
7b41d1bb-f239-5634-ae72-cc1b381ee7eb.description: You conjure a portal linking an unoccupied space you can see within range to a precise location on a different plane of existence. The portal is a circular opening, which you can make 5 to 20 feet in diameter. You can orient the portal in any direction you choose. When you cast this spell, you can speak the name of a specific creature (a pseudonym, title, or nickname doesn't work). If that creature is on a plane other than the one you're on, the portal opens in the named creature's immediate vicinity and draws the creature through it.

b2fab795-f82b-5756-939e-be3fe5c9b24d.description: You create a magical restraint to hold a creature that you can see within range. While affected by this spell, the creature doesn't need to breathe, eat, or drink, and it doesn't age. Choose Burial, Chaining, Hedged Prison, Minimus Containment, or Slumber.

c57b9815-0f0e-5b91-bb3c-0327e237724a.name: Mass Heal
c57b9815-0f0e-5b91-bb3c-0327e237724a.description: A flood of healing energy flows from you into injured creatures around you. You restore up to 700 HP, divided as you choose among any number of creatures that you can see within range. Creatures healed by this spell are also cured of all diseases and any effect making them Blinded or Deafened. This spell has no effect on Undead or Constructs.

e479ebf5-5d3d-5e9a-a920-21414e8f8735.name: Prismatic Wall
e479ebf5-5d3d-5e9a-a920-21414e8f8735.description: A shimmering, multicolored plane of light forms a vertical opaque wall — up to 90 feet long, 30 feet high, and 1 inch thick — centered on a point you can see within range. The wall sheds Bright Light in a 100-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 100 feet. You and creatures you designate when casting the spell can pass through and be near the wall without harm. Other creatures within 20 feet that can see the wall must succeed on a Con save or have the Blinded condition for 1 minute. The wall has seven layers, each color of the spectrum (Red, Orange, Yellow, Green, Blue, Indigo, Violet); each has a separate effect when a creature attempts to pass through.

4460d1f8-43f2-5fb8-8503-b187d50b26e5.name: Shapechange
4460d1f8-43f2-5fb8-8503-b187d50b26e5.description: You assume the form of a different creature for the duration. The new form can be any creature with a CR equal to your level or lower. The creature can't be a Construct or an Undead, and you must have seen the kind of creature before. You transform into an average specimen of that creature, one that doesn't have any class levels or the Spellcasting trait. Your game statistics are replaced by the new form's, but you retain your alignment and personality.

316b0341-4c83-5cad-a5a1-929dc472776c.name: Storm of Vengeance
316b0341-4c83-5cad-a5a1-929dc472776c.description: A churning storm cloud forms, centered on a point you can see and spreading to a radius of 360 feet. Lightning flashes in the area, thunder booms, and strong winds roar. Each creature under the cloud must succeed on a Con save or be Deafened for 5 minutes. Each round you maintain Concentration, the storm produces escalating effects: round 2 acidic rain (1d6 Acid each turn), round 3 lightning (six bolts striking creatures or objects of your choice), round 4 hailstones (2d6 Bludgeoning, possibly Cold also), rounds 5-10 driving rain (Heavy Obscure, Difficult Terrain, etc.).

964b80be-86ab-53c7-bb75-ebe826523bbd.name: True Polymorph
964b80be-86ab-53c7-bb75-ebe826523bbd.description: Choose one creature or nonmagical object that you can see within range. The transformation lasts for the duration, or until the target drops to 0 HP or dies. If you concentrate on this spell for the full duration, the transformation becomes permanent. An unwilling creature can make a Wisdom save, ending the spell on a success.

d3c85aaf-aea5-5f83-ac60-fa6c2e3f2b1f.name: True Resurrection
d3c85aaf-aea5-5f83-ac60-fa6c2e3f2b1f.description: You touch a creature that has been dead for no longer than 200 years and that died for any reason except old age. If the creature's soul is free and willing, the creature is restored to life with all its HP. This spell closes all wounds, neutralizes any poison, cures all diseases, and lifts any curses affecting the creature when it died. The spell replaces damaged or missing organs and limbs. If the creature was Undead, it is restored to its non-Undead form. The spell can even provide a new body if the original no longer exists.

932969e4-d4ce-5c08-9924-7eff99e64746.description: A shimmering barrier extends out from you in a 10-foot Emanation and moves with you. The barrier prevents creatures other than Undead and Constructs from passing or reaching through it. The spell ends if you move so that one of these creatures is forced to pass through the barrier.

Regardless of HP, Celestials, Elementals, Fey, and Fiends are forced back to their home plane on a failed save.

1db19d97-4876-53bb-af2e-38082f3ea0dd.name: Dominate Beast

**Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.** Your Concentration can last longer with a spell slot of level 5 (up to 10 minutes), 6 (up to 1 hour), or 7+ (up to 8 hours).

9eb56b05-5c4e-5816-91e0-48fc2548b219.description:

**Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.** You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 1.

**Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.** The Cold damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 1.

8894aee9-8f90-5bd9-b933-b34fa03a67c8.description: You step into a stone object or surface large enough to fully contain your body, melding yourself and all the equipment you carry with the stone for the duration. **Cantrip Upgrade.** Damage increases by 1d8 at levels 5 (2d8), 11 (3d8), and 17 (4d8).

On each of your later turns, you can take a Magic action to call down another bolt.

**Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.** Damage increases by 1d10 for each spell slot level above 3.

The wall provides Three-Quarters Cover, and its space is Difficult Terrain. A creature in the wall's space when it appears or that enters it for the first time on a turn must make a Dex save: 6d10 Force damage on a fail or half on a save.

eb232c24-192f-5037-8749-ffed9821e5ea.name: Create Undead
eb232c24-192f-5037-8749-ffed9821e5ea.description:
You can cast this spell only at night. Choose up to three corpses of Medium or Small Humanoids within range. Each becomes a Ghoul under your control. The spell's magic affects each Ghoul for 24 hours, after which it ignores your commands. To maintain control for another 24 hours, recast the spell on the Ghouls before the current 24-hour period ends.

**Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.** With a level 7 slot create or reassert control over four Ghouls; level 8: five Ghouls or two Ghasts/Wights; level 9: six Ghouls, three Ghasts/Wights, or two Mummies.

e065f705-9658-50ab-945b-d77129ece983.description: One creature that you can see within range must make a Wisdom saving throw. While Charmed, the target dances comically, must use all its movement to dance in place, has Disadvantage on Dexterity saves and attack rolls, and other creatures have Advantage on attack rolls against it.

90d9e9bb-7b82-5686-b84e-e92e3bc06069.name: Contingency
90d9e9bb-7b82-5686-b84e-e92e3bc06069.description: Choose a spell of level 5 or lower that you can cast, that has a casting time of an action, and that can target you. You cast that spell—called the contingent spell—as part of casting Contingency, expending spell slots for both, but the contingent spell doesn't come into effect. Instead, it takes effect when a certain trigger occurs. You describe that trigger when you cast the two spells. For example, a Contingency cast with Water Breathing might stipulate that Water Breathing comes into effect when you are engulfed in water or a similar liquid. The contingent spell takes effect immediately after the trigger occurs for the first time, whether or not you want it to, and then Contingency ends. The contingent spell takes effect only on you, even if it can normally target others. You can use only one Contingency spell at a time. If you cast this spell again, the effect of another Contingency spell on you ends. Also, Contingency ends on you if its material component is ever not on your person.

On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage only.

2af69a19-f7f1-548c-bd7c-ce2be3fd35d5.name: Instant Summons
2af69a19-f7f1-548c-bd7c-ce2be3fd35d5.description: You touch the sapphire used in the casting and an object weighing 10 pounds or less whose longest dimension is 6 feet or less. The spell leaves an Invisible mark on that object and invisibly inscribes the object's name on the sapphire. Each time you cast this spell, you must use a different sapphire. Thereafter, you can take a Magic action to speak the object's name and crush the sapphire. The object instantly appears in your hand regardless of physical or planar distances, and the spell ends. If another creature is holding or carrying the object, crushing the sapphire doesn't transport it, but instead you learn who that creature is and where that creature is currently located.

2e3085af-6bef-55a2-9a6e-23dcff2370af.name: Phantasmal Force
2e3085af-6bef-55a2-9a6e-23dcff2370af.description: You attempt to craft an illusion in the mind of a creature you can see within range. The target makes an Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, you create a phantasmal object, creature, or other phenomenon that is no larger than a 10-foot Cube and that is perceivable only to the target for the duration. The phantasm includes sound, temperature, and other stimuli. The target can take a Study action to examine the phantasm with an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC. If the check succeeds, the target realizes that the phantasm is an illusion, and the spell ends. While affected by the spell, the target treats the phantasm as if it were real and rationalizes any illogical outcomes from interacting with it. For example, if the target steps through a phantasmal bridge and survives the fall, it believes the bridge exists and something else caused it to fall. An affected target can even take damage from the illusion if the phantasm represents a dangerous creature or hazard. On each of your turns, such a phantasm can deal 2d8 Psychic damage to the target if it is in the phantasm's area or within 5 feet of the phantasm. The target perceives the damage as a type appropriate to the illusion.

f867e02b-ed7a-5718-a3e1-4fad6ead8c01.description: With a touch, you magically sequester an object or a willing creature. For the duration, the target has the Invisible condition and can't be targeted by Divination spells, detected by magic, or viewed remotely with magic. If the target is a creature, it enters a state of suspended animation; it has the Unconscious condition, doesn't age, and doesn't need food, water, or air. You can set a condition for the spell to end early. The condition can be anything you choose, but it must occur or be visible within 1 mile of the target. Examples include "after 1,000 years" or "when the tarrasque awakens." This spell also ends if the target takes any damage.

You must have seen or touched the destination plant at least once before. For the duration, any creature can step into the target plant and exit from the destination plant by using 5 feet of movement.

eb131956-8e5f-5be1-ab00-a0ea8b3db774.name: Barbarian
eb131956-8e5f-5be1-ab00-a0ea8b3db774.description: Fierce warrior of primitive background who can enter a battle rage. Hit Die d12. Strength-primary. Wears Light/Medium armor; trained with all weapons.

features.name: Rage
features.description: You can imbue yourself with primal power as a Bonus Action while not in Heavy armor. While raging you have Resistance to B/P/S, gain a damage bonus on Strength attacks, Advantage on Strength checks/saves, can't cast spells or maintain Concentration. Lasts to the end of your next turn; extend by attacking, forcing a save, or a Bonus Action. Up to 10 minutes per Rage.

features.name: Unarmored Defense
features.description: While not wearing armor, your AC = 10 + Dex mod + Con mod. You can use a Shield and still gain this benefit.

features.name: Weapon Mastery
features.description: Use the mastery property of two kinds of Simple/Martial Melee weapons. Swap one choice on a Long Rest. More kinds unlock at higher levels.

features.name: Danger Sense
features.description: Advantage on Dex saves while not Incapacitated.

features.name: Reckless Attack
features.description: On your first attack of the turn, gain Advantage on Strength attacks until the start of your next turn; attacks against you also have Advantage during that time.

features.name: Barbarian Subclass
features.description: Choose a subclass (Path of the Berserker in this SRD).

features.name: Primal Knowledge
features.description: Gain proficiency in another barbarian skill. While raging you can substitute Strength for ability checks made with Acrobatics, Intimidation, Perception, Stealth, or Survival.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat you qualify for. Repeats at levels 8, 12, 16.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: Attack twice when you take the Attack action.

features.name: Fast Movement
features.description: +10 ft. Speed while not in Heavy armor.

features.name: Feral Instinct
features.description: Advantage on Initiative rolls.

features.name: Instinctive Pounce
features.description: When you Bonus Action into Rage, move up to half your Speed.

features.name: Brutal Strike
features.description: When you Reckless Attack, you can forgo Advantage on one Str attack to deal +1d10 damage and apply a Brutal Strike effect (Forceful Blow or Hamstring Blow).

features.name: Relentless Rage
features.description: When dropped to 0 HP while raging, DC 10 Con save to drop to twice your level instead. DC +5 each subsequent use; resets on a rest.

features.name: Improved Brutal Strike
features.description: Adds Staggering Blow and Sundering Blow to your Brutal Strike options.

features.name: Persistent Rage
features.description: When you roll Initiative, regain all uses of Rage (once per Long Rest). Rage now lasts 10 minutes without extending.

features.name: Improved Brutal Strike (II)
features.description: Brutal Strike extra damage rises to 2d10 and you can apply two effects per use.

features.name: Indomitable Might
features.description: If your Strength check/save total is less than your Str score, use the score instead.

features.name: Epic Boon
features.description: Gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat you qualify for. Boon of Irresistible Offense is recommended.

features.name: Primal Champion
features.description: Strength and Constitution scores increase by 4, max 25.

features.name: Bardic Inspiration
features.description: As a Bonus Action choose a creature within 60 feet (other than yourself); they gain a Bardic Inspiration die (d6). Number of uses = your Charisma modifier (min 1) per Long Rest. Die size grows at higher levels.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: You know cantrips and spells from the Bard list. Charisma is your spellcasting ability.

features.name: Expertise
features.description: Choose two skills you're proficient in; your Proficiency Bonus is doubled for ability checks with those skills. Another skill at level 9.

features.name: Jack of All Trades
features.description: Add half your PB (rounded down) to ability checks that don't already include it.

features.name: Bard Subclass
features.description: Choose a subclass (College of Lore in this SRD).

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Repeats at levels 8, 12, 16, 19.

features.name: Font of Inspiration
features.description: Bardic Inspiration die becomes d8. Regain expended Bardic Inspiration on a Short or Long Rest.

features.name: Countercharm
features.description: When you or a creature within 30 feet of you fails a save against being Charmed or Frightened, you can use a Reaction to let them reroll.

features.name: Expertise (II)
features.description: Choose two more skills for Expertise.

features.name: Magical Secrets
features.description: Replace one Bard spell with a spell of the same level from any class's spell list. Repeats at higher levels.

features.name: Words of Creation
features.description: You always have the Power Word Heal and Power Word Kill spells prepared. Power Word Heal can target an additional creature you can see and Power Word Kill an additional creature with HP threshold.

features.name: Epic Boon
features.description: Recommended: Boon of Spell Recall.

features.name: Superior Bardic Inspiration
features.description: Regain two uses of Bardic Inspiration when you roll Initiative.

58545a87-d2fa-5e00-94db-adcb23b9fdf4.name: Cleric
58545a87-d2fa-5e00-94db-adcb23b9fdf4.description: Priestly champion who wields divine magic in service of a higher power. Hit Die d8. Wisdom-primary full caster.

be722962-2f31-5157-a517-0c75a34a5551.description: Priest of the Old Faith, wielding the powers of nature and adopting animal forms. Hit Die d8. Wisdom-primary full caster.

options.label: Leather Armor, Shield, Sickle, Quarterstaff, Explorer's Pack, Herbalism Kit, 9 GP

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: You know Druid cantrips and prepare spells from the Druid list. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability. Your Druidic Focus is your spellcasting focus.

features.name: Druidic
features.description: You know the secret druidic language. Bonus Action to leave a magical message understandable only to other druids.

features.name: Primal Order
features.description: Choose Magician (extra cantrip + Arcana/Nature proficiency) or Warden (Martial weapon proficiency + Medium armor training).

features.name: Wild Shape
features.description: Bonus Action to assume the form of a Beast you've seen, of CR ≤ ¼ (no flying speed). Lasts up to half your Druid level in hours. Two uses per Short or Long Rest.

features.name: Wild Companion
features.description: Expend a Wild Shape use to cast Find Familiar without material components; the familiar lasts until you finish a Long Rest.

features.name: Druid Subclass
features.description: Choose a subclass (Circle of the Land in this SRD).

features.name: Wild Resurgence
features.description: Convert two Wild Shape uses into a level-1 spell slot, or vice versa, once per turn (no action).

features.name: Elemental Fury
features.description: Choose Potent Spellcasting (add Wis mod to cantrip damage) or Primal Strike (your Wild Shape attacks count as magical for resistance).

features.name: Improved Elemental Fury
features.description: Improvements to chosen option.

features.name: Beast Spells
features.description: Cast known/prepared Druid spells with V/S components only while in Wild Shape.

features.name: Archdruid
features.description: Unlimited Wild Shape uses; ignore Verbal/Somatic components and material components without cost while in Wild Shape; age 1 year for every 10 elapsed.

d6f8d57e-5b37-5d81-aade-b2a632ad4f5d.name: Fighter
d6f8d57e-5b37-5d81-aade-b2a632ad4f5d.description: Master of martial combat, skilled with a variety of weapons and armor. Hit Die d10. Strength or Dexterity primary; non-caster.

options.label: Chain Mail, Greatsword, Flail, 8 Javelins, Dungeoneer's Pack, 4 GP
Studded Leather, Scimitar, Shortsword, Longbow, 20 Arrows, Quiver, Dungeoneer's Pack, 11 GP

features.name: Fighting Style
features.description: Gain a Fighting Style feat (see "Feats"): Archery, Defense, Great Weapon Fighting, or Two-Weapon Fighting.

features.name: Second Wind
features.description: Bonus Action: regain HP equal to 1d10 + your Fighter level. Number of uses scales (2 at L1, 3 at L4, 4 at L10). Regain on a Short or Long Rest.

features.name: Weapon Mastery
features.description: Use the mastery property of three Simple/Martial weapons. Swap one choice on a Long Rest. More kinds unlock at higher levels.

features.name: Action Surge
features.description: Once per Short/Long Rest, take an additional action on your turn (twice at L17).

features.name: Tactical Mind
features.description: When you fail an ability check, you can spend a Second Wind use (without regaining HP) to roll 1d10 and add it; if it would still fail, no use is consumed.

features.name: Fighter Subclass
features.description: Choose a subclass (Champion in this SRD).

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: Attack twice when you take the Attack action; three times at L11; four times at L20.

features.name: Tactical Shift
features.description: When you Second Wind, also move up to half your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

features.name: Indomitable
features.description: If you fail a saving throw, you can reroll it with a bonus equal to your Fighter level. Once per Long Rest at L9; scales to two uses at L13 and three at L17.

features.name: Studied Attacks
features.description: When you miss a creature, your next attack on that creature before the end of your next turn has Advantage.

features.name: Epic Boon
features.description: Recommended: Boon of Combat Prowess.

features.name: Three Extra Attacks
features.description: Attack four times when you Attack.

features.name: Two Extra Attacks
features.description: You can attack three times when you take the Attack action.

1b8a9f47-edd0-58aa-8c46-bc0049eea29a.name: Monk
1b8a9f47-edd0-58aa-8c46-bc0049eea29a.description: Master of martial arts, harnessing the power of the body in pursuit of physical and spiritual perfection. Hit Die d8. Dexterity-primary, Wisdom-secondary.

features.name: Martial Arts
features.description: While unarmed or using a Monk weapon and not in armor or wielding a Shield, you can use Dex instead of Str for attack/damage; your Martial Arts die replaces the weapon's damage die (d6 at L1, scaling); Bonus Action to make an Unarmed Strike after taking the Attack action.

features.name: Unarmored Defense
features.description: While not in armor and not wielding a Shield, AC = 10 + Dex mod + Wis mod.

features.name: Monk's Focus
features.description: You gain Focus Points equal to your Monk level. Spend Focus on Flurry of Blows, Patient Defense, and Step of the Wind. Regain on a Short or Long Rest.

features.name: Unarmored Movement
features.description: +10 ft. Speed while unarmored, scaling with level.

features.name: Uncanny Metabolism
features.description: When you roll Initiative, you can regain all expended Focus Points. When you do so, roll your Martial Arts die and regain HP = Monk level + the roll. Once per Long Rest.

features.name: Monk Subclass
features.description: Choose a subclass (Warrior of the Open Hand in this SRD).

features.name: Deflect Attacks
features.description: Reaction to reduce the damage from one ranged or melee attack by 1d10 + Dex + Monk level; if reduced to 0 damage and ranged, redirect at a target within 60 ft.

features.name: Slow Fall
features.description: Reaction to reduce falling damage by 5 × Monk level.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: Attack twice when you Attack.

features.name: Stunning Strike
features.description: When you hit with a Monk weapon or Unarmed Strike, spend 1 Focus Point to force the target to make a Con save or be Stunned until the end of your next turn.

features.name: Empowered Strikes
features.description: Your Unarmed Strikes count as magical and you can make their damage Force.

features.name: Evasion
features.description: When you make a Dex save against an effect that does half damage on a success, you take none on a success and half on a failure.

features.name: Acrobatic Movement
features.description: You can move along vertical surfaces and across liquids without falling while you move at least 10 feet.

features.name: Heightened Focus
features.description: Your Flurry of Blows, Patient Defense, and Step of the Wind gain enhanced benefits.

features.name: Perfect Focus
features.description: When you roll Initiative and don't use Uncanny Metabolism, regain Focus Points until you have 4 if you have 3 or fewer.

features.name: Deflect Energy
features.description: Deflect Attacks now applies to spells/effects that deal damage; redirect costs Focus.

features.name: Superior Defense
features.description: Bonus Action to gain Resistance to all damage except Force for 1 minute (cost 3 Focus).

features.name: Body and Mind
features.description: Dex and Wis scores increase by 4, max 25.

5fbc7fd6-cc78-5a39-98e9-5d0b9890ba8b.name: Paladin
5fbc7fd6-cc78-5a39-98e9-5d0b9890ba8b.description: Holy warrior bound to a sacred oath. Hit Die d10. Strength-primary, Charisma-secondary half-caster.

options.label: Chain Mail, Shield, Longsword, 6 Javelins, Holy Symbol, Priest's Pack, 9 GP

features.name: Lay On Hands
features.description: Pool of healing equal to 5 × Paladin level. Spend points one at a time to restore HP or to cure one disease/poison (cost 5).

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: Half-caster on the Paladin list; Charisma is your spellcasting ability; your Holy Symbol is your spellcasting focus.

features.name: Weapon Mastery
features.description: Use the mastery property of two kinds of weapons; swap on a Long Rest.

features.name: Fighting Style
features.description: Gain a Fighting Style feat.

features.name: Paladin's Smite
features.description: Always have Divine Smite prepared (no slot count). When you hit with a Melee weapon or Unarmed Strike, expend a spell slot of any level to deal extra Radiant damage = 2d8 + 1d8 per slot level above 1 (max 5d8).

features.name: Paladin Subclass
features.description: Choose a subclass (Oath of Devotion in this SRD).

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.description: You gain Divine Sense as a base option, plus subclass options. Use Channel Divinity twice per Short Rest.

features.name: Faithful Steed
features.description: You always have Find Steed prepared. You can also cast it once without expending a spell slot, regaining the ability on a Long Rest.

features.name: Aura of Protection
features.description: You and friendly creatures within 10 feet of you gain a bonus to saving throws equal to your Charisma modifier (min +1).

features.name: Abjure Foes
features.description: Once per Long Rest as a Magic action, force creatures of your choice within 60 feet to make a Wisdom save or have the Frightened condition until the end of your next turn (additional save effects at higher levels).

features.name: Aura of Courage
features.description: You and your allies have Immunity to the Frightened condition while in your Aura of Protection.

features.name: Radiant Strikes
features.description: Once per turn, when you hit with a weapon, deal +1d8 Radiant damage.

features.name: Restoring Touch
features.description: Spend Lay On Hands points to also remove charmed/frightened/paralyzed/stunned conditions.

features.name: Aura Expansion
features.description: Aura of Protection range increases to 30 feet.

features.name: Subclass capstone
features.description: Per chosen subclass.

31bb8dfa-8080-565e-b005-0d3bd5e81d4f.name: Ranger
31bb8dfa-8080-565e-b005-0d3bd5e81d4f.description: Warrior of the wilderness skilled at tracking, survival, and primal magic. Hit Die d10. Dexterity-primary, Wisdom-secondary half-caster.

options.label: Studded Leather, Scimitar, Shortsword, Longbow, 20 Arrows, Quiver, Explorer's Pack, 7 GP

features.name: Favored Enemy
features.description: You always have Hunter's Mark prepared and can cast it without a slot a number of times = your Wis mod (min 1) per Long Rest.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: Half-caster on the Ranger list; Wisdom is your spellcasting ability; you use a Druidic Focus.

features.name: Weapon Mastery
features.description: Use the mastery property of two kinds of weapons.

features.name: Deft Explorer
features.description: Gain Expertise in one of your skill proficiencies; learn an extra language. More benefits at higher levels.

features.name: Fighting Style
features.description: Gain a Fighting Style feat.

features.name: Ranger Subclass
features.description: Choose a subclass (Hunter in this SRD).

features.name: Roving
features.description: +5 ft. Speed; you have a Climb Speed and Swim Speed equal to your Speed.

features.name: Expertise
features.description: Choose two skills you're proficient in for Expertise.

features.name: Tireless
features.description: You can grant yourself temporary HP equal to a roll of 1d8 + Wisdom modifier as a Magic action. Number of uses = Wis mod per Long Rest. You also reduce Exhaustion levels on a Short Rest.

features.name: Relentless Hunter
features.description: Damage taken doesn't break your Concentration on Hunter's Mark.

features.name: Nature's Veil
features.description: As a Bonus Action, expend a level 1+ slot to give yourself the Invisible condition until the end of your next turn.

features.name: Feral Senses
features.description: You don't suffer Disadvantage on attacks against unseen creatures within 30 feet.

features.name: Foe Slayer
features.description: Hunter's Mark damage die becomes 1d10. Once on each of your turns you can deal +Wis mod damage to a Hunter's Mark target.

5217f310-6c1a-52b0-8aec-0f8dc3354fe8.name: Rogue
5217f310-6c1a-52b0-8aec-0f8dc3354fe8.description: Scoundrel who uses stealth and trickery to overcome obstacles. Hit Die d8. Dexterity-primary; non-caster (subclass dependent).

options.label: Leather Armor, 2 Daggers, Shortsword, Shortbow, 20 Arrows, Quiver, Thieves' Tools, Burglar's Pack, 8 GP

features.name: Expertise
features.description: Gain Expertise in two of your skill proficiencies. More skills at higher levels.

features.name: Sneak Attack
features.description: Once per turn, deal +1d6 damage to a target you hit with a Finesse or Ranged weapon when you have Advantage on the attack OR when an ally is within 5 feet of the target. Damage scales with level.

features.name: Thieves' Cant
features.description: You know Thieves' Cant and a signed version of it.

features.name: Weapon Mastery
features.description: Use the mastery property of two kinds of weapons.

features.name: Cunning Action
features.description: Bonus Action: Dash, Disengage, or Hide.

features.name: Rogue Subclass
features.description: Choose a subclass (Thief in this SRD).

features.name: Steady Aim
features.description: As a Bonus Action while you haven't moved this turn, give yourself Advantage on your next attack roll this turn; your Speed becomes 0 until the end of the turn.

features.name: Cunning Strike
features.description: When you hit with Sneak Attack, you can spend dice to apply effects (Poison, Trip, Withdraw, etc.).

features.name: Uncanny Dodge
features.description: Reaction: halve the damage of an attack you can see hit you.

features.name: Evasion
features.description: On a Dex save against an area effect, take no damage on success and half on fail.

features.name: Reliable Talent
features.description: Treat any d20 roll of 9 or lower as a 10 on ability checks where you have proficiency.

features.name: Improved Cunning Strike
features.description: Apply two Cunning Strike effects per Sneak Attack.

features.name: Devious Strikes
features.description: New Cunning Strike options: Daze, Knock Out, Obscure.

features.name: Slippery Mind
features.description: Gain proficiency in Wisdom and Charisma saving throws.

features.name: Elusive
features.description: No attack roll has Advantage against you while you're not Incapacitated.

features.name: Stroke of Luck
features.description: Once per Short or Long Rest, treat one missed attack as a hit, or one failed ability check as 20.

1d43b563-d584-5897-afa1-673da5068d23.name: Sorcerer
1d43b563-d584-5897-afa1-673da5068d23.description: Spellcaster who draws on inherent magic from a gift or bloodline. Hit Die d6. Charisma-primary full caster.

options.label: Spear, 2 Daggers, Arcane Focus (Crystal), Dungeoneer's Pack, 28 GP

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: Sorcerer cantrips/spells. Charisma is your casting ability.

features.name: Innate Sorcery
features.description: Bonus Action: gain Advantage on Sorcerer spell attack rolls and increase the save DC by 1 for 1 minute. Number of uses = your Cha mod (min 1) per Long Rest.

features.name: Font of Magic
features.description: Gain Sorcery Points equal to your Sorcerer level. Convert SP ↔ slots: 1→2 SP regen, 2→1 slot at L1, etc.

features.name: Metamagic
features.description: Choose two Metamagic options. Add more at higher levels.

features.name: Sorcerer Subclass
features.description: Choose a subclass (Draconic Sorcery in this SRD).

features.name: Sorcerous Restoration
features.description: Once per Short Rest, recover Sorcery Points (≤ half your Sorcerer level, rounded down).

features.name: Sorcery Incarnate
features.description: You can use Innate Sorcery as a free action when you cast a Sorcerer spell, even when you're out of uses (cost: 2 SP).

features.name: Metamagic (extra)
features.description: Learn an additional Metamagic option.

features.name: Epic Boon
features.description: Recommended: Boon of Spell Recall.

features.name: Arcane Apotheosis
features.description: When you use Innate Sorcery, you can apply one Metamagic option of your choice without expending Sorcery Points.

6757b064-902e-56f6-9b7e-9bbe095c20aa.name: Warlock
6757b064-902e-56f6-9b7e-9bbe095c20aa.description: Wielder of magic granted by a pact with an otherworldly being. Hit Die d8. Charisma-primary pact caster.

options.label: Leather Armor, Sickle, 2 Daggers, Arcane Focus (Orb), Book, Scholar's Pack, 15 GP

features.name: Eldritch Invocations
features.description: Choose two Eldritch Invocations. Add more at higher levels.

features.name: Pact Magic
features.description: Pact spell slots regain on a Short or Long Rest. Number of slots scales (1→4); slot level scales separately. Charisma is your spellcasting ability.

features.name: Magical Cunning
features.description: On a Short Rest, regain expended pact slots equal to half your max (rounded up). Once per Long Rest.

features.name: Warlock Subclass
features.description: Choose a subclass (Fiend Patron in this SRD).

features.name: Pact Boon
features.description: Choose Pact of the Blade, Chain, or Tome.

features.name: Eldritch Master
features.description: You can spend 1 minute to plead with your patron and regain all expended pact slots; once per Long Rest.

features.name: Eldritch Resilience
features.description: Bonus uses of Magical Cunning; resists patron sundering.

149482f3-09f7-5714-a41b-f50e2d43219e.name: Wizard
149482f3-09f7-5714-a41b-f50e2d43219e.description: Scholarly magic-user capable of manipulating the structures of reality. Hit Die d6. Intelligence-primary full caster.

options.label: 2 Daggers, Arcane Focus (Quarterstaff), Robe, Spellbook, Scholar's Pack, 5 GP

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: You know a number of cantrips and prepare wizard spells from your spellbook. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability.

features.name: Ritual Adept
features.description: Cast spells with the Ritual tag without expending a spell slot — even if not prepared, as long as in your spellbook.

features.name: Arcane Recovery
features.description: Once per day after a Short Rest, recover spell slots whose combined level ≤ ½ your wizard level (rounded up); none of those slots can be 6th level or higher.

features.name: Scholar
features.description: Choose Arcana, History, Investigation, Medicine, Nature, or Religion. You gain Expertise in that skill.

features.name: Wizard Subclass
features.description: Choose a subclass (Evoker in this SRD).

features.name: Memorize Spell
features.description: After a Short Rest, replace one prepared wizard spell with another from your spellbook of the same level.

features.name: Spell Mastery
features.description: Choose a level 1 and level 2 wizard spell you have prepared; cast each at lowest level without using a spell slot.

features.name: Epic Boon
features.description: Recommended: Boon of Spell Recall.

features.name: Signature Spells
features.description: Choose two level 3 wizard spells from your spellbook; you always have them prepared and can cast each once without a spell slot per Short or Long Rest.

644107da-1a2c-535b-9e04-488a85bb8daa.name: Path of the Berserker
644107da-1a2c-535b-9e04-488a85bb8daa.description: Barbarians who direct their Rage primarily toward violence. Path of untrammeled fury.

attributes.flavor_description: Channel Rage into Violent Fury. Berserkers thrill in the chaos of battle as they let their Rage seize and empower them.

features.name: Frenzy
features.description: When you Reckless Attack while Raging, deal extra damage to the first target you hit on your turn equal to a number of d6s = your Rage Damage bonus.

features.name: Mindless Rage
features.description: Immune to Charmed and Frightened conditions while Raging. If Charmed/Frightened when entering Rage, the condition ends.

features.name: Retaliation
features.description: When you take damage from a creature within 5 feet, take a Reaction to make one melee attack against it.

features.name: Intimidating Presence
features.description: Bonus Action: each creature of your choice in a 30-ft Emanation makes a Wis save (DC 8 + Str + PB) or is Frightened for 1 minute (saves at end of each turn).

716bb8d8-0e43-596d-be52-4372007ebda1.name: College of Lore
716bb8d8-0e43-596d-be52-4372007ebda1.description: Bards who collect knowledge and weave subtle, witty magic.

attributes.flavor_description: Bards of the College of Lore know something about most things. Their wit is as sharp as their wisdom is broad.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.description: Gain proficiency with three skills of your choice.

features.name: Cutting Words
features.description: Reaction when a creature within 60 feet makes an attack roll, ability check, or damage roll: subtract a Bardic Inspiration die from the result.

features.name: Magical Discoveries
features.description: Learn two spells of your choice from any class's spell list. They count as Bard spells.

features.name: Peerless Skill
features.description: Roll a Bardic Inspiration die and add the result to a single ability check.

f0029e29-8a15-544f-bf70-225b8c6f0410.name: Life Domain
f0029e29-8a15-544f-bf70-225b8c6f0410.description: Clerics devoted to gods of life, healing, and the protection of the innocent.

attributes.flavor_description: The Life Domain focuses on the vibrant positive energy that sustains all life. Its clerics are skilled healers.

features.name: Disciple of Life
features.description: When you cast a level 1+ spell that restores HP, the target regains additional HP = 2 + the spell's level.

features.name: Domain Spells
features.description: You always have prepared a list of bonus spells, scaling with level (Bless, Cure Wounds, Lesser Restoration, Aid, Beacon of Hope, etc.).

features.name: Preserve Life
features.description: Channel Divinity: Magic action — restore 5 × Cleric level HP divided as you choose among creatures within 30 feet (none above half HP).

features.name: Blessed Healer
features.description: When you cast a level 1+ healing spell on others, you regain HP = 2 + the spell's level.

features.name: Supreme Healing
features.description: Whenever you would roll dice to restore HP, treat each die as the maximum value.

cfa166f7-0abd-57d8-be72-0933f4a7d591.name: Circle of the Land
cfa166f7-0abd-57d8-be72-0933f4a7d591.description: Druids drawn to mystical sites such as sacred groves, who safeguard ancient knowledge and rites.

attributes.flavor_description: Members of the Circle of the Land gather within sacred sites to perform rituals beneath the stars.

features.name: Land's Aid
features.description: When you cast a Druid spell of level 1+, you can also restore 1d4 + spell level HP to one creature within 60 feet, or deal 1d4 + spell level Necrotic damage to a creature.

features.name: Circle Forms
features.description: Wild Shape options expanded; you can transform into Beasts of CR ½.

features.name: Land's Stride
features.description: You ignore Difficult Terrain made of nonmagical plants. Magical Difficult Terrain caused by plants requires no save to pass through.

features.name: Nature's Ward
features.description: Immune to the Poisoned condition; gain Resistance to a damage type associated with your current land choice.

features.name: Nature's Sanctuary
features.description: Magic Action: expend Wild Shape to summon protective trees and vines in a 15-foot Cube. You and allies gain Half Cover + your Nature's Ward resistance.

features.name: Circle Spells
features.description: Choose a land (Arctic, Coast, Desert, Forest, Grassland, Mountain, Swamp, Underdark). You learn additional spells associated with that land at levels 3, 5, 7, and 9. They are always prepared.

features.name: Natural Recovery
features.description: Once per day on a Short Rest, you regain expended spell slots whose combined level ≤ half your Druid level (rounded up); none can be 6th level or higher.

dbc4a5e3-2af3-5257-b38e-9206bbac8f9c.name: Champion
dbc4a5e3-2af3-5257-b38e-9206bbac8f9c.description: Fighters who pursue physical perfection through martial training and refinement of body.

attributes.flavor_description: The Champion focuses on raw physical power honed to deadly perfection.

features.name: Improved Critical
features.description: Weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20.

features.name: Remarkable Athlete
features.description: Add half your PB (rounded up) to any Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution check that doesn't already include it.

features.name: Additional Fighting Style
features.description: Choose a second Fighting Style feat.

features.name: Heroic Warrior
features.description: Heroic Inspiration whenever you don't already have it.

features.name: Superior Critical
features.description: Critical hits trigger on 18–20.

features.name: Survivor
features.description: At the start of each of your turns, regain HP = 5 + Con mod if you have at least 1 HP and at most half your HP max.

b23f7297-c6b0-5073-a991-0cafe32a2bdb.name: Warrior of the Open Hand
b23f7297-c6b0-5073-a991-0cafe32a2bdb.description: Monks who specialize in unarmed combat and channel flowing martial techniques.

attributes.flavor_description: Open Hand monks are the ultimate masters of martial-arts combat, harnessing the body and mind in flowing harmony.

features.name: Open Hand Technique
features.description: Whenever you hit with a Martial Arts strike, choose one effect: knock the target prone (Dex save), push the target up to 15 feet (Str save), or impose Disadvantage on its next save (Dex save).

features.name: Wholeness of Body
features.description: As a Bonus Action, restore HP equal to 2 × Monk level (cost 2 Focus). Once per Long Rest.

features.name: Fleet Step
features.description: Bonus Action: take Step of the Wind in addition to making an attack as part of the Attack action.

features.name: Quivering Palm
features.description: When you hit with an Unarmed Strike, spend 4 Focus Points to plant lethal vibrations: target makes a Con save or takes 10d12 Force damage on activation.

c90e91bc-53d2-5de0-afb2-11f35a649b8b.name: Oath of Devotion
c90e91bc-53d2-5de0-afb2-11f35a649b8b.description: Paladins who embody the most idealistic principles of justice, valor, and order.

attributes.flavor_description: The Oath of Devotion binds the paladin to ideals of honesty, courage, compassion, honor, duty, responsibility, and faith.

features.name: Sacred Weapon
features.description: Channel Divinity: Bonus Action to imbue a weapon with positive energy for 1 minute. Add Cha mod to attacks, weapon emits Bright Light.

features.name: Domain Spells
features.description: You always have prepared spells like Protection from Evil and Good, Lesser Restoration, Beacon of Hope, Dispel Magic, Guardian of Faith, Commune.

features.name: Aura of Devotion
features.description: You and friendly creatures within 10 feet can't be Charmed while you're conscious.

features.name: Smite of Protection
features.description: Allies in your Aura of Protection gain Half Cover.

features.name: Holy Nimbus
features.description: Magic action: emit aura of sunlight for 10 minutes. Deal 10 Radiant damage to enemies that start their turn in the aura. Once per Long Rest.

c2679722-0e53-5505-9f44-a7f91d9f204c.name: Hunter
c2679722-0e53-5505-9f44-a7f91d9f204c.description: Rangers who stalk the multiverse's most dangerous predators and protect civilization from monstrous foes.

attributes.flavor_description: A Hunter learns specialized techniques for fighting threats menacing the natural world.

features.name: Hunter's Lore
features.description: When you cast Hunter's Mark on a creature, learn whether it has Resistance/Immunity/Vulnerability to acid/cold/fire/lightning/thunder.

features.name: Hunter's Prey
features.description: Choose Colossus Slayer, Horde Breaker, or Giant Killer.

features.name: Defensive Tactics
features.description: Choose Escape the Horde, Multiattack Defense, or Steel Will.

features.name: Multiattack
features.description: Choose Volley (ranged AoE) or Whirlwind Attack (melee AoE).

features.name: Superior Hunter's Defense
features.description: Choose Evasion, Stand Against the Tide, or Uncanny Dodge.

features.name: Hunter's Strategy
features.description: Each Hunter's Prey, Defensive Tactics, and Multiattack option is now available to you (no choice required).

eaa2778a-68f3-5b3c-920e-167988f8c862.name: Thief
eaa2778a-68f3-5b3c-920e-167988f8c862.description: Rogues who hone skills of stealth, mobility, and the manipulation of magical implements.

attributes.flavor_description: Thieves are versed in the techniques of treasure-hunting, climbing, and reading languages and magic.

features.name: Fast Hands
features.description: Bonus Action: Sleight of Hand check, use Thieves' Tools, take the Use an Object action.

features.name: Second-Story Work
features.description: Climbing speed equal to your Speed; running long jump distance increases by Dex mod.

features.name: Supreme Sneak
features.description: Spend 1 d6 of Sneak Attack to move with unaltered Stealth.

features.name: Use Magic Device
features.description: Ignore class, race, level requirements when using a magic item or scroll.

features.name: Thief's Reflexes
features.description: On the first round of combat, take two turns; the second occurs on Initiative count − 10.

fc2f0ec4-e44f-58b7-b5e8-1b4ec299eeab.name: Draconic Sorcery
fc2f0ec4-e44f-58b7-b5e8-1b4ec299eeab.description: Sorcerers whose innate magic stems from a draconic bloodline.

attributes.flavor_description: Your innate magic stems from the blood of a powerful dragon — your latent power runs in your veins.

features.name: Draconic Resilience
features.description: HP max increases by 3 and by 1 again whenever you gain a Sorcerer level. Your AC = 13 + Dex mod when not wearing armor.

features.name: Draconic Spells
features.description: Choose a damage type from the Draconic Ancestors table; gain bonus prepared spells like Chromatic Orb, Dragon's Breath, Fly, Fireball.

features.name: Elemental Affinity
features.description: When casting a spell with your draconic damage type, add Cha mod to one damage roll. Spend 1 Sorcery Point to gain Resistance to that damage type for 1 hour.

features.name: Dragon Wings
features.description: Bonus Action: sprout dragon wings; gain a Fly Speed equal to your Speed for 1 hour.

features.name: Dragon Companion
features.description: Cast Summon Dragon without expending a slot once per Long Rest; you can dismiss the dragon as a Bonus Action.

features.name: Draconic Presence
features.description: As a Magic action, spend 5 Sorcery Points to project a 60-foot Emanation that imposes Charmed or Frightened on creatures of your choice (Wis save).

ea144fec-ae9c-54eb-8a40-6d19497ec8bb.name: Fiend Patron
ea144fec-ae9c-54eb-8a40-6d19497ec8bb.description: Warlocks bound to a powerful fiend who has clawed its way to a station of greater devil or demon.

attributes.flavor_description: Your patron is a powerful denizen of the Lower Planes — Asmodeus, Baalzebul, or some demon prince.

features.name: Dark One's Blessing
features.description: When you reduce a creature to 0 HP, gain temp HP = Cha mod + Warlock level.

features.name: Fiend Spells
features.description: Bonus prepared spells: Burning Hands, Command, Blindness/Deafness, Scorching Ray, Fireball, Stinking Cloud, Fire Shield, Wall of Fire, Insect Plague, Hallow.

features.name: Dark One's Own Luck
features.description: Add 1d10 to an ability check or saving throw after rolling but before the result. Once per Short or Long Rest.

features.name: Fiendish Resilience
features.description: After a Short or Long Rest, choose a damage type (other than Force); gain Resistance to it until you choose a different one.

features.name: Hurl Through Hell
features.description: When you hit a creature with an attack, use a Reaction to vanish it through Hell: at the start of your next turn it returns to its previous space (or nearest unoccupied) and takes 8d10 Psychic damage. Once per Long Rest.

features.name: Fiendish Vigor
features.description: You always have False Life prepared.

553a38aa-3350-5e57-aec4-97a57f365f43.name: Evoker
553a38aa-3350-5e57-aec4-97a57f365f43.description: Wizards who focus on magic that creates powerful elemental effects.

attributes.flavor_description: Evokers find magic in raw destructive forces — fire, frost, lightning, thunder.

features.name: Evocation Savant
features.description: When you choose a wizard spell to add to your spellbook on level-up, you can add a 2nd Evocation spell of the same level for free.

features.name: Sculpt Spells
features.description: When you cast an Evocation spell affecting an area, choose a number of creatures equal to 1 + the spell's level — those creatures automatically succeed on saves and take no damage.

features.name: Potent Cantrip
features.description: When a creature succeeds on a save against your cantrip, it still takes half damage but no other effect.

features.name: Empowered Evocation
features.description: Add Int mod to one damage roll of any wizard Evocation spell you cast.

features.name: Overchannel
features.description: Cast a level 1–5 wizard spell at maximum damage; suffer Necrotic damage if used again before a Long Rest.

5a92e85d-6855-5843-8602-fc7a473b8948.description: The sphinx emits a magical roar. 9b5f1c14-67f8-5f11-a610-f4f03043df22.name: Second Wind
9b5f1c14-67f8-5f11-a610-f4f03043df22.description: Regain 1d10 + Fighter level HP. Uses recharge on a Short or Long Rest. Number of uses scales with Fighter level (2 at L4, 3 at L10, 4 at L15).

attributes.description: Regain 1d10 + Fighter level HP. Uses recharge on a Short or Long Rest. Number of uses scales with Fighter level (2 at L4, 3 at L10, 4 at L15).

8b9acef5-91f9-5ee1-a5b8-eb4d0fcbc1b9.name: Action Surge
8b9acef5-91f9-5ee1-a5b8-eb4d0fcbc1b9.description: On your turn, take one additional Action (not Bonus Action). One use per Short or Long Rest at L2; two uses at L17.

attributes.description: On your turn, take one additional Action (not Bonus Action). One use per Short or Long Rest at L2; two uses at L17.

71885043-4c8e-50e6-85d1-41ac0b8cc785.name: Bardic Inspiration
71885043-4c8e-50e6-85d1-41ac0b8cc785.description: Choose a creature within 60 feet (other than yourself); they gain a Bardic Inspiration die (d6 at L1, d8 at L5, d10 at L10, d12 at L15). They can roll the die within 10 minutes and add it to one ability check, attack roll, or saving throw — deciding after the d20 but before the result is known. Uses = your Charisma modifier (min 1) per Long Rest.

a2344deb-16a7-5083-8734-d265ba109558.name: Lay on Hands
a2344deb-16a7-5083-8734-d265ba109558.description: Touch a creature and draw from your pool of healing power equal to your Paladin level × 5. You can restore HP, or expend 5 points to end one disease or one Poisoned condition.

attributes.description: Touch a creature and draw from your pool of healing power equal to your Paladin level × 5. You can restore HP, or expend 5 points to end one disease or one Poisoned condition.

b15252e9-9c6b-5ed0-93dc-9c7c7a6e1baf.name: Divine Sense
b15252e9-9c6b-5ed0-93dc-9c7c7a6e1baf.description: Until the end of your next turn, you sense the location of any Celestial, Fiend, or Undead within 60 feet that isn't behind Total Cover, plus the location of any Hallow spell or place consecrated/desecrated by such an effect. Uses = your Charisma modifier (min 1) per Long Rest.

ab6848df-f5af-5c9a-964d-55fba44bf10f.name: Channel Divinity
ab6848df-f5af-5c9a-964d-55fba44bf10f.description: Channel divine energy directly from your deity. Use to fuel a specific Channel Divinity effect granted by your Cleric subclass or by Cleric features (e.g. Turn Undead). Uses scale: 2 at L2, 3 at L6. Recharge on a Short or Long Rest.

9879c3bf-5258-5bd9-9c10-574d5892eea5.name: Turn Undead
9879c3bf-5258-5bd9-9c10-574d5892eea5.description: Each Undead within 30 feet of you that can see or hear you must make a Wisdom save (DC = your Cleric spell save DC). On a failure, the Undead is Frightened of you for 1 minute or until it takes damage. Expends one use of Channel Divinity.

4c209e58-2da0-5fa2-b22e-6f96505a1905.name: Wild Shape
4c209e58-2da0-5fa2-b22e-6f96505a1905.description: Transform into a Beast you have seen (challenge rating per Druid level rules). You retain mental ability scores; physical scores become the Beast's. You can revert as a Bonus Action. Uses recharge on a Short or Long Rest.

cd53ab8c-482e-52db-abc3-af250531de56.name: Flurry of Blows
cd53ab8c-482e-52db-abc3-af250531de56.description: Spend 1 Focus point to make two Unarmed Strikes. Replaces the standard Martial Arts bonus-action Unarmed Strike.

attributes.description: Spend 1 Focus point to make two Unarmed Strikes. Replaces the standard Martial Arts bonus-action Unarmed Strike.

840a7b04-b6bf-53f3-8e5c-42698e678287.name: Patient Defense
840a7b04-b6bf-53f3-8e5c-42698e678287.description: Take the Disengage action. You can also spend 1 Focus point to take both Disengage and Dodge on the same Bonus Action.

attributes.description: Take the Disengage action. You can also spend 1 Focus point to take both Disengage and Dodge on the same Bonus Action.

5a5e8fb2-a4ff-5a78-8695-ef6b7134d528.name: Step of the Wind
5a5e8fb2-a4ff-5a78-8695-ef6b7134d528.description: Take the Dash action. You can spend 1 Focus point to also take the Disengage action, and your jump distance is doubled for the turn.

attributes.description: Take the Dash action. You can spend 1 Focus point to also take the Disengage action, and your jump distance is doubled for the turn.

974d5141-7465-5426-9263-78ab209560b3.name: Hunter's Mark (Class)
974d5141-7465-5426-9263-78ab209560b3.description: Mark a creature you can see within 90 feet. The next time you hit that creature with a weapon attack on your turn, it takes extra 1d6 Force damage. Move the mark as a Bonus Action. Concentration, up to 1 hour.

attributes.description: Mark a creature you can see within 90 feet. The next time you hit that creature with a weapon attack on your turn, it takes extra 1d6 Force damage. Move the mark as a Bonus Action. Concentration, up to 1 hour.

6a176eca-2268-5f8c-9984-58ad2e1a4c91.name: Sorcery Points
6a176eca-2268-5f8c-9984-58ad2e1a4c91.description: Spend Sorcery Points to fuel Metamagic options or to convert into spell slots (and vice versa). Sorcery Point pool = Sorcerer level (refreshes on Long Rest).

attributes.description: Spend Sorcery Points to fuel Metamagic options or to convert into spell slots (and vice versa). Sorcery Point pool = Sorcerer level (refreshes on Long Rest).

71d34983-7cc1-509f-9e5c-c94db0f63d16.name: Eldritch Blast (Class Action)
71d34983-7cc1-509f-9e5c-c94db0f63d16.description: Cantrip-level eldritch energy attack. A beam of crackling energy streaks toward a creature within 120 feet. Ranged spell attack; on a hit, the target takes 1d10 Force damage. Beam count scales with character level.

attributes.description: Cantrip-level eldritch energy attack. A beam of crackling energy streaks toward a creature within 120 feet. Ranged spell attack; on a hit, the target takes 1d10 Force damage. Beam count scales with character level.

83ee0ed8-8567-5993-a4f4-4931eb372cb0.name: Breath Weapon (Dragonborn)
83ee0ed8-8567-5993-a4f4-4931eb372cb0.description: Exhale destructive energy as instinctive magic. Choose a 15-foot Cone or a 30-foot Line (5 ft. wide). Each creature in the area makes a Dexterity save (DC = 8 + Con mod + PB). *Failure:* (5×CharLevel)d10 damage scaled to character tier — see SRD table. *Success:* Half damage. Damage type matches your ancestry (Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Poison).
