516a65a3-7068-5289-b756-a2ba29d8d694.name: Relentless Endurance
516a65a3-7068-5289-b756-a2ba29d8d694.description: When you are reduced to 0 HP but not killed outright, you can drop to 1 HP instead. Once per Long Rest.

attributes.description: When you are reduced to 0 HP but not killed outright, you can drop to 1 HP instead. Once per Long Rest.

9c0314dd-f968-542a-8086-df4a5206b843.name: Adrenaline Rush
9c0314dd-f968-542a-8086-df4a5206b843.description: Take the Dash action and gain Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus. Uses = PB per Short or Long Rest.

attributes.description: Take the Dash action and gain Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus. Uses = PB per Short or Long Rest.

4b331fa9-7163-55db-b81a-90f2792513ba.name: Cloud's Jaunt
4b331fa9-7163-55db-b81a-90f2792513ba.description: Magically teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. Uses = PB per Long Rest.

attributes.description: Magically teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. Uses = PB per Long Rest.

9fd9d7ce-a80a-5a00-ab9b-d9b7b5e29023.name: Hill's Tumble
9fd9d7ce-a80a-5a00-ab9b-d9b7b5e29023.description: When you hit a Large or smaller creature with a melee attack, you can knock the target Prone. Uses = PB per Long Rest.

attributes.description: When you hit a Large or smaller creature with a melee attack, you can knock the target Prone. Uses = PB per Long Rest.

7ff63c7c-268d-5fcf-b6f1-46a1c5bc8e22.name: Stone's Endurance
7ff63c7c-268d-5fcf-b6f1-46a1c5bc8e22.description: When you take damage, roll 1d12 + your Constitution modifier and reduce the damage by that amount. Uses = PB per Long Rest.

attributes.description: When you take damage, roll 1d12 + your Constitution modifier and reduce the damage by that amount. Uses = PB per Long Rest.

77390e98-c901-59bc-b0e4-60e2535f0cc2.name: Storm's Thunder
77390e98-c901-59bc-b0e4-60e2535f0cc2.description: When you take damage from a creature within 60 feet of you, you can deal 1d8 Thunder damage to that creature. Uses = PB per Long Rest.

attributes.description: When you take damage from a creature within 60 feet of you, you can deal 1d8 Thunder damage to that creature. Uses = PB per Long Rest.

da61f2e1-b3ac-5296-93b1-52123c6346c6.name: Fire's Burn
da61f2e1-b3ac-5296-93b1-52123c6346c6.description: When you hit a target with an attack roll and deal damage to it, you can also deal 1d10 Fire damage to that target.

attributes.description: When you hit a target with an attack roll and deal damage to it, you can also deal 1d10 Fire damage to that target.

a9f55de9-05fe-55da-aa54-80022ff765fd.name: Frost's Chill
a9f55de9-05fe-55da-aa54-80022ff765fd.description: When you hit a target with an attack roll and deal damage to it, you can also deal 1d6 Cold damage to that target and reduce its Speed by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.

attributes.description: When you hit a target with an attack roll and deal damage to it, you can also deal 1d6 Cold damage to that target and reduce its Speed by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.

15fffaa6-9427-5861-ba0a-35e3bcaa4b40.name: Draconic Flight
15fffaa6-9427-5861-ba0a-35e3bcaa4b40.description: Starting at character level 5, you can channel draconic magic to give yourself temporary flight. Sprout spectral wings on your back that last for 10 minutes or until you retract them (no action required). During that time, you have a Fly Speed equal to your Speed. Once per Long Rest.

c7ccce4c-715c-5748-b36a-8d51f835d566.name: Cutting Words
c7ccce4c-715c-5748-b36a-8d51f835d566.description: When a creature within 60 feet of you that you can see makes an attack roll, ability check, or damage roll, you can expend one use of Bardic Inspiration and subtract that die's roll from the creature's result.

65358a57-356a-5efc-b078-67899f9f588a.name: Retaliation
65358a57-356a-5efc-b078-67899f9f588a.description: When you take damage from a creature that is within 5 feet of you, you can take a Reaction to make one melee attack against that creature, using a weapon or an Unarmed Strike.

attributes.description: When you take damage from a creature that is within 5 feet of you, you can take a Reaction to make one melee attack against that creature, using a weapon or an Unarmed Strike.

69bf0a03-e23f-5875-b042-d4b117b9523a.name: Intimidating Presence
69bf0a03-e23f-5875-b042-d4b117b9523a.description: Strike terror into others. Each creature of your choice in a 30-foot Emanation originating from you must make a Wisdom save (DC 8 + Str + PB) or have the Frightened condition for 1 minute. Save repeats at end of each turn.

8a39eb8f-e677-5fca-9dfc-eddbd6c9668a.name: Preserve Life
8a39eb8f-e677-5fca-9dfc-eddbd6c9668a.description: Expend one use of Channel Divinity. Present your Holy Symbol and evoke healing energy that can restore HP = 5 × Cleric level. Choose Bloodied creatures within 30 feet and divide HP among them; no creature healed above half maximum.

3b954ed1-9082-5346-9b00-b7ef0f2d1f8e.name: Sacred Weapon
3b954ed1-9082-5346-9b00-b7ef0f2d1f8e.description: Expend one use of Channel Divinity to imbue one Melee weapon you're holding with positive energy. For 10 minutes (or until you use this again), add Cha mod (min +1) to attack rolls with that weapon and it deals Radiant damage instead of its normal type. The weapon emits Bright Light 20 ft + Dim 20 ft.

8d526104-fe76-5ba2-814a-428387ca84a6.name: Abjure Foes
8d526104-fe76-5ba2-814a-428387ca84a6.description: Expend one use of Channel Divinity to overwhelm foes with awe. Target creatures equal to your Cha mod within 60 feet. Each makes a Wisdom save or has Frightened condition for 1 minute or until taking damage. Once per Long Rest.

8be0304d-52d2-5994-8238-924cf48a7f1b.name: Wholeness of Body
8be0304d-52d2-5994-8238-924cf48a7f1b.description: Roll your Martial Arts die. Regain HP equal to the roll + your Wisdom modifier (min 1). Uses = Wis mod per Long Rest.

attributes.description: Roll your Martial Arts die. Regain HP equal to the roll + your Wisdom modifier (min 1). Uses = Wis mod per Long Rest.

5c68a9eb-c2e3-5a9e-a9d9-772bc598f0f0.name: Land's Aid
5c68a9eb-c2e3-5a9e-a9d9-772bc598f0f0.description: Expend one use of Wild Shape. Choose a point within 60 feet; vitality-giving flowers + life-draining thorns appear in a 10-foot-radius Sphere there. Each creature you choose in the sphere makes a Con save: 2d6 Necrotic on fail (half on success). One creature in area regains 2d6 HP. Damage + heal scale with Druid level.

Each creature you choose in the sphere makes a Con save: 2d6 Necrotic on fail (half on success). One creature in area regains 2d6 HP. Damage + heal scale with Druid level.

04548c66-271c-578c-b683-fa318468da32.name: Nature's Sanctuary
04548c66-271c-578c-b683-fa318468da32.description: Expend one use of Wild Shape to summon spectral trees and vines in a 15-foot Cube on the ground within 120 feet. Lasts 1 minute. You + allies in the area gain Half Cover and Resistance to your current land's damage type.

6593d56f-54c7-5c5c-9594-d3c540a82408.name: Dragon Wings
6593d56f-54c7-5c5c-9594-d3c540a82408.description: Cause draconic wings to appear on your back. They last for 1 hour or until you dismiss them (no action required). For the duration, you have a Fly Speed of 60 feet. Once per Long Rest unless you spend 3 Sorcery Points (no action required) to restore the use.

ae788cfa-34a8-59c2-8d93-92aaf6457041.name: Deflect Attacks
ae788cfa-34a8-59c2-8d93-92aaf6457041.description: When an attack roll hits you and the attack deals Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage, you can take a Reaction to reduce the attack's total damage by 1d10 + your Dex modifier + Monk level. If reduced to 0 and ranged, you can spend 1 Focus Point to redirect at a target within 5 ft (melee) or 60 ft (ranged) with a Dex save.

87b3ad05-aa32-5b88-9ff9-fad3aa0ba3cb.name: Slow Fall
87b3ad05-aa32-5b88-9ff9-fad3aa0ba3cb.description: When you fall, you can take a Reaction to reduce any damage you take from the fall by 5 × your Monk level.

attributes.description: When you fall, you can take a Reaction to reduce any damage you take from the fall by 5 × your Monk level.

889ba573-d317-5984-8a9e-0acb3d7489ba.name: Steady Aim
889ba573-d317-5984-8a9e-0acb3d7489ba.description: Give yourself Advantage on your next attack roll on the current turn. You can only use this if you haven't moved during this turn, and after you use it your Speed is 0 until the end of the current turn.

attributes.description: Give yourself Advantage on your next attack roll on the current turn. You can only use this if you haven't moved during this turn, and after you use it your Speed is 0 until the end of the current turn.

7f5dda98-cd5f-5b27-b0b5-db25c6301d86.name: Uncanny Dodge
7f5dda98-cd5f-5b27-b0b5-db25c6301d86.description: When an attacker that you can see hits you with an attack roll, you can take a Reaction to halve the attack's damage against you (round down).

attributes.description: When an attacker that you can see hits you with an attack roll, you can take a Reaction to halve the attack's damage against you (round down).

e3b9d4d3-9cb6-58a4-9246-8119dedaeec3.name: Fast Hands
e3b9d4d3-9cb6-58a4-9246-8119dedaeec3.description: Take one of the following: Sleight of Hand (Dex check to pick a lock or disarm a trap with Thieves' Tools or pick a pocket); or Use an Object (take the Utilize action, or take the Magic action to use a magic item that requires that action).

attributes.description: Take one of the following: Sleight of Hand (Dex check to pick a lock or disarm a trap with Thieves' Tools or pick a pocket); or Use an Object (take the Utilize action, or take the Magic action to use a magic item that requires that action).

a3487309-cacf-5482-acce-c9251765bdbd.name: Cunning Action
a3487309-cacf-5482-acce-c9251765bdbd.description: Take the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action as a Bonus Action.

attributes.description: Take the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action as a Bonus Action.

fe103f1c-e583-5cfe-a38c-68f3ad47f9e7.name: Aboleth
fe103f1c-e583-5cfe-a38c-68f3ad47f9e7.description: An ancient aberration that lurks in lightless seas and underground lakes. The aboleth despises all other intelligent life and uses its psychic abilities to enslave them. Once a creature is enslaved by the aboleth, it can't willingly disobey the aboleth's telepathic commands.

d9d6ea40-b45d-5ac9-a8cd-e7a93d9623bb.name: Goblin Warrior
d9d6ea40-b45d-5ac9-a8cd-e7a93d9623bb.description: A small, sneaky humanoid that lives in dark places. Goblins band together in raucous warbands.

42b319c7-2f35-5e72-a265-a770f5d7e845.name: Skeleton
42b319c7-2f35-5e72-a265-a770f5d7e845.description: A ghastly thing of bones, animated by dark magic. Skeletons lurk in old tombs and ruins, awaiting the bidding of their masters.

3d6f64ef-1ca3-57d9-8320-c6ed33091b89.name: Zombie
3d6f64ef-1ca3-57d9-8320-c6ed33091b89.description: A reanimated corpse, slow and relentless. Zombies serve necromancers and vile priests as cheap labor and front-line fodder.

9368e6ee-21c5-5eaf-bbbd-6190dddb3c5e.name: Adult Red Dragon
9368e6ee-21c5-5eaf-bbbd-6190dddb3c5e.description: A colossal scarlet wyrm whose mere presence radiates menace. Adult red dragons are the most fearsome of true dragons, ruling vast volcanic territories and hoarding mountains of treasure beneath their caves.

9eb8851c-a6ac-51e7-af0b-9f7144bafee2.name: Lich
9eb8851c-a6ac-51e7-af0b-9f7144bafee2.description: An archmage who has cheated death by binding their soul to a phylactery. Liches pursue secrets of magic across centuries, undeterred by the loss of their flesh.

fcd6c66e-bb4e-5094-8abd-b7d4ab555123.name: Beholder
fcd6c66e-bb4e-5094-8abd-b7d4ab555123.description: A floating spheroid aberration with a great central eye and ten smaller eyes on stalks, each producing a different magical ray. Beholders are paranoid masters of underground lairs.

134ba2a3-b224-5faa-a94e-8e6dd7ccfa6e.name: Mind Flayer
134ba2a3-b224-5faa-a94e-8e6dd7ccfa6e.description: A four-tentacled humanoid aberration with a head like a violet octopus. Mind flayers feed on the brains of sapient creatures and rule subterranean colonies through psychic enslavement.

63a66a8f-3e48-5aa5-903d-feaf212964ab.name: Ogre
63a66a8f-3e48-5aa5-903d-feaf212964ab.description: A hulking, dim-witted giant that pillages, kidnaps, and devours. Ogres revere strength and cruelty above all else.

6182a1f2-4261-5ed6-8ecb-6f0aa3b71c29.name: Owlbear
6182a1f2-4261-5ed6-8ecb-6f0aa3b71c29.description: A monstrous predator with the body of a bear and the head and feathers of an owl. Owlbears are fierce, territorial, and impossible to tame.

07157747-3cfb-5785-83d0-f5b1c1b83447.name: Hobgoblin Warrior
07157747-3cfb-5785-83d0-f5b1c1b83447.description: A martial humanoid that wages war with disciplined precision. Hobgoblin warbands operate as professional soldiers under strict chains of command.

a25d4596-427b-51ca-a1f1-ae2dcb1474ba.name: Bandit
a25d4596-427b-51ca-a1f1-ae2dcb1474ba.description: A brigand who haunts roads and ruins, preying on travelers. Bandits work in gangs led by a captain or thug.

a03ad7d3-7d53-5d65-a8c4-f870aed6f307.name: Giant Spider
a03ad7d3-7d53-5d65-a8c4-f870aed6f307.description: A horse-sized arachnid that lurks in caves, jungle canopies, and the corners of haunted ruins. Its venom paralyzes prey.

836e0306-4d6b-5907-a84d-ce0b7c8bcf07.name: Kobold Warrior
836e0306-4d6b-5907-a84d-ce0b7c8bcf07.description: A small reptilian humanoid that lives in tribes and traps. Kobolds favor ambushes and mob attacks.

10327b7a-fba5-577b-ac2d-35e276a73838.name: Orc
10327b7a-fba5-577b-ac2d-35e276a73838.description: A bestial humanoid raider, savage and warlike. Orcs roam in war bands and worship gods of conquest.

a0b6ace8-f5e2-5421-aa40-e8401babe6e8.name: Gnoll
a0b6ace8-f5e2-5421-aa40-e8401babe6e8.description: A vicious hyena-headed humanoid that hunts in packs and feasts on the slain.

82801cf4-305d-5fef-b05d-2fc8bfe54e06.name: Bugbear Warrior
82801cf4-305d-5fef-b05d-2fc8bfe54e06.description: A stealthy goblinoid brute that strikes from ambush. Bugbears combine size with cunning.

a7d4e3b8-ee42-5ddd-b734-e137bd02ca25.name: Drow
a7d4e3b8-ee42-5ddd-b734-e137bd02ca25.description: A black-skinned, white-haired elf of the Underdark, schooled in stealth, poison, and cruel magic.

b91e610b-2b6d-5dcc-8c7c-001628175c5a.name: Werewolf
b91e610b-2b6d-5dcc-8c7c-001628175c5a.description: A humanoid cursed with lycanthropy, transforming under the moon into a savage wolf-beast.

cfd987cb-eacf-5eae-820f-a0f3147982d5.name: Troll
cfd987cb-eacf-5eae-820f-a0f3147982d5.description: A gangly, rubbery-skinned giant whose flesh regenerates from wounds unless seared with fire or acid.

12d93751-f47e-5c9f-b712-124b10bb618f.name: Hydra
12d93751-f47e-5c9f-b712-124b10bb618f.description: A serpentine monstrosity with five heads. When one is severed, two grow in its place unless cauterized.

3fac964c-3ba4-5b49-aa4a-1e1832d921bd.name: Vampire
3fac964c-3ba4-5b49-aa4a-1e1832d921bd.description: An undead lord that drinks the blood of the living. Vampires command the night, with shapechanging powers and dread mental dominance.

6b3d5e87-0b94-5308-b60c-a3deb78ac6ec.name: Balor
6b3d5e87-0b94-5308-b60c-a3deb78ac6ec.description: A massive demon wreathed in flame, wielding a flaming whip and a lightning sword. The most fearsome of the demons that haunt the Abyss.

ffc666da-06e5-5fb6-acb0-547f626d8dc2.name: Pit Fiend
ffc666da-06e5-5fb6-acb0-547f626d8dc2.description: The supreme commanders of the Nine Hells' armies. Pit fiends are devils of cunning malevolence and crushing power.

f531a1df-c7ce-5709-94a3-7bcf39eeac98.name: Air Elemental
f531a1df-c7ce-5709-94a3-7bcf39eeac98.description: A whirling vortex of wind summoned from the Plane of Air, dissolving solid forms with raging gusts.

87909958-cd0c-5b3e-9947-011183706bb5.name: Earth Elemental
87909958-cd0c-5b3e-9947-011183706bb5.description: A walking mass of stone and earth from the Plane of Earth, slow but devastating in its blows.

1afbba07-a1e9-5986-bc0a-31b6b1138939.name: Fire Elemental
1afbba07-a1e9-5986-bc0a-31b6b1138939.description: A mass of writhing flame summoned from the Elemental Plane of Fire, igniting all it touches.

b19cc122-959a-5533-878e-4a1afb5d3ef5.name: Water Elemental
b19cc122-959a-5533-878e-4a1afb5d3ef5.description: A torrent of conscious water summoned from the Elemental Plane of Water, drowning enemies in its grip.

f7faf165-6308-5ebc-8339-cf9fde1a33fb.name: Ghoul
f7faf165-6308-5ebc-8339-cf9fde1a33fb.description: A flesh-eating undead with a hunger for the dead and dying. Its claws can paralyze with a touch.

492ec78b-7904-5226-83bd-1dc28178e69b.name: Wight
492ec78b-7904-5226-83bd-1dc28178e69b.description: A malevolent undead that drains the life from the living. Once a mortal who chose darkness over death.

4012cfc4-098c-59b7-8fa7-d710a2ec96bf.name: Specter
4012cfc4-098c-59b7-8fa7-d710a2ec96bf.description: The incorporeal spirit of a soul filled with hatred for the living, draining life with its chilling touch.

e3b1a629-3067-5e4f-b802-05745f687326.name: Animated Armor
e3b1a629-3067-5e4f-b802-05745f687326.description: An empty suit of armor brought to life by magic, defending its master's home with relentless violence.

608ee807-047e-5408-a1e8-fdb285a537e7.name: Stone Giant
608ee807-047e-5408-a1e8-fdb285a537e7.description: A reclusive giant of mountain caverns, hurling boulders with uncanny precision.

0ba237ef-6a4f-58dd-bcf4-e07dd0697e6a.name: Hill Giant
0ba237ef-6a4f-58dd-bcf4-e07dd0697e6a.description: A simple-minded brute that lumbers across hills and lowlands, smashing villages and herds for its supper.

9f4037d2-b65e-5a66-9cb6-5c6e3ac0a6e0.name: Manticore
9f4037d2-b65e-5a66-9cb6-5c6e3ac0a6e0.description: A flying monstrosity with a lion's body, bat wings, a man's face, and a tail full of lethal spikes.

59a26e98-a0e3-5fa6-8476-f6202c7a03bf.name: Minotaur
59a26e98-a0e3-5fa6-8476-f6202c7a03bf.description: A bull-headed warrior bound to ancestral mazes. The minotaur charges its prey with deadly horns.

bbb77520-f417-5ccc-b057-0c1f4158dc89.name: Basilisk
bbb77520-f417-5ccc-b057-0c1f4158dc89.description: An eight-legged reptilian monstrosity whose gaze can turn flesh to stone.

cb90ec5a-f4c0-5ffe-8e32-83d4fe9690ce.name: Cockatrice
cb90ec5a-f4c0-5ffe-8e32-83d4fe9690ce.description: A scaled rooster-like creature whose bite can slowly turn the living to stone.

3a5c3377-a031-506a-b693-9dd36a3a7ccb.name: Ettin
3a5c3377-a031-506a-b693-9dd36a3a7ccb.description: A two-headed giant cousin to ogres, ill-tempered and always squabbling with itself.

1fb5c358-13e5-547a-b9bd-5fed633ca593.name: Harpy
1fb5c358-13e5-547a-b9bd-5fed633ca593.description: A foul-tempered creature with a woman's torso and a vulture's wings. Its song lures victims to their doom.

d612995f-2211-5df6-a961-579b885892fe.name: Will-o'-Wisp
d612995f-2211-5df6-a961-579b885892fe.description: A pale, glowing orb that drifts through swamps and battlefields, draining the life of those who follow.

e460fc43-12a1-5049-8bdc-0810ee4a3d89.name: Mummy
e460fc43-12a1-5049-8bdc-0810ee4a3d89.description: An ancient corpse wrapped in funeral linen, animated by foul magic to guard a tomb or ruin.

86285784-468d-5012-ac7e-6a2cfe71aa45.name: Treant
86285784-468d-5012-ac7e-6a2cfe71aa45.description: An ancient awakened tree-being that protects forests and remembers all who pass beneath its branches.

56186d71-d6cf-59a0-8283-ea7010163a00.name: Adult Black Dragon
56186d71-d6cf-59a0-8283-ea7010163a00.description: A cruel chromatic dragon that dwells in fetid swamps and ruined keeps. Its breath is a deadly stream of acid.

97695bbd-dd43-572e-989f-56b2f22ab248.name: Adult Blue Dragon
97695bbd-dd43-572e-989f-56b2f22ab248.description: A territorial chromatic dragon that rules deserts and arid plains. Its breath is a crackling line of lightning.

06abab57-e12f-5c79-a9a4-3fea237c32e2.name: Adult Green Dragon
06abab57-e12f-5c79-a9a4-3fea237c32e2.description: A cunning chromatic dragon of deep forests. Its poisonous breath corrupts everything it touches.

df51ade0-2cbe-528b-b180-4fe7289858c1.name: Adult White Dragon
df51ade0-2cbe-528b-b180-4fe7289858c1.description: A primitive chromatic dragon of glaciers and frozen peaks. Vicious and territorial.

81fab357-f20f-5a59-afa1-a6546310c62e.name: Chuul
81fab357-f20f-5a59-afa1-a6546310c62e.description: A horrid lobster-like aberration that lurks in submerged ruins serving ancient masters.

c3264bef-98bd-53a3-8f87-7faa921248ea.name: Otyugh
c3264bef-98bd-53a3-8f87-7faa921248ea.description: A foul, three-legged aberration that lairs in middens, sewers, and refuse heaps.

a00953c0-ff20-5a52-a60b-0bfaef0e5314.name: Roper
a00953c0-ff20-5a52-a60b-0bfaef0e5314.description: A predatory aberration that perfectly mimics a stalagmite or stalactite, snaring prey with sticky tendrils.

e1116274-83a6-5855-9a95-d6c9b3519681.name: Nothic
e1116274-83a6-5855-9a95-d6c9b3519681.description: A grotesque, one-eyed aberration cursed by failed magical ambition. It hoards arcane secrets.

79951f75-e9da-579f-8082-b3efe9cc11ed.name: Dryad
79951f75-e9da-579f-8082-b3efe9cc11ed.description: A fey spirit bound to a single tree. Beautiful and reclusive, dryads protect their forest homes.

20c12038-0b65-5984-b809-e9b083e038ac.name: Gargoyle
20c12038-0b65-5984-b809-e9b083e038ac.description: A grotesque stone-skinned elemental, often perched motionless on rooftops awaiting the chance to attack.

44f649e9-2fe4-5021-bf5c-5f815ab5da7b.name: Couatl
44f649e9-2fe4-5021-bf5c-5f815ab5da7b.description: A divine, feathered serpent — a benevolent celestial guardian created by the gods to watch over the world.

5f45df66-b48f-5c44-bb43-d4ee9e5e348c.name: Sphinx
5f45df66-b48f-5c44-bb43-d4ee9e5e348c.description: A guardian celestial with the body of a great cat and the head of a wise being. Sphinxes pose riddles to those they encounter.

f63519dc-e27a-5598-ba9b-18d80c256997.name: Death Dog
f63519dc-e27a-5598-ba9b-18d80c256997.description: A two-headed dog that prowls deserts and ruins, infecting bite victims with a wasting disease.

0da4f42d-6d20-5311-9f3a-ca31cc26ecab.name: Knight
0da4f42d-6d20-5311-9f3a-ca31cc26ecab.description: A heavily armored warrior bound by a code of chivalry to serve a noble lord, faith, or ideal.

d2a01479-f7b0-54f4-8f6f-c8965691cdb2.name: Veteran
d2a01479-f7b0-54f4-8f6f-c8965691cdb2.description: A seasoned mercenary fighter, hard-bitten and skilled with sword and crossbow.

8ae30c18-8f18-509a-acd4-495d9a73bfa2.name: Gladiator
8ae30c18-8f18-509a-acd4-495d9a73bfa2.description: A celebrated arena fighter — equal parts warrior, performer, and crowd-pleaser.

c762ef71-ddc3-5a4e-be08-5eefaf3365b1.name: Mage
c762ef71-ddc3-5a4e-be08-5eefaf3365b1.description: A wizard versed in evocation and divination, often serving as advisor to nobles or kings.

9acad329-e641-5c6e-9cbc-7b5286d3e7d0.name: Priest
9acad329-e641-5c6e-9cbc-7b5286d3e7d0.description: A devout cleric who serves a deity and ministers to a flock — and, when called upon, fights for the faith.

7ea3c627-193b-5512-bd01-d80446de8553.name: Cult Fanatic
7ea3c627-193b-5512-bd01-d80446de8553.description: A zealous priest of a dark cause, willing to commit any atrocity in the name of their cause.

dc8a4ac0-d1f0-5937-91f0-a06bf382612e.name: Spy
dc8a4ac0-d1f0-5937-91f0-a06bf382612e.description: An information-gatherer trained to deceive and infiltrate. Skilled in stealth and disguise.

eea2b1b8-ac48-5cba-be7b-2a85460eccaa.name: Assassin
eea2b1b8-ac48-5cba-be7b-2a85460eccaa.description: A trained killer schooled in stealth, poisons, and the precise placement of a blade.

145151d4-a340-555c-9887-d998d31513ba.name: Black Dragon Wyrmling
145151d4-a340-555c-9887-d998d31513ba.description: A young black dragon, recently hatched. Cunning and cruel from birth.

2e37e5e5-8425-5e08-b101-eed53adf3156.name: Blue Dragon Wyrmling
2e37e5e5-8425-5e08-b101-eed53adf3156.description: A young blue dragon, hatched in arid wastes.

a921fa27-5da6-5f1c-af95-74e77e687767.name: Brass Dragon Wyrmling
a921fa27-5da6-5f1c-af95-74e77e687767.description: A small metallic dragon prone to chatter.

b359e3e4-a957-5e06-9c47-79fe98ff4760.name: Bronze Dragon Wyrmling
b359e3e4-a957-5e06-9c47-79fe98ff4760.description: A young bronze dragon with a love for storms.

e45afb3b-a280-52c0-aae4-19a1638de05e.name: Gold Dragon Wyrmling
e45afb3b-a280-52c0-aae4-19a1638de05e.description: The youngest and most regal of metallic dragons.

41b0ff0f-4b88-52a8-bdb5-7bf5317f7609.name: Green Dragon Wyrmling
41b0ff0f-4b88-52a8-bdb5-7bf5317f7609.description: A young green dragon, treacherous from hatching.

f1b951e4-6094-56e9-ac5a-82d53a7a1002.name: Red Dragon Wyrmling
f1b951e4-6094-56e9-ac5a-82d53a7a1002.description: A young red dragon brimming with arrogance and fire.

744baff0-4071-5ee8-adfe-0b80d2236905.name: Silver Dragon Wyrmling
744baff0-4071-5ee8-adfe-0b80d2236905.description: A noble metallic dragon hatchling, kindly and curious.

2a63b730-1755-571d-a606-4e4c12731949.name: White Dragon Wyrmling
2a63b730-1755-571d-a606-4e4c12731949.description: A young white dragon, savage and slow-witted.

6442fcd4-31a9-5590-9ee0-ff33de8ffd81.name: Young Black Dragon
6442fcd4-31a9-5590-9ee0-ff33de8ffd81.description: An adolescent black dragon claiming a swamp lair.

c8307b64-11b2-52d3-996d-f167db6d52cc.name: Young Blue Dragon
c8307b64-11b2-52d3-996d-f167db6d52cc.description: An adolescent blue dragon ruling a desert canyon.

99725787-ea9d-59de-a1c1-8590b05cc694.name: Young Brass Dragon
99725787-ea9d-59de-a1c1-8590b05cc694.description: An adolescent brass dragon, garrulous and sociable.

01cbda46-ba70-5253-b9b5-1d253364a8d7.name: Young Bronze Dragon
01cbda46-ba70-5253-b9b5-1d253364a8d7.description: An adolescent bronze dragon, vigilant against evil.

2fb9f29f-9db4-5511-bd54-5109696034f0.name: Young Copper Dragon
2fb9f29f-9db4-5511-bd54-5109696034f0.description: An adolescent copper dragon prone to mischief.

d36c7391-3d9a-5d63-b78d-ed5f44ff3f1d.name: Young Gold Dragon
d36c7391-3d9a-5d63-b78d-ed5f44ff3f1d.description: An adolescent gold dragon of noble bearing.

60f3b61a-58f7-57d8-864c-3ffc9a38c458.name: Young Green Dragon
60f3b61a-58f7-57d8-864c-3ffc9a38c458.description: An adolescent green dragon prowling primeval forests.

ee47d2d8-e37e-5749-96df-515aca074cc3.name: Young Red Dragon
ee47d2d8-e37e-5749-96df-515aca074cc3.description: An adolescent red dragon, prideful and brutal.

d14169be-8a06-5ba2-bb39-e7381ec087cd.name: Young Silver Dragon
d14169be-8a06-5ba2-bb39-e7381ec087cd.description: An adolescent silver dragon, kindly and noble.

6a8ba7be-6c5a-5f7a-9924-f4b9e02506ad.name: Young White Dragon
6a8ba7be-6c5a-5f7a-9924-f4b9e02506ad.description: An adolescent white dragon, savage hunter of frozen wastes.

4bdec92b-b659-5ee6-9e95-da34fc2f050c.name: Adult Brass Dragon
4bdec92b-b659-5ee6-9e95-da34fc2f050c.description: A garrulous metallic dragon ruling sun-baked deserts.

26d9c242-3d12-507a-8790-cd68a5e29255.name: Adult Bronze Dragon
26d9c242-3d12-507a-8790-cd68a5e29255.description: A noble metallic dragon, defender of coastlines.

5b9562f7-60a7-5721-b40a-cb0afd75f400.name: Adult Copper Dragon
5b9562f7-60a7-5721-b40a-cb0afd75f400.description: A trickster metallic dragon, master of sardonic humor.

a692723d-31d6-5fe4-8a9b-f795bb3bb4ca.name: Adult Gold Dragon
a692723d-31d6-5fe4-8a9b-f795bb3bb4ca.description: A regal metallic dragon, foe of evil tyranny.

4851092a-6c5d-5351-8d8c-2e0cf0ac03de.name: Adult Silver Dragon
4851092a-6c5d-5351-8d8c-2e0cf0ac03de.description: A noble metallic dragon, friend of mortals.

b959ce49-0280-53ba-bd36-a91a4863bf20.name: Ancient Black Dragon
b959ce49-0280-53ba-bd36-a91a4863bf20.description: An ancient black dragon ruling fetid swamps for centuries.

b485accf-8bb8-5205-a297-d895490cc79a.name: Ancient Blue Dragon
b485accf-8bb8-5205-a297-d895490cc79a.description: An ancient blue dragon, tyrant of arid lands.

1d76cfda-acef-5a98-86c9-f7b61c01d8c5.name: Ancient Brass Dragon
1d76cfda-acef-5a98-86c9-f7b61c01d8c5.description: An ancient brass dragon, sage of the desert wastes.

c7c97fdc-8017-53e9-a013-5d1991ab8625.name: Ancient Bronze Dragon
c7c97fdc-8017-53e9-a013-5d1991ab8625.description: An ancient bronze dragon, scourge of pirates and tyrants.

d7e249e9-fff3-5b46-9352-c85d81696288.name: Ancient Copper Dragon
d7e249e9-fff3-5b46-9352-c85d81696288.description: An ancient copper dragon, master of riddles and stone.

a6e92bbb-4664-5caf-afdb-cb17170174f5.name: Ancient Gold Dragon
a6e92bbb-4664-5caf-afdb-cb17170174f5.description: An ancient gold dragon, paragon of just causes.

87daee60-dbf0-5267-8a1e-2c2025a0fd3e.name: Ancient Green Dragon
87daee60-dbf0-5267-8a1e-2c2025a0fd3e.description: An ancient green dragon, manipulative tyrant of forests.

3ae89ccc-7bbe-5581-b7e2-4850b9af96c7.name: Ancient Red Dragon
3ae89ccc-7bbe-5581-b7e2-4850b9af96c7.description: An ancient red dragon, supreme tyrant of fire and pride.

a0c725d1-a7db-5b55-8903-f3890590ac80.name: Ancient Silver Dragon
a0c725d1-a7db-5b55-8903-f3890590ac80.description: An ancient silver dragon, age-wise mentor of dragonkind.

437ef2f8-1a07-5ea7-8fe7-0d57aed243c7.name: Ancient White Dragon
437ef2f8-1a07-5ea7-8fe7-0d57aed243c7.description: An ancient white dragon, primeval terror of the frozen wastes.

74241053-ed07-5e09-8b83-8e5986a5ed0d.name: Archmage
74241053-ed07-5e09-8b83-8e5986a5ed0d.description: A peerless wizard, advisor to royalty or master of a tower.

a43a54cc-c77d-5333-9ebe-23e9b882355d.name: Bandit Captain
a43a54cc-c77d-5333-9ebe-23e9b882355d.description: A swashbuckling brigand leading a gang of cutthroats.

bb1b0965-addb-5e91-8e9f-4136868b6bac.name: Berserker
bb1b0965-addb-5e91-8e9f-4136868b6bac.description: A frenzied warrior who fights with reckless abandon.

f5ba3610-4166-5037-a1a4-7153e1e1b147.name: Commoner
f5ba3610-4166-5037-a1a4-7153e1e1b147.description: An ordinary villager — farmer, cooper, or laborer.

db49a82d-7a93-518b-a82f-84a0cbfaca28.name: Cultist
db49a82d-7a93-518b-a82f-84a0cbfaca28.description: A devotee of dark powers, willing to spill blood in their name.

eb92113b-4e1d-57c2-928a-245f06be7cf6.name: Cultist Fanatic
eb92113b-4e1d-57c2-928a-245f06be7cf6.description: A zealous devotee, far more dangerous than ordinary cultists.

70584c90-8065-554b-831b-17ef45ce468a.name: Druid
70584c90-8065-554b-831b-17ef45ce468a.description: A spellcaster of the wilds, channeling primordial nature magic.

341293ff-c0c0-5460-9854-9df80d0f3eb2.name: Guard
341293ff-c0c0-5460-9854-9df80d0f3eb2.description: A sworn watchman patrolling town gates and noble courts.

39f3fea6-412b-50b0-9f8b-b24bc9f06581.name: Guard Captain
39f3fea6-412b-50b0-9f8b-b24bc9f06581.description: A veteran officer commanding city watch or castle garrison.

9c3655b7-4e7f-567a-a587-e49a45b4e7c7.name: Hobgoblin Captain
9c3655b7-4e7f-567a-a587-e49a45b4e7c7.description: A goblinoid commander leading hobgoblin troops with iron discipline.

5fd6074f-5f1e-5c81-a5f1-225c0781dd9b.name: Noble
5fd6074f-5f1e-5c81-a5f1-225c0781dd9b.description: An aristocrat — by blood, status, or fortune.

d182b83f-6b3f-588e-93a1-576df2a18320.name: Pirate
d182b83f-6b3f-588e-93a1-576df2a18320.description: A buccaneer of the high seas, equally at home in rigging or tavern brawl.

8fdfb796-73e4-5c0c-9a37-cacb2d9bffeb.name: Pirate Captain
8fdfb796-73e4-5c0c-9a37-cacb2d9bffeb.description: A swashbuckling raider commanding a vessel and crew.

a4a78a71-a4e8-5763-b018-f0177a8bbee3.name: Priest Acolyte
a4a78a71-a4e8-5763-b018-f0177a8bbee3.description: A junior cleric of a temple, devoted to a chosen deity.

38ceb039-a584-54c2-bfaa-81ec1ef79ab6.name: Sahuagin Warrior
38ceb039-a584-54c2-bfaa-81ec1ef79ab6.description: A shark-like aquatic raider lurking in coral reefs.

27234147-9f76-5c25-a28e-d260807bf25d.name: Scout
27234147-9f76-5c25-a28e-d260807bf25d.description: A skilled tracker and ranger of wilderness paths.

4dc1ff12-87b8-5d07-b919-47c805905765.name: Warrior Infantry
4dc1ff12-87b8-5d07-b919-47c805905765.description: A trained soldier in shield wall or column.

fd1407b8-0c12-50ab-9598-3f1cd46da0f5.name: Warrior Veteran
fd1407b8-0c12-50ab-9598-3f1cd46da0f5.description: A seasoned campaigner, sergeant or lieutenant of the line.

18623ba8-cb7c-5899-8abf-c860444efa90.name: Tough
18623ba8-cb7c-5899-8abf-c860444efa90.description: A bare-knuckle brawler or street thug.

aaff35b6-5dd0-5384-872c-c2ebeaa0178f.name: Tough Boss
aaff35b6-5dd0-5384-872c-c2ebeaa0178f.description: The leader of a gang of toughs, larger and meaner than the rest.

6080e6ce-6ae9-5c2d-8876-53b3e95177e6.name: Bugbear Stalker
6080e6ce-6ae9-5c2d-8876-53b3e95177e6.description: A bugbear leader, master of ambush and butchery.

3f8fbf18-c520-5e9e-8934-2fb80c6bc98f.description: The mightiest of angels, paragons of celestial radiance.

3c2db35a-bdfa-5ee0-93c4-944f4951096b.name: Planetar
3c2db35a-bdfa-5ee0-93c4-944f4951096b.description: A righteous angelic warrior of the upper planes.

e8aa8538-1386-5669-bffd-5829f3383f7c.name: Deva
e8aa8538-1386-5669-bffd-5829f3383f7c.description: A messenger angel that carries the will of the gods.

80e55285-9799-57e5-97da-706b2e94371e.name: Sphinx of Lore
80e55285-9799-57e5-97da-706b2e94371e.description: A guardian sphinx that prizes ancient knowledge above all.

3a17fa71-5867-511b-9b65-88739ab00aa6.name: Sphinx of Valor
3a17fa71-5867-511b-9b65-88739ab00aa6.description: A guardian sphinx that defends sacred sites with strength and prowess.

69a77234-5392-5af4-91a1-194ef79fc3b5.name: Sphinx of Wonder
69a77234-5392-5af4-91a1-194ef79fc3b5.description: A small playful sphinx, herald of curiosity and mystery.

69d25edf-726b-526c-b27b-b1956e60990a.name: Spirit Naga
69d25edf-726b-526c-b27b-b1956e60990a.description: An evil naga whose spite burns long after its body has been slain.

e8ccc6fe-f25c-54d6-a81c-ede67ed989fb.name: Sprite
e8ccc6fe-f25c-54d6-a81c-ede67ed989fb.description: A tiny fey scout, armed with shortbow and heart-detection.

de2c1f3c-b961-56f8-989b-8185839d44c8.name: Tarrasque
de2c1f3c-b961-56f8-989b-8185839d44c8.description: A legendary apocalyptic beast capable of leveling cities.

be6d0a28-08d0-5222-bb27-8bf225cc81a7.name: Troll Limb
be6d0a28-08d0-5222-bb27-8bf225cc81a7.description: A severed troll limb that continues to fight on its own.

9a9e4902-c98a-5e9c-938d-cffce2ee4cbd.name: Unicorn
9a9e4902-c98a-5e9c-938d-cffce2ee4cbd.description: A horse-shaped celestial steed that aids the worthy in fey forests.

d06dabd9-b17e-5dfe-abe1-6488bd6f84b0.name: Violet Fungus
d06dabd9-b17e-5dfe-abe1-6488bd6f84b0.description: A purple-streaked fungus that lashes with rotting tentacles.

973882bf-95b8-59c5-8243-bec2b13197f2.name: Winter Wolf
973882bf-95b8-59c5-8243-bec2b13197f2.description: A large arctic wolf with a frigid breath weapon.

b0b04eba-4313-5b6b-9392-926482b6c754.name: Worg
b0b04eba-4313-5b6b-9392-926482b6c754.description: An evil wolflike beast that hunts goblins and other creatures.

261314a2-817d-54b7-90c7-6f5b9e3c0a5b.name: Wyvern
261314a2-817d-54b7-90c7-6f5b9e3c0a5b.description: A two-legged dragonkin with a venomous stinger tail.

360d6b96-09dc-5beb-8036-616caa794297.name: Xorn
360d6b96-09dc-5beb-8036-616caa794297.description: A three-armed earth elemental that devours gems and metals.

aa21a53f-a54f-51ec-ac0e-25d036c8dbd1.name: Banshee
aa21a53f-a54f-51ec-ac0e-25d036c8dbd1.description: The vengeful spirit of an elf maiden cursed to wail at the moment of death.

bb712577-d7bd-5297-a87d-395bdf6bba8c.name: Pixie
bb712577-d7bd-5297-a87d-395bdf6bba8c.description: A diminutive sprite of mischief and protection, no taller than a hand.

7118c0c7-ff25-5ac8-94c9-aad1afe25209.name: Wolf
7118c0c7-ff25-5ac8-94c9-aad1afe25209.description: A swift hunter with a haunting howl. Wolves run in packs and use coordination to bring down prey larger than themselves.

54b6669d-722f-5d48-904e-4bc5a3408fd8.name: Giant Eagle
54b6669d-722f-5d48-904e-4bc5a3408fd8.description: A noble raptor of mountain heights, larger than a horse and intelligent enough to speak in Auran and Common.

1f12c56d-2e07-539c-923a-044c2532cba9.name: Dire Wolf
1f12c56d-2e07-539c-923a-044c2532cba9.description: A wolf as large as a riding horse, with a shaggy coat and bone-crushing jaws. Dire wolves run in packs and are favored mounts of goblin chiefs.

d6afbf6b-91c1-5fc6-9354-890d4c6e2c06.name: Tiger
d6afbf6b-91c1-5fc6-9354-890d4c6e2c06.description: A solitary apex predator of jungles and grasslands. The tiger stalks prey from cover, then pounces with terrible speed.

c8b15b78-3def-55b5-b429-822b61bf9bf6.name: Lion
c8b15b78-3def-55b5-b429-822b61bf9bf6.description: The royal predator of the savanna, hunting in coordinated prides. A lion charges from cover and uses its weight to pin prey.

8631746c-bf20-58a1-8f0e-359996169c18.name: Crocodile
8631746c-bf20-58a1-8f0e-359996169c18.description: A scaled ambush predator of rivers and swamps, dragging its prey beneath the water to drown.

e5313c0a-d6d6-53d8-ab11-3af67e5f250e.name: Boar
e5313c0a-d6d6-53d8-ab11-3af67e5f250e.description: A bristly forest pig with sharp tusks. Boars charge straight at threats and gore them with surprising power.

1f49b37c-fd3b-51f0-bb7c-d901a4ebaf4c.name: Mastiff
1f49b37c-fd3b-51f0-bb7c-d901a4ebaf4c.description: A large hunting hound, loyal and fierce. Mastiffs are favored as guard dogs and battlefield companions.

33b57a44-11d2-5f48-9994-4d31c4f531b5.name: Riding Horse
33b57a44-11d2-5f48-9994-4d31c4f531b5.description: A common steed bred for endurance and steadiness in travel. Most adventurers acquire one for the road.

ee9f7680-c513-57e3-aec5-5ef2f7cb4b36.name: Cat
ee9f7680-c513-57e3-aec5-5ef2f7cb4b36.description: A common house cat, swift and aloof.

e708893b-8363-5534-8cc3-7f59d305e642.name: Rat
e708893b-8363-5534-8cc3-7f59d305e642.description: A small disease-carrying rodent of city sewers and old grain stores.

97b9075e-59a4-5b90-b9f1-bf0b0fd77b62.name: Giant Rat
97b9075e-59a4-5b90-b9f1-bf0b0fd77b62.description: A wolf-sized rodent with mangy fur and yellowed teeth, found in dungeons and sewers.

0485dab5-cfdc-5a9e-8168-6f7f27b8c90e.name: Hawk
0485dab5-cfdc-5a9e-8168-6f7f27b8c90e.description: A small raptor with keen eyes, common to many lands.

33f0c190-6534-5e1b-81a3-1902fd02e4b1.name: Eagle
33f0c190-6534-5e1b-81a3-1902fd02e4b1.description: A keen-eyed bird of prey of mountains and open lands.

796c4359-487e-5377-9fe6-2d77089e75ed.name: Owl
796c4359-487e-5377-9fe6-2d77089e75ed.description: A nocturnal raptor that hunts in silence.

e45e16c4-fbf2-563e-8cbb-9e455ad63edc.name: Pony
e45e16c4-fbf2-563e-8cbb-9e455ad63edc.description: A small horse breed favored by halflings and gnomes.

cb19c5a8-e914-591b-a1f4-26c7f81c4223.name: Camel
cb19c5a8-e914-591b-a1f4-26c7f81c4223.description: A hardy desert beast of burden capable of many days without water.

24608d16-fc71-5699-8e15-758ecea4927b.name: Elephant
24608d16-fc71-5699-8e15-758ecea4927b.description: A massive grass-eating mammal that defends its herd with charging tusks.

8c38cd22-67a4-5371-96f7-f7f30dd82ef3.name: Ape
8c38cd22-67a4-5371-96f7-f7f30dd82ef3.description: A great forest ape that lives in family bands and defends its territory with thrown rocks.

c71d0684-2178-500b-a53c-b028a2a2d6c2.name: Constrictor Snake
c71d0684-2178-500b-a53c-b028a2a2d6c2.description: A large serpent that subdues prey by squeezing it to death.

2b6b5ab6-6bff-5115-afee-d29fbad17fac.name: Giant Constrictor Snake
2b6b5ab6-6bff-5115-afee-d29fbad17fac.description: An enormous serpent capable of crushing the largest prey.

f840270d-167f-58f1-9a59-0dbab772c927.name: Frog
f840270d-167f-58f1-9a59-0dbab772c927.description: A small amphibian found in marshes and ponds.

61dc0cba-408b-56ae-80ba-17b4f63348df.name: Giant Frog
61dc0cba-408b-56ae-80ba-17b4f63348df.description: A horse-sized frog that lurks in fetid pools, swallowing prey whole.

090445ad-09f5-598f-bed4-3001ae2bab42.name: Giant Centipede
090445ad-09f5-598f-bed4-3001ae2bab42.description: A car-sized arthropod with venomous bite, lurking in dark caves.

e3041f70-f5b5-5bbb-a918-67aa6fd1c707.name: Giant Lizard
e3041f70-f5b5-5bbb-a918-67aa6fd1c707.description: A donkey-sized reptile, often used as a mount or beast of burden in the Underdark.

b26fc771-f5bc-583c-a29e-2f3537ed4bb9.name: Polar Bear
b26fc771-f5bc-583c-a29e-2f3537ed4bb9.description: A massive white bear of arctic regions, hunting seals and the unwary.

af3c60fa-82e4-5533-992d-7c3c599c945e.name: Warhorse
af3c60fa-82e4-5533-992d-7c3c599c945e.description: A heavy horse trained for battle, faster and more aggressive than a riding horse.

1f811bb6-645b-5cf1-8475-4e78299e4be3.name: Octopus
1f811bb6-645b-5cf1-8475-4e78299e4be3.description: A small cephalopod with sucker-tipped tentacles, capable of squeezing through the smallest gaps.

0cfd7e4c-f8b9-5a87-ae1f-4719cc072713.name: Brown Bear
0cfd7e4c-f8b9-5a87-ae1f-4719cc072713.description: A massive omnivore that wanders forests and mountain slopes, defending its territory with savage claws and a punishing bite.

10ffb657-386e-546c-b214-897d65a66146.name: Tyrannosaurus Rex
10ffb657-386e-546c-b214-897d65a66146.description: A colossal apex predator dinosaur with massive jaws and surprisingly small forelimbs.

e3c4a9d4-4a14-53aa-9b7c-f5fefcfc2466.name: Triceratops
e3c4a9d4-4a14-53aa-9b7c-f5fefcfc2466.description: A heavy-bodied herbivorous dinosaur with three horns and a bony frill protecting its neck.

adb82270-3fda-5fee-a757-965cd1433be3.name: Allosaurus
adb82270-3fda-5fee-a757-965cd1433be3.description: A swift bipedal predator dinosaur, smaller than a tyrannosaurus but no less savage.

3d61e6b6-e464-5011-9654-854359f23fc4.name: Pteranodon
3d61e6b6-e464-5011-9654-854359f23fc4.description: A flying reptile with a long beak and a wingspan greater than a Medium humanoid is tall.

32d759e1-9426-5c6e-a1c5-ca9ff7a03614.name: Plesiosaurus
32d759e1-9426-5c6e-a1c5-ca9ff7a03614.description: A long-necked aquatic reptile that hunts the deep waters of prehistoric seas.

4910ab96-ac10-5adc-bc2a-97f72f9287fc.name: Mammoth
4910ab96-ac10-5adc-bc2a-97f72f9287fc.description: A great shaggy elephant of cold climates, with massive curved tusks.

89882ba6-837f-57e2-9488-117cc477e3b7.name: Rhinoceros
89882ba6-837f-57e2-9488-117cc477e3b7.description: A great herbivore with a single horn, known for an aggressive charge.

de2fda82-e7dc-5821-ae56-ed6a0b57d9c6.name: Killer Whale
de2fda82-e7dc-5821-ae56-ed6a0b57d9c6.description: A large oceanic apex predator. Despite the name, killer whales are intelligent and social.

3bda4056-ceab-5d06-9832-7380e98661d5.name: Stirge
3bda4056-ceab-5d06-9832-7380e98661d5.description: A bat-winged blood-drinking parasite the size of a small bird.

c8b87c04-34e2-5d11-8ddf-467b00fe5d19.name: Giant Crab
c8b87c04-34e2-5d11-8ddf-467b00fe5d19.description: A crab the size of a large dog, with massive crushing claws.

a9c1beed-7003-5ab3-88d6-f61ed6a9b9e7.name: Giant Octopus
a9c1beed-7003-5ab3-88d6-f61ed6a9b9e7.description: A massive cephalopod hunting in coastal seas.

939082ac-ca00-5cec-94ed-605ef70a4ebf.name: Giant Shark
939082ac-ca00-5cec-94ed-605ef70a4ebf.description: A 30-foot apex predator of the deep, scenting prey miles away.

58dfa7dc-29a1-5e06-8da8-04ab070b02c4.name: Hunter Shark
58dfa7dc-29a1-5e06-8da8-04ab070b02c4.description: A solitary deep-water shark, dangerous and aggressive.

c3f5afbf-e443-5967-8fc4-60bc5bb1e55f.name: Reef Shark
c3f5afbf-e443-5967-8fc4-60bc5bb1e55f.description: A smaller predatory shark of warm coastal waters, often hunting in groups.

4511fe67-ee6d-50fc-909a-40fb59919ca8.name: Quipper
4511fe67-ee6d-50fc-909a-40fb59919ca8.description: A small carnivorous fish that hunts in vicious swarms.

7a7a7762-c98f-51e2-a8d5-c1874114af9f.name: Swarm of Bats
7a7a7762-c98f-51e2-a8d5-c1874114af9f.description: A cloud of fluttering bats moves and attacks as a single creature.

3bea159f-31d5-5691-b449-ef1dc72b9f35.name: Swarm of Insects
3bea159f-31d5-5691-b449-ef1dc72b9f35.description: A horde of biting, stinging, or burrowing insects acts as one creature.

e43cc610-0eb4-5471-ae0d-58db5e528849.name: Swarm of Rats
e43cc610-0eb4-5471-ae0d-58db5e528849.description: A boiling mass of rats — small, fast, and dangerous in numbers.

c5252869-aea0-5226-85a8-e860631322a6.name: Swarm of Quippers
c5252869-aea0-5226-85a8-e860631322a6.description: A school of carnivorous fish that strips prey to bone in moments.

8bbfc60e-a4e3-5e12-8d9a-314669e2615c.name: Vulture
8bbfc60e-a4e3-5e12-8d9a-314669e2615c.description: A scavenging bird with keen eyes and a strong beak.

77ad259b-3c5d-5d9f-99cd-1a94ff87a639.name: Ankylosaurus
77ad259b-3c5d-5d9f-99cd-1a94ff87a639.description: A massive armored herbivorous dinosaur with a heavy clubbed tail.

7a132d26-5a04-52a0-b778-7f588c4e7dfa.name: Archelon
7a132d26-5a04-52a0-b778-7f588c4e7dfa.description: An immense prehistoric sea turtle with a hardened shell.

d63254ef-8ff2-5fc6-ae22-5d85cd94cd62.name: Baboon
d63254ef-8ff2-5fc6-ae22-5d85cd94cd62.description: A medium primate with sharp teeth and quick reflexes that travels in troops.

a89c85a2-8061-525f-b63f-d01796e14420.name: Badger
a89c85a2-8061-525f-b63f-d01796e14420.description: A small burrowing mammal with strong claws and a tenacious bite.

81d713dc-1698-52fd-bcd1-c65eb9f0a212.name: Bat
81d713dc-1698-52fd-bcd1-c65eb9f0a212.description: A flying mammal that navigates using echolocation.

dd8dea1a-8514-51d0-afd6-dc162d3d65c5.name: Black Bear
dd8dea1a-8514-51d0-afd6-dc162d3d65c5.description: A medium-sized bear common in forested regions, fierce when threatened.

48fa89af-6d20-5e9d-bb81-0275f22e6158.name: Blood Hawk
48fa89af-6d20-5e9d-bb81-0275f22e6158.description: A predatory bird that hunts in flocks for prey larger than itself.

29b4b6e0-1720-583b-adea-bbc4649d3b50.name: Crab
29b4b6e0-1720-583b-adea-bbc4649d3b50.description: A small crustacean common in coastal areas.

22bb6988-f32d-5485-a93a-1bc35cf717b3.name: Deer
22bb6988-f32d-5485-a93a-1bc35cf717b3.description: A graceful hoofed mammal common in woodlands.

7c2c56fe-3250-5ed6-8e75-0007cf214c29.name: Draft Horse
7c2c56fe-3250-5ed6-8e75-0007cf214c29.description: A large working horse bred for hauling.

dd0198b0-ef4c-5ce6-8045-b3e21d1eb442.name: Elk
dd0198b0-ef4c-5ce6-8045-b3e21d1eb442.description: A large deer with imposing antlers, capable of charging foes.

fcc3372c-a2f0-5671-91ae-e2b968737bfa.name: Flying Snake
fcc3372c-a2f0-5671-91ae-e2b968737bfa.description: A small winged serpent with venomous fangs.

bf753035-e6f6-571e-86bf-9ad856ad62c3.name: Giant Ape
bf753035-e6f6-571e-86bf-9ad856ad62c3.description: A massive primate of jungle and mountain, capable of hurling boulders.

34eb9a09-faaa-5893-92a9-12d984dd5e83.name: Giant Badger
34eb9a09-faaa-5893-92a9-12d984dd5e83.description: An oversized badger that burrows aggressively.

7bfc4534-353e-5734-98e6-d57612c48876.name: Giant Bat
7bfc4534-353e-5734-98e6-d57612c48876.description: A bat the size of a large dog, hunting in caves.

473c00da-511e-5fac-9a44-6d8843595dc2.name: Giant Boar
473c00da-511e-5fac-9a44-6d8843595dc2.description: A massive wild pig with razor-sharp tusks and a savage charge.

bfe58af5-45c1-5224-88c1-cae0b730a5a9.name: Giant Crocodile
bfe58af5-45c1-5224-88c1-cae0b730a5a9.description: A monstrous reptile of riverbeds and swamps.

91251a15-344d-5f16-969b-c8986fbddda9.name: Giant Elk
91251a15-344d-5f16-969b-c8986fbddda9.description: An enormous elk with majestic antlers and incredible speed.

067250f0-2c3e-591d-88de-cc1a73209604.name: Giant Fire Beetle
067250f0-2c3e-591d-88de-cc1a73209604.description: A glowing beetle that sheds light from luminescent glands.

79b46f85-633d-5b90-913b-9f4d7648ea56.name: Giant Goat
79b46f85-633d-5b90-913b-9f4d7648ea56.description: A massive goat capable of charging foes.

c11aa016-8249-50c9-9285-b58f3c6939ad.name: Giant Hyena
c11aa016-8249-50c9-9285-b58f3c6939ad.description: A monstrous hyena with bone-crushing jaws.

2c726db8-240f-554a-87a4-a7688c234038.name: Giant Owl
2c726db8-240f-554a-87a4-a7688c234038.description: A wise giant owl that speaks Common, Elvish, and Sylvan.

d4d3a52d-8835-571c-8bbb-780cb6f7bb32.name: Giant Scorpion
d4d3a52d-8835-571c-8bbb-780cb6f7bb32.description: A massive armored arachnid with deadly venom in its tail.

4a2f7ebb-9845-56b3-a8b9-147e43103f4d.name: Giant Seahorse
4a2f7ebb-9845-56b3-a8b9-147e43103f4d.description: An enormous seahorse capable of charging through water.

bcba26bc-756d-50b7-bd02-9ac6298dd5a7.name: Giant Spider
bcba26bc-756d-50b7-bd02-9ac6298dd5a7.description: A horse-sized arachnid that spins enormous webs and ambushes prey.

6832c4ba-477b-57f9-ba81-fb0ed4c74b47.name: Giant Toad
6832c4ba-477b-57f9-ba81-fb0ed4c74b47.description: A massive toad that swallows prey whole.

b67f7b37-0b30-5e2e-af91-11987ff9f78c.name: Giant Venomous Snake
b67f7b37-0b30-5e2e-af91-11987ff9f78c.description: A constrictor-sized serpent with deadly venom.

ca305d18-1db4-56b3-83bd-f21cf46e522c.name: Giant Vulture
ca305d18-1db4-56b3-83bd-f21cf46e522c.description: An enormous scavenger bird with limited intelligence.

1d2ca123-5c09-50fa-a1b8-fc730e0dcc54.name: Giant Wasp
1d2ca123-5c09-50fa-a1b8-fc730e0dcc54.description: A horse-sized wasp with a paralyzing sting.

e9d59cac-a340-5875-924c-55fc6861560c.name: Giant Weasel
e9d59cac-a340-5875-924c-55fc6861560c.description: A wolf-sized weasel with a quick bite.

60462e0c-5ba6-55cf-8728-c56780bcca95.name: Giant Wolf Spider
60462e0c-5ba6-55cf-8728-c56780bcca95.description: A wolf-sized hunting spider with venomous fangs.

cad5fab7-f87e-58d5-9931-2ba13560ad71.name: Hippopotamus
cad5fab7-f87e-58d5-9931-2ba13560ad71.description: A massive semi-aquatic mammal with bone-crushing jaws.

4bfa9b4d-da03-5020-b868-6fe4e005b7ee.name: Hyena
4bfa9b4d-da03-5020-b868-6fe4e005b7ee.description: A scavenging carnivore that hunts in cackling packs.

a56e5d47-377f-54ed-ba9d-1d55fb6dab81.name: Jackal
a56e5d47-377f-54ed-ba9d-1d55fb6dab81.description: A small wild canine that scavenges in groups.

215c3fef-cff2-5f13-8a45-f47c5570f0d9.name: Lizard
215c3fef-cff2-5f13-8a45-f47c5570f0d9.description: A small reptile common in warm climates.

2ae89429-48d3-575d-a637-c69b6fbf4df6.name: Mule
2ae89429-48d3-575d-a637-c69b6fbf4df6.description: A sturdy hybrid pack animal, common as a beast of burden.

1f37c8ca-f414-5ef0-9658-189e4180a321.name: Panther
1f37c8ca-f414-5ef0-9658-189e4180a321.description: A sleek black predator that ambushes prey from above.

4f1e22d6-6055-5930-9419-93a1dcd8b2a2.name: Piranha
4f1e22d6-6055-5930-9419-93a1dcd8b2a2.description: A toothy fish notorious for swarming prey.

5f1a121d-60c7-5a81-bfe9-83e0cda253aa.name: Raven
5f1a121d-60c7-5a81-bfe9-83e0cda253aa.description: A clever black bird capable of mimicking sounds.

7acd0c2c-0b94-50be-b678-92068b521679.name: Saber-Toothed Tiger

dd38325e-c75f-52ff-88b2-bc68f94d4ac5.name: Bag of Holding
dd38325e-c75f-52ff-88b2-bc68f94d4ac5.description:
This bag has an interior space considerably larger than its outside dimensions, roughly 2 feet in diameter at the mouth and 4 feet deep. The bag can hold up to 500 pounds, not exceeding a volume of 64 cubic feet. The bag weighs 15 pounds, regardless of its contents. Retrieving an item from the bag requires a Utilize action.

If the bag is overloaded, pierced, or torn, it ruptures and is destroyed; its contents are scattered in the Astral Plane. If the bag is turned inside out, its contents spill forth, unharmed; the bag must be put right before it can be used again. Placing a bag of holding inside an extradimensional space (Bag of Holding, Portable Hole, Handy Haversack) immediately destroys both items and opens a gate to the Astral Plane.

e479d418-316e-5762-935f-6aa3707ee13d.description:
This wand has 7 charges. While holding it, you can use a Magic action to expend 1 or more of its charges to cast Magic Missile from it. For 1 charge, cast the level 1 version. You can increase the slot level by one for each additional charge expended.

The wand regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the wand's last charge, roll a d20. On a 1, the wand crumbles into ashes and is destroyed.

f71baf4e-01ca-54ee-a6be-468142cd32b7.name: Ring of Spell Storing
f71baf4e-01ca-54ee-a6be-468142cd32b7.description:
This ring stores spells cast into it, holding them until the attuned wearer uses them. The ring can store up to 5 levels worth of spells at a time. When found, it contains 1d6 − 1 levels of stored spells chosen by the GM.

Any creature can cast a spell of level 1–5 into the ring by touching it. The spell has no effect; it is stored. If the ring can't hold the spell, it is expended without effect. The wearer can cast a stored spell using its spell save DC, slot level, and spell attack bonus. Casting it from the ring requires no Material components, removes it from the ring, and frees up its capacity.

• Cure Wounds (1 charge per spell level, up to level 4)
• Lesser Restoration (2 charges)
• Mass Cure Wounds (5 charges)

The staff regains 1d6 + 4 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the last charge, roll a d20. On a 1, the staff vanishes in a flash of light, lost forever.

312cc4e2-d501-58af-8172-e83a3e7b2238.name: Sword of Sharpness
312cc4e2-d501-58af-8172-e83a3e7b2238.description:
When you attack an object with this magic Slashing weapon and hit, maximize your weapon damage dice against the target.

When you attack a creature with this weapon and roll a 20 on the attack roll, that target takes an extra 4d6 Slashing damage. Then roll another d20. If you roll a 20, you lop off one of the target's limbs, with the effect of such loss determined by the GM. If the creature has no limb to sever, you lop off a portion of its body instead.

In addition, you can speak the sword's command word to cause the blade to shed Bright Light in a 10-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 10 feet. Speaking the command word again or sheathing the sword puts out the light.

407470cc-c3b9-5b17-aee5-8f56d3f0dd87.name: Vorpal Sword
407470cc-c3b9-5b17-aee5-8f56d3f0dd87.description:
You gain a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. In addition, the weapon ignores Resistance to Slashing damage.

When you attack a creature that has at least one head with this weapon and roll a 20 on the attack roll, you cut off one of the creature's heads. The creature dies if it can't survive without the lost head. A creature is immune to this effect if it has Legendary Actions, lacks or doesn't need a head, or the GM decides that the creature is too big for its head to be cut off. Otherwise you can decapitate it with this attack.

The boots regain 2 hours of flying capability for every 12 hours they aren't in use.

b2e7a4b2-a2ce-5f78-a6bd-605b9d04aa6f.name: Spell Scroll
b2e7a4b2-a2ce-5f78-a6bd-605b9d04aa6f.description:
A Spell Scroll bears the words of a single spell, written in a mystical cipher. If the spell is on your spell list, you can cast it from the scroll without having to provide any Material components. Otherwise the scroll is unintelligible.

If the spell is of a level higher than you can normally cast, you must make an ability check using your spellcasting ability to determine whether you cast it successfully (DC = 10 + spell's level). On a failed check, the spell disappears with no other effect.

Once the spell is cast, the words on the scroll fade and the scroll itself crumbles to dust. The level of the spell on the scroll determines its rarity, save DC, attack bonus, and gold value (Cantrip = Common, Level 1 = Common, Level 2-3 = Uncommon, Level 4-5 = Rare, Level 6-7 = Very Rare, Level 8-9 = Legendary).

Applying the oil takes 10 minutes. The affected creature then gains the effect of a Freedom of Movement spell for 8 hours.

a7f15114-a8bc-569d-9c3f-bd635f5346a2.description: While wearing this cloak, you have Advantage on Dex (Stealth) checks. In an area of Dim Light or Darkness, you can grip the edges of the cloak with both hands and use it to fly at a Speed of 40 feet. If you ever fail to grip the cloak's edges, or you are no longer in Dim Light or Darkness, you lose this Fly Speed. While wearing the cloak in an area of Dim Light or Darkness, you can take a Magic action to cast Polymorph on yourself, transforming into a Bat. While in this form you retain your Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores.

f186343a-a41c-5581-86ad-86293b7fa30d.description: Inside this heavy cloth bag are 3d4 dry beans. You can take a Magic action to remove a bean and throw it up to 10 feet. After 1 minute, the bean produces a magical effect determined by rolling on a table provided in the SRD (effects range from a useful Treant to a calamitous earthquake). If you dump the bag's contents on the ground, the beans burst forth in a 30-foot-radius eruption.

a13d1440-99e7-576e-9b9c-7a62ebf2fe35.name: Bag of Tricks (Gray)
a13d1440-99e7-576e-9b9c-7a62ebf2fe35.description: This ordinary-looking bag, made from gray cloth, appears empty. Reaching inside, however, retrieves a small fuzzy object. You can take a Magic action to pull the object from the bag and throw it up to 20 feet. When the object lands, it transforms into a creature determined by rolling a d8 (Weasel, Giant Rat, Badger, Boar, Panther, Giant Badger, Dire Wolf, Giant Elk). The creature is friendly to you and your companions, and acts on your turn. The creature exists for 1 hour, until it drops to 0 HP, or until you dismiss it. The bag has 3 charges, regaining 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn.

8f00bb60-22ac-5fdf-810f-b3b725aa7fc2.description: This prism has 50 charges. While you are holding it, you can take a Magic action to speak one of three command words to cause one of the following effects. The gem can't be recharged. *Light:* Speaking the first command word causes the gem to shed Bright Light in a 30-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 30 feet. *Bright Beam:* Speaking the second command word expends 1 charge and causes the gem to fire a brilliant beam of light at one creature within 60 feet of you. The creature must succeed on a DC 15 Con save or have the Blinded condition for 1 minute. *Blinding Cone:* Speaking the third command word expends 5 charges and causes the gem to flare with blinding light in a 30-foot Cone originating from it. Each creature in the Cone must make the same saving throw.

6924009c-23fb-5a49-9e53-45cedc0cbc4b.description: You can take a Magic action to blow this horn, which emits a thunderous blast in a 30-foot Cone. Each creature in the Cone must make a DC 15 Con save: 5d6 Thunder damage and Deafened 1 minute on a fail, half damage on a success. A creature made of inorganic material such as stone, crystal, or metal has Disadvantage on this save. A nonmagical object that isn't worn or carried also takes the damage if in the Cone. Once the horn has been used, it can't be used again until the next dawn. If you blow the horn 4 or more times before the next dawn, there is a 20% chance that it explodes, dealing 10d6 Force damage to you.

fdff6471-7d81-5983-a348-ed453271f77a.description: While wearing this ring, you can take a Magic action to have the Invisible condition. You remain Invisible until the ring is removed, until you attack or cast a spell, or until you take a Bonus Action to become visible again.

If you have any unfinished business in life, your soul inhabits the ring and remains until your business is concluded.

When you hit a Dragon with this weapon, the Dragon takes an extra 3d6 damage of the weapon's type. For the purpose of this weapon, "Dragon" refers to any creature with the Dragon creature type.

The flames last until you use a Bonus Action to speak the command word again or until you drop or sheathe the sword.

You and all Celestials, Fey, and Humanoids in the aura have Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects. If the sword has 17 or more levels, the aura's radius increases to 30 feet.

e700f291-b116-5146-a37e-1a3819b352d5.description: You can take a Magic action to place these shackles on an Incapacitated creature. The shackles adjust to fit Small to Large creatures. 305c6efa-88d6-5a69-8b2d-47df61fc1e4d.name: Robe of Scintillating Colors
305c6efa-88d6-5a69-8b2d-47df61fc1e4d.description: This robe has 3 charges, and it regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn. While you wear it, you can take a Magic action and expend 1 charge to cause the garment to display a swirling pattern of dazzling colors until the end of your next turn. During this time, the robe sheds Bright Light in a 30-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 30 feet. Creatures that can see you have Disadvantage on attack rolls against you. In addition, any creature in the Bright Light that can see you when the robe's power is activated must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom save or have the Stunned condition until the effect ends.

On a fail, you and each creature within 15 feet of you travel to a random destination determined by rolling on the planar table.

ed003ccd-ded2-5503-a398-475c3d8035f2.description: This bag superficially resembles a Bag of Holding but is a feeding orifice for a gigantic extradimensional creature. The bag can hold up to 64 cubic feet of matter; once a Medium creature or 30 cubic feet of matter is placed inside, the bag swallows the contents and transports them to a random plane of existence; the bag is destroyed in the process.

The cube regains 1d3 charges daily at dawn.

The sword then hovers in your space and attacks one creature within 5 feet on each of your turns, using your attack roll and ability modifier. The sword has 4 rounds of independent action; after that, it falls to your space, or you can grasp it before it falls. While the sword hovers, you can't attack with it.

Anything in physical contact with the illusion reveals it to be an illusion. Otherwise, the illusion can act and appear convincing.

04d0c882-4355-57e9-a897-3e001ab5d694.description: A fine black cloth that unfolds into a 6-foot-diameter circle. As a Magic action, you can place it on a horizontal surface, where it forms a two-way portal to another world or plane of existence. Each time you use it, the destination is random unless you set the destination by spending 1 hour focused on a specific known plane. Closing the portal requires lifting the cloth.

8bba52a8-8b1c-5951-a2aa-8384bf048e23.name: Berserker Axe
8bba52a8-8b1c-5951-a2aa-8384bf048e23.description: You have a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. While attuned, your HP maximum increases by 1 for each level you have. Curse: while attuned, you have Disadvantage on attack rolls with weapons other than this axe, unless no foe is within 60 feet of you that you can see or hear. Whenever a creature damages you while you are wielding the axe, you must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom save or go berserk: until the start of your next turn, you must take the Attack action against the creature nearest to you.

149eccbb-acbb-5960-b263-0b2be0106df0.name: Candle of Invocation
149eccbb-acbb-5960-b263-0b2be0106df0.description:
This candle's magic is activated when the candle is lit, which requires a Magic action. After burning for 4 hours, the candle is destroyed. You can snuff it out early for use at a later time. Deduct the time it burned in increments of 1 minute from its total burn time.

While lit, the candle sheds Dim Light in a 30-foot radius. While you are within that light, you have Advantage on D20 Tests. In addition, a Cleric or Druid in the light can cast level 1 spells they have prepared without expending spell slots.

Alternatively, when you light the candle for the first time, you can cast *Gate* with it. Doing so destroys the candle. The portal created by the spell links to a particular Outer Plane chosen by the GM or determined by rolling on the following table.

| 1d100 | Outer Plane    |
|-------|----------------|
| 01–05 | Abyss          |
| 06–10 | Acheron        |
| 11–17 | Arborea        |
| 18–25 | Arcadia        |
| 26–33 | Beastlands     |
| 34–41 | Bytopia        |
| 42–46 | Carceri        |
| 47–54 | Elysium        |
| 55–59 | Gehenna        |
| 60–64 | Hades          |
| 65–69 | Limbo          |
| 70–77 | Mechanus       |
| 78–85 | Mount Celestia |
| 86–90 | Nine Hells     |
| 91–95 | Pandemonium    |
| 96–00 | Ysgard         |

255286a4-36a6-5a1a-b482-73a86bc4d4e7.name: Cloak of Arachnida
255286a4-36a6-5a1a-b482-73a86bc4d4e7.description: This fine garment is made of black silk interwoven with faint, silvery threads. While wearing it, you gain the following benefits. Poison Resistance. You have Resistance to Poison damage. Spider Climb. You have a Climb Speed equal to your Speed and can move up, down, and across vertical surfaces and along ceilings, while leaving your hands free. Spider Walk. You can't be caught in webs of any sort and can move through webs as if they were Difficult Terrain. Web. You can cast Web (save DC 13). The web created by the spell fills twice its normal area. Once used, this property can't be used again until the next dawn.

You can take a Bonus Action to magically coat the blade with poison. The poison remains for 1 minute or until an attack using this weapon hits a creature. That creature must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 2d10 Poison damage and have the Poisoned condition for 1 minute. The weapon can't be used this way again until the next dawn.

0b27409e-6570-5ba2-8dfa-2ca15ca9b7f7.name: Elemental Gem
0b27409e-6570-5ba2-8dfa-2ca15ca9b7f7.description:
This gem contains a mote of elemental energy. When you take a Utilize action to break the gem, an elemental is summoned (see "Monsters" for its stat block), and the gem ceases to be magical. The elemental appears in an unoccupied space as close to the broken gem as possible, understands your languages, obeys your commands, and takes its turn immediately after you on your Initiative count. The elemental disappears after 1 hour, when it dies, or when you dismiss it as a Bonus Action. The type of gem determines the elemental, as shown in the following table.

| Gem            | Summoned Elemental |
|----------------|--------------------|
| Blue sapphire  | Air Elemental      |
| Emerald        | Water Elemental    |
| Red corundum   | Fire Elemental     |
| Yellow diamond | Earth Elemental    |

94d99706-2348-558b-b896-98f9d2be2b20.name: Eversmoking Bottle
94d99706-2348-558b-b896-98f9d2be2b20.description: As a Magic action, you can open or close this bottle. Opening the bottle causes thick smoke to billow out, forming a cloud that fills a 60-foot Emanation originating from the bottle. The area within the smoke is Heavily Obscured. Each minute the bottle remains open, the size of the Emanation increases by 10 feet until it reaches its maximum size of 120 feet. Closing the bottle causes the cloud to become fixed in place until it disperses after 10 minutes. A strong wind (such as that created by the Gust of Wind spell) disperses the cloud after 1 minute.

1a48a48e-f5e1-5dc7-b7ec-5a13ff35aca4.name: Horseshoes of a Zephyr
1a48a48e-f5e1-5dc7-b7ec-5a13ff35aca4.description: These horseshoes come in a set of four. As a Magic action, you can touch one of the horseshoes to the hoof of a horse or similar creature, whereupon the horseshoe affixes itself to the hoof. Removing a horseshoe also takes a Magic action. While all four shoes are affixed to the hooves of a horse or similar creature, they allow the creature to move normally while floating 4 inches above a surface. This effect means the creature can cross or stand above nonsolid or unstable surfaces, such as water or lava. The creature leaves no tracks and ignores Difficult Terrain. In addition, the creature can travel for up to 12 hours a day without gaining Exhaustion levels from extended travel.

41dd977a-7779-5b7a-9efe-ff9c409eac19.name: Javelin of Lightning
41dd977a-7779-5b7a-9efe-ff9c409eac19.description: Each time you make an attack roll with this magic weapon and hit, you can have it deal Lightning damage instead of Piercing damage. Lightning Bolt. When you throw this weapon at a target no farther than 120 feet from you, you can forgo making a ranged attack roll and instead turn the weapon into a bolt of lightning. This bolt forms a 5-foot-wide Line between you and the target. The target and each other creature in the Line (excluding you) makes a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking 4d6 Lightning damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. Immediately after dealing this damage, the weapon reappears in your hand. This property can't be used again until the next dawn.

a6d6e3a2-7a7a-549b-9933-de06966fa0cc.name: Ring of X-ray Vision
a6d6e3a2-7a7a-549b-9933-de06966fa0cc.description: While wearing this ring, you can take a Magic action to gain X-ray vision with a range of 30 feet for 1 minute. To you, solid objects within that radius appear transparent and don't prevent light from passing through them. The vision can penetrate 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of common metal, or up to 3 feet of wood or dirt. Thicker substances or a thin sheet of lead block the vision. Whenever you use the ring again before taking a Long Rest, you must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or gain 1 Exhaustion level.

744aa212-11d7-5b67-be9d-9fa538fcc783.name: Staff of Thunder and Lightning
744aa212-11d7-5b67-be9d-9fa538fcc783.description: This staff can be wielded as a magic Quarterstaff that grants a +2 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with it. It also has the following additional properties. Once one of these properties is used, it can't be used again until the next dawn. Lightning. When you hit with a melee attack using the staff, you can cause the target to take an extra 2d6 Lightning damage (no action required). Thunder. When you hit with a melee attack using the staff, you can cause the staff to emit a crack of thunder audible out to 300 feet (no action required). The target you hit must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or have the Stunned condition until the end of your next turn. Thunder and Lightning. Immediately after you hit with a melee attack using the staff, you can take a Bonus Action to use the Lightning and Thunder properties (see above) at the same time. Doing so doesn't expend the daily use of those properties, only the use of this one. Lightning Strike. You can take a Magic action to cause a bolt of lightning to leap from the staff's tip in a Line that is 5 feet wide and 120 feet long. Each creature in that Line makes a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw, taking 9d6 Lightning damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. Thunderclap. You can take a Magic action to cause the staff to produce a thunderclap audible out to 600 feet. Every creature within a 60-foot Emanation originating from you makes a DC 17 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 2d6 Thunder damage and has the Deafened condition for 1 minute. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only.
